articleTitle: Raman amplification: An enabling technology for high-capacity, long-haul transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Raman increases OSNR without much penalty to allow longer reach (skipping Regens) and/or longer spans (or skipped sites) for all fiber types and links. Modular Raman implementation allows customized designs. Higher power Raman modules may be needed for high Aeff fiber types. Raman cost should be viewed at both beginning & end of life. Raman works on aged fiber and through multiple connectors as long as simple installation cleaning is performed (high power connectors recommended for > 10 dB Raman gain). Raman helps deal with varying span losses during operation. Raman and EDFAs should be designed to work together. Raman has been commercially deployed for > 10 years. Operating a network with Raman should not be more complex & should add robustness!

articleTitle: Biomedical fiber optic sensor applications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Fiber optic sensors offer the possibility to perform on-line, real time chemical, bio and medical measurements. Unique applications in medicine, food industry, environmental monitoring and homeland defense are covered in this presentation.

articleTitle: High speed circuits for short reach optical communications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Circuits (SiGe and CMOS) are ready for >50 Gb/s NRZ optical TX and RX; SiGe can deliver >100 Gb/s NRZ optical TX/RX; VCSEL links have been demonstrated at up to 71 Gb/s; Silicon Photonics links have been demonstrated at 56 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Information-theoretic limits on coherent nonlinear optical-fiber communication
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Information theory establishes fundamental limits on the rate of reliable communication over noisy channels. This talk reviews basic information-theoretic concepts, particularly as they apply to coherent optical data transmission over nonlinear optical fibers.

articleTitle: SDN control of a coherent Open Line System
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Microsoft is beginning the development of a SDN control plane for an Open Line System (OLS). This paper discusses some of the issues surrounding the effort and some potential approaches for controlling the OLS and coherent sources and receivers.

articleTitle: Device technologies for integrated packaged transceivers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: InP-based PICs have enabled a first generation of CFP2-ACO modules for line-side 100Gb/s deployment. A number of options are available to scale to higher volumes and enable high density transport up to 400Gb/s.

articleTitle: ONF: Applying SDN to optical transport
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: One of the key tenets of SDN followed by the Open Networking Foundation is the abstraction of network behavior. This has enabled the separation of forwarding and control and led to faster innovation in both the forwarding plane and the control plane. In our work on optical transport, we have demonstrated common control for packet and optical switching, as well as application access to network topology and control. In this talk, we will describe ONF's SDN architectural view of the network in general and optical transport in particular and explain the extensions to OpenFlow that instantiate SDN for optical transport along with the requirements they satisfy.

articleTitle: Facebook's data center infrastructure: Open compute, disaggregated rack, and beyond
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This talk describes critical elements in Facebook's latest data center architectural design. From rack disaggregation, to the strategy for optical interconnect deployment; we describe how these concepts become initiatives in the Open Compute Project (OCP).

articleTitle: Beyond CFP2-ACO
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Why the CFP2-ACO? Where is it now? Where is it going? Does a CFP4-ACO make any sense? The EO component space evolution over the next 3 years and the roles for ACO and board mounted components.

articleTitle: Architecting the next generation DCN for flexibility and scale with optics and SDN
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recent trends in cloud computing call for rethinking the Data Center Network (DCN) design for huge capacities, tremendous scale, and high levels of flexibility. On the other hand, business and environmental sustainability concerns call for improving the cost effectiveness and power efficiency. DCN architecture proposed by EU project COSIGN stands up for these challenges by combining optical technologies for data plane benefits, Software Defined Networking (SDN) for control plane programmability, and orchestration software for advanced network service provisioning.

articleTitle: Programmable hardware in software defined networking
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Software presents performance difficulties if it is the sole means of allowing programmability in high-speed optical SDN and NFV. Programmable hardware offers an ideal companion for implementing flexible SDN data planes and accelerating NFV functions.

articleTitle: High bandwidth transceivers using heterogeneous integration on silicon
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The heterogeneous integration of InP material into a silicon photonics wafer flow enables high bandwidth transceivers to be fabricated using established silicon foundry infrastructure for both fabrication and packaging.

articleTitle: Towards a control orchestration protocol for multi-tenant multi-domain SDN/PCE transport networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Intra-DC networks are composed of heterogeneous vendor domains. The definition of a common SDN/PCE orchestration architecture and protocol abstracting the specific control and transport technologies is key for providing end-to-end connectivity and virtual network services

articleTitle: Inscribed waveguides for new optical circuit applications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The document was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: SDN and routing strategies for cloud-scale data center traffic
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Networks for CloudScale Data Centers are challenged by the need to support multiple diverse traffic patterns and traffic types across a single shared physical network. This talk lays out challenges and shows how softwaredefined networking combined with simple physical networks meets the need.

articleTitle: How server designs will change as interface bandwidth demands continue to increase
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper explores the trade-offs of how system designs will change as interface designs migrate from 10 to 25 to 56Gbit/lane applied to traditional scale-out systems and disaggregrated systems.

articleTitle: Implementing SDN controlled flexible optical transport at AT&T, the next steps
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An overall view of AT&T's SDN based optical transport target architecture, role of flexible and feature rich network elements, SDN driven use cases to enable multi-layer packet/optical network in serving cloud applications, and practical & real implementation in the near term.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics … with the photons
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Skorpios technology platform that delivers on all promises of Silicon Photonics will be described. Skorpios' proprietary process monolithically integrates III–V material into SOI wafers and allows the production of a wide variety of laser sources.

articleTitle: Technology trends to speed up the delivery of wall street data
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Networking is having a profound and increasingly dominant role in modem financial markets. This talk will present an overview of electronic trading systems, trends in the underlying technologies, and areas of opportunity for researchers.

articleTitle: Emerging open technology and optics for the next generation mega data centers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: I will talk about how 2015 is the year of the change for mega data centers. The industry is shifting to open hardware and software. An important part of this is the optical interconnect industry is targeting now the high volume data centers first changing the development, manufacturing, and pricing models.

articleTitle: Opportunities for bandwidth-on-demand between large datacenters
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Cloud computing has numerous use cases requiring bursts of intercloud bandwidth while maintaining a lower average network utilization. We describe the applications driving these requirements and network programmability from a cloud service provider perspective.

articleTitle: Atomic cladding waveguide
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present recent results on our atomic clad waveguide including strong interactions at moderate temperatures, all optical switching and Doppler free lines. We also discuss coupled photonic-atomic resonances and their potential for stabilizing telecom sources.

articleTitle: Visible light communication
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: VLC physical layer techniques have advanced significantly during last decade. We have seen tremendous improvements in data rates, range and coverage. Novel devices such as SPADs and micro LEDs can improve VLC systems considerably. VLC is not just a point-to-point communication technology. Li-Fi attocellular networks achieves ever smaller cells to enable 10,000 more traffic, 100 times more wireless devices and peak data rates above 10 Gbps. Li-Fi enables secure wireless communications. Li-Fi is a strong candidate for 5G technology. Li-Fi supports the emerging Internet-of-Things as well as new ways of energy harvesting wireless communications.

articleTitle: Realizing a 36-core, 3-mode fiber with 108 spatial channels
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe the design and characterization of a 3-type heterogeneous 36-core, 3-mode fiber with record spatial channel count and density and perform transmission measurements in all 108 spatial channels using 40×100GHz spaced 25GBaud DP-QPSK signals.

articleTitle: 114 space-division-multiplexed transmission over 9.8-km weakly-coupled-6-mode uncoupled-19-core fibers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present space-division multiplexed transmission with spatial multiplicity over 100 using weakly-coupled-6-mode uncoupled-19-core fiber. Suppressing mode coupling and core-to-core crosstalk, MIMO complexity can be reduced. The record aggregate spectral efficiency over 345 bit/s/Hz is achieved.

articleTitle: High-density multicore fiber with heterogeneous core arrangement
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 30-core fiber with heterogeneous cores that achieved large spatial multiplicity and low crosstalk of less than -40 dB at 100 km was demonstrated. The correlation lengths were estimated to be more than 1 m.

articleTitle: LDPC coded modulation with probabilistic shaping for optical fiber systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An LDPC coded modulation scheme with probabilistic shaping, optimized interleavers and noniterative demapping is proposed. Full-field simulations show an increase in transmission distance by 8% compared to uniformly distributed input.

articleTitle: An o-band metamaterial converter interfacing standard optical fibers to silicon nanophotonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A metamaterial interface between standard optical fibers and silicon waveguides was fabricated in a CMOS production facility and shows -1.3dB peak efficiency with 0.8dB penalty over a 100 nm bandwidth and all polarizations.

articleTitle: Next-generation optical access networks for C-RAN
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper reviews the required specifications to optical fronthaul links for C-RAN and presents key technologies of optical transmissions and a CPRI data compression for next-generation optical access networks.

articleTitle: C-band single wavelength 100-Gb/s IM-DD transmission over 80-km SMF without CD compensation using SSB-DMT
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: C-band 100-Gb/s discrete multi-tone modulation transmission over 80-km single mode fiber without CD compensation is experimentally demonstrated. By using dual-drive Mach-Zehnder modulator-assisted single-sideband modulation, CD induced power fading is eliminated after direct detection.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous space-division multiplexing and joint wavelength switching demonstration
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a six spatial-mode, wavelength-routing network interoperable with few-mode, coupled-multi-core, and single-mode fiber spans using a custom 57-port wavelength-selective switch configured for joint-switching of spatial-superchannels.

articleTitle: Next generation mobile fronthaul architectures
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The evolution to ever higher radio bandwidths and the massive introduction of new services and technologies in 5G networks, along with their challenging requirements in the time and frequency domain will warrant revisiting the present CPRI fronthaul approach.

articleTitle: 1-Terabit/s net data-rate transceiver based on single-carrier Nyquist-shaped 124 GBaud PDM-32QAM
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using a transmitter based on sub-band synthesis, we generate and transmit over long-haul distance a record 1-Tb/s net data-rate single-carrier PDM-32QAM 124-GBd Nyquist-shaped signal with a spectral efficiency of 8 b/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Transmission of 56-Gb/s PAM-4 over 26-km single mode fiber using maximum likelihood sequence estimation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a transmission of 56-Gb/s PAM-4 over a 26.4-km single mode fiber (SMF) at 1550nm using maximum likelihood sequence estimation (MLSE). We discuss the transmitter and receiver DSP that can improve PAM-4 performance.

articleTitle: Low-power MOS-capacitor based silicon photonic modulators and CMOS drivers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present efficient MOS-capacitor based silicon photonic modulators driven by low-power CMOS inverter based driver ICs. Operating under the lumped-element approximation, modulation formats of NRZ, PAM, and QAM are demonstrated.

articleTitle: APD-based duobinary direct detection receivers for 40 Gbps TDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on the feasibility of using 25 Gbps APDs as 3-level electrical duobinary direct detection receivers for use in low cost 40 Gbps TDM-PON.

articleTitle: Split-PHY processing architecture to realize base station coordination and transmission bandwidth reduction in mobile fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a new RAN architecture splitting BS functions within PHY layer. It reduces mobile fronthaul transmission bandwidth by 90 % and achieves BS coordination performance with 0.5 dB SNR degradation compared to conventional C-RAN.

articleTitle: Analytical results on system maximum reach increase through symbol rate optimization
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the dependence of maximum system reach on symbol rate. We identify a suitable modeling framework and derive a closed-form formula for the optimum rate, typically 2-to-10 GBaud. Maximum reach gains are between 5% and 20%.

articleTitle: Joint adaptive pre-compensation of transmitter I/Q skew and frequency response for high order modulation formats and high baud rates
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a digital algorithm for joint pre-compensation of the low-pass frequency response and I/Q skew in transmitters. Experimental results for DP-16QAM to DP-256QAM at 37.41 GBaud are presented.

articleTitle: 5 mW/Gbps hybrid-integrated Si-photonics-based optical I/O cores and their 25-Gbps/ch error-free operation with over 300-m MMF
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed 5 mm square Si-photonics-based chip-scale optical transmitters/receivers called “optical I/O cores”. The power consumption of their hybrid-integrated ICs is 5 mW/Gbps. We demonstrated 25-Gbps/ch error-free oerror-free operationperation over 300-m MMF in the O band.

articleTitle: High capacity submarine transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: · Coherent technology unlocked capacity of undersea systems · Increased several times the capacity of the legacy systems· Brought to life new generation of dispersion uncompensated systems with capacities more than 10 Tb/s per fiber · Laboratory experiments are close to Shannon limit · Further increase in capacity can be achieved · Better bandwidth utilization: spectral shaping and variable spectral efficiency · Expansion of the bandwidth into L band · Is SDM the next step? · Power efficiency is an attractive argument.

articleTitle: BiCMOS silicon photonics platform
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Photonic BiCMOS is a new monolithic electronic-photonic integration technology, offering high-speed bipolar transistors together with broadband silicon photonics devices such as germanium detectors and depletion-type modulators. Integration aspects and first demonstrator examples shall be reviewed.

articleTitle: Practical implementation of higher order modulation beyond 16-QAM
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review practical aspects of higher order QAM modulation for optical coherent transmission systems. Measurements of 64-QAM with a silicon-photonics based integrated transmitter show only minor degradation, when compared to a discrete components setup.

articleTitle: Narrow linewidth sampled-grating distributed Bragg reflector laser with enhanced side-mode suppression
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a thermally tuned SGDBR laser integrated with semiconductor optical amplifier and spectral filter achieving 70kHz spectral linewidth, 50dB SMSR, and +17dBm fiber- coupled output power over a 41nm wavelength range across the C-band.

articleTitle: Novel DAC digital pre-emphasis algorithm for next-generation flexible optical transponders
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel digital pre-emphasis algorithm based on the mean-square-error. We numerically demonstrate a significant increase of the maximum transmittable symbol rate for 4- up to 64QAM and experimentally, a ~ 0.7dBQ-gain for 40GBaud-16QAM.

articleTitle: An ultra low power 3D integrated intra-chip silicon electronic-photonic link
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A record low energy (250fJ/bit) intra-chip electronic-photonic link is demonstrated at 5Gb/s on a 3D-integrated wafer using through-oxide-vias (1.45fF-per-via) for the first time. The receiver sensitivity was −19.3dBm and the on-chip laser energy was 6fJ/bit.

articleTitle: Practical implementation of 100-Gbit/s/lambda optical short-reach transceiver with Nyquist PAM4 signaling using electroabsorptive modulated laser (EML)
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate practical equalizing filter requirement and temperature range of EML-base 102.4-Gbit/s Nyquist-PAM4 transceivers and demonstrate its wide-temperature operation (20 degree) and a 40-km SMF transmission at 1.3 μm using commercial EMLs experimentally.

articleTitle: 112-Gb/s WDM link using two directly modulated Al-MQW BH DFB lasers at 56 Gb/s
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Reliable Al-BH lasers at 1310 nm with a 29-GHz bandwidth were used to demonstrate a 2×56-Gb/s NRZ WDM link.

articleTitle: Ultra-high port count wavelength selective switch employing waveguide-based I/O frontend
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an ultra-high port count wavelength selective switch employing a waveguide-based input/output frontend that scales the port count to the order of hundreds. We demonstrate a 1 × 95 WSS and confirm its feasibility.

articleTitle: Joint coding rate and modulation format optimization for 8QAM constellations using BICM mutual information
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We compare the BICM mutual information of different 8QAM constellations and we show that Circular-8QAM is attractive for high coding rates while quadrature optimized Rect-8QAM provides best performance for low coding rates, both outperforming Star-8QAM.

articleTitle: A 64 Gb/s PAM-4 linear optical receiver
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a linear optical receiver realized on 130 nm SiGe BiCMOS. Error-free operation assuming FEC is shown at bitrates up to 64 Gb/s (32 Gbaud) with 165mW power consumption, corresponding to 2.578 pJ/bit.

articleTitle: Advanced ROADM technologies and architectures
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper reviews the dependencies between the node-level architecture, the wavelength selective switches, the multiplexer/demultiplexers, and the transceivers within advanced reconfigurable optical add/drop multiplexing networks supporting colorless, directionless and contentionless multiplexing/demultiplexing.

articleTitle: First experimental demonstration of orchestration of optical transport, RAN and cloud based on SDN
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We design and experimentally demonstrate the first resource orchestration across DWDM optical transport, radio access networks (RANs) and cloud domains based on SDN. The orchestration enables agile service creation and optimized resource allocation.

articleTitle: Monolithic photonic-electronic QPSK receiver for 28Gbaud
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The paper presents the first fully monolithic photonic-electronic single-polarization QPSK receiver for 56Gbps (28Gbaud). The receiver sub-system was realized in photonic BiCMOS technology and demonstrates integration capabilities for state-of-the-art coherent systems.

articleTitle: Record-low (0.1460 dB/km) attenuation ultra-large aeff optical fiber for submarine applications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Record-low attenuation of 0.1460 dB/km is measured on a silica-core fiber with 148 µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> effective area. Other span loss characteristics are also discussed and quantified, such as ultra-low attenuation after cabling and splice loss reduction.

articleTitle: First quasi-single-mode transmission over transoceanic distance using few-mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A record spectral efficiency of 6.5 b/s/Hz over 6600 km is demonstrated using quasi-single-mode transmission over 101.6-km long hybrid few-mode and single-mode spans with high launch power.

articleTitle: Demonstration of SDN orchestration in optical multi-vendor scenarios
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: SDN brings automation to network operation and abstracts the complexity of optical networks. An orchestration layer is required to support multivendor interoperability scenarios. This work demonstrates that an ABNO architecture enables SDN controlled domain interoperability.

articleTitle: Network virtualization controller for abstraction and control of OpenFlow-enabled multi-tenant multi-technology transport networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A network hypervisor is introduced to dynamically deploy multi-tenant virtual networks on top of multi-technology optical networks. It provides an abstract view of each virtual network and enables its control through an independent SDN controller.

articleTitle: Nonlinear modulation characteristics of white LEDs in visible light communications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The nonlinear dependence of the modulation bandwidth and electrical to optical conversion on the drive current of white LEDs were investigated by comparing novel analytical modeling and experimental measurement for visible light communications.

articleTitle: Tomlinson-Harashima precoding with soft detection for faster than Nyquist DP-16QAM coherent optical systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the feasibility of transmitting 5×32 Gbaud DP-16QAM faster-than-Nyquist signals within 30 GHz spaced channels, which is enabled by the Tomlinson-Harashima precoding (THP) combined with soft-decision forward error correction (SD-FEC).

articleTitle: Reach enhancement of 100% for a DP-64QAM super-channel using MC-DBP
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A digital coherent super-receiver enables the reception and demodulation of a 7×10GBd DP-64QAM Nyquist spaced super-channel. Multi-channel DBP provides a 100% improvement in reach from 640km to 1280km of SSMF, with an ISD of 9.15b/s/Hz.

articleTitle: 160-Gbaud coherent receiver based on 100-GHz bandwidth, 240-GS/s analog-to-digital conversion
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a coherent receiver using a 100-GHz electrical bandwidth and 240-GS/s real-time oscilloscope as analog-to-digital converter in a 160-Gbaud QPSK system.

articleTitle: First demonstration of SDN-based segment routing in multi-layer networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Segment Routing enabling dynamic optical bypass in a multi-layer network is experimentally demonstrated. Edge nodes are efficiently configured by an enhanced SDN controller, showing effective scalability performance under different label stacking conditions.

articleTitle: Transmission of single-carrier Nyquist-shaped 1-Tb/s line-rate signal over 3,000 km
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We synthesize a single-carrier optical signal at a record 1-Tb/s line-rate, out of multiple spectral slices by joint optical and digital signal processing. The 127.9-GBd signal is successfully transmitted and detected after 3,000km distance.

articleTitle: Mobile front-haul employing ethernet-based TDM-PON system for small cells
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We develop a mobile front-haul prototype based on TDM-PON (10G-EPON). The system can accommodate 3 CPRI option-3 links and 7 compressed CPRI option-3 links with reasonable latency under 100 μs.

articleTitle: 6-mode spatial multiplexer with low loss and high selectivity for transmission over few mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a spatial 6-mode multiplexer with low loss and high mode selectivity. We demonstrate 100Gbit/s error-free transmission over 20km for 6 modes and over 40km bi-directional transmission with 3 modes in each direction.

articleTitle: A simple strategy for mitigating XPM in nonlinear WDM optical systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Resilience to cross-phase modulation (XPM) can be improved by employing multicarrier modulation formats. The impact of the number of subcarriers on the achievable information rate is discussed and a possible XPM compensation strategy is suggested.

articleTitle: Novel digital pre-distortion techniques for low-extinction ratio Mach-Zehnder modulators
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel digital pre-distortion technique for low-extinction ratio modulators is presented. Penalty-free transmission in back-to-back system configuration is reported for 16- and 64QAM at 32GBaud with modulator extinction ratios as low as 14dB.

articleTitle: Impact of linear mode coupling on the group delay spread in few-mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report an investigation on the group delay spread in few-mode fibers operating in the weak and strong linear coupling regimes, and for the first time, we study the transition region between them. A single expression linking the group delay spread to the fiber correlation length is validated for any coupling regime, considering 3 guided modes.

articleTitle: Four-channel 100-Gb/s per channel discrete multi-tone modulation using silicon photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report four-channel discrete multi-tone modulation using silicon photonic circuits with net channel rates of 100 Gb/s and 70 Gb/s detected by commercial and germanium receivers, respectively. Transmission up to 4-km fiber is presented.

articleTitle: On parameter optimization for staircase codes
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss the optimization of staircase code parameters based on density evolution. An extension of the original code construction is proposed, leading to codes with steeper waterfall performance.

articleTitle: Characterization of space-division multiplexing fibers using swept-wavelength interferometry
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Swept-wavelength interferometry can rapidly characterize the amplitude and phase transfer matrices of multi-mode fibers and components. We will show measurements of short (meter) and long (kilometer) few-mode, multi-mode, and coupled multi-core fibers.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity-tolerant OSNR estimation technique for coherent optical systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel technique capable of accurately monitoring OSNR even under the influences of fiber nonlinearities. We show that this technique can monitor the OSNR of 112-Gb/s PDM-QPSK signals with accuracy of 1.3 dB.

articleTitle: Experimental validation of the EGN-model in uncompensated optical links
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first experimental validation of the EGN-model. Using a PM-QPSK Nyquist-WDM transmission we confirm the enhanced accuracy of the EGN-model comparing maximum reach predictions with those of GN-model.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Nyquist UDWDM-PON with digital signal processing in real-time
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper reports the first coherent WDM-PON (16×2.5 Gb/s QPSK) experimental demonstration with real-time Nyquist OLT transmitters and real-time ONU receivers. Both transmitters/receivers implemented in FPGA use a simple 8-bit DSP architecture. An optimal transmitted power of -7 dBm per channel is achieved for 50 km, 1:16 split and 2.5 GHz grid.

articleTitle: Dense space division multiplexed transmission over multi-core and multi-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review recent progress in space division multiplexed (SDM) transmission, and examine our experimental demonstration of dense SDM (DSDM) using both multi-core and multi-mode, which provides a key advance to ultra-high capacity transmission.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of a four-dimensional 256-ary lattice-based modulation format
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A four-dimensional modulation format with 256 point from the D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>-lattice (256-D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>) is compared to PM-16QAM in experiments. 256-D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> is more sensitive at high OSNR but with a 21.3% overhead turbo product code, PM-16QAM outperforms 256-D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>.

articleTitle: A 26-Gb/s 1.80-pJ/b CMOS-driven transmitter for 850-nm common-cathode VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 26-Gb/s, 1.80-pJ/b transmitter composed of a 65-nm bulk-CMOS driver and an 850nm VCSEL array in a QFN package is demonstrated. The VCSEL's anode is directly modulated without a negative supply voltage at 0.82-dBm OMA.

articleTitle: Optical demonstration of a compliant polymer interface between standard fibers and nanophotonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a peak transmission efficiency of −2.4dB between a standard optical fiber and a nanophotonic waveguide using a mechanically compliant polymer interface. We find a 1.5dB penalty over a 100nm bandwidth and all polarizations.

articleTitle: Real-time demonstration of software-defined Elastic interface for flexgrid networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a real-time Elastic Interface for future flex-grid networks with a software-defined symbol rate transmission. Using PDM-QPSK modulation, live experiments show a line rate adaptation from 10.7 to 107Gbit/s with a sub-millisecond reconfiguration time.

articleTitle: Self-seeded RSOAs WDM PON field trial for business and mobile fronthaul applications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: GEth, CPRI and 10 Gbit/s transmissions are experimented using amplified and standard self-seeded RSOA WDM PON systems. A field trial setup was exploited to test the system performance in terms of reach and optical budget.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of relation between mode-coupling and fiber characteristics in few-mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally clarify that relation between mode-coupling coefficient h and effective-index difference Δn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> in few-mode fibers (FMFs) by impulse response technique and h in our fabricated FMFs with Δn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> ≥ 1.7 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> converges to 7.4×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> 1/km.

articleTitle: Experimental characterization of a graded-index ring-core fiber supporting 7 LP mode groups
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We design and characterize a graded-index-ring-core fiber supporting 7 LP mode-groups (13 spatial modes) for mode multiplexed transmission with low MIMO processing complexity. Spatial and temporal modal properties are analyzed using an SLM-based mode multiplexer/demultiplexer.

articleTitle: LDPC codes for optical channels: Is the “FEC limit” a good predictor of post-FEC BER?
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We answer the question in the title negatively. More precisely, the FEC limit is invalid for soft decision decoding and low to medium code rates. A better predictor is the generalized mutual information.

articleTitle: Extended reach of 116 Gb/s DP-QPSK transmission using random DFB fiber laser based raman amplification and bidirectional second-order pumping
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel random DFB fiber laser based Raman amplification using bidirectional second-order pumping. This extends the reach of 116 Gb/s DP-QPSK WDM transmission up to 7915 km, compared with other Raman amplification techniques.

articleTitle: Integrated optical beamformers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper gives an overview of three different types of integrated optical beamfoming networks (OBFNs) that have been designed and/or fabricated over the past few years. The first is a binary tree true time delay based OBFN, the second a novel hardware compressed OBFN exploiting multi-wavelength, and finally an optical beamformer capable of multibeaming based on the Nolen matrix.

articleTitle: A torus datacenter network based on OPS/OCS/VOCS enabled by smart flow management
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an energy-efficient, low-latency, torus-topology intra-datacenter network with the deployment of 100-Gb/s hybrid optoelectronic routers, where OPS, OCS and virtual OCS are all supported on a single hardware platform enabled by smart flow management.

articleTitle: Spectral engineering technique to mitigate 37.5-GHz filter-cascade penalty with real-time 32-GBaud PDM-16QAM
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the potential of spectral engineering to mitigate the penalties on 32-Gbaud 256-Gb/s PDM-16QAM channels passing through the deployed cascade of 37.5-GHz wide filters in case of wavelength detuning and real-time coherent detection.

articleTitle: 42.8 Gbit/s indoor optical wireless communication with 2-dimensional optical beam-steering
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: To combat the imminent radio frequency spectrum crunch, we propose an infrared optical wireless communication solution for in-home networks, with remotely controlled 2-dimensional passive optical beam-steering, which exhibited 42.8 Gbit/s over 2.5 m free-space transmission.

articleTitle: An SDN-based integration of green TWDM-PONs and metro networks preserving end-to-end delay
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel latency-aware aggregation node architecture supporting TWDM-PONs is successfully demonstrated. The node, performing traffic scheduling according to sleep-mode operations, includes a lightweight SDN solution, scaled to operate as intra-node controller.

articleTitle: 50GHz Ge waveguide electro-absorption modulator integrated in a 220nm SOI photonics platform
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report waveguide-integrated Ge electro-absorption modulators operating at 1615nm wavelength with 3dB bandwidth beyond 50GHz and a capacitance of 10fF. A 2V voltage swing enables 4.6dB DC extinction ratio for 4.1dB insertion loss.

articleTitle: Assessment of options for utilizing SNR margin to increase network data throughput
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: When optimizing an optical network should we adapt the SNR to the signal or adapt the signal to the available SNR? We show both approaches give comparable results but have different complexity trade-offs.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a 9 LP-mode transmission fiber with low DMD and loss
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 9 LP-mode (15 spatial modes) fiber with low DMD, confirmed by both time of flight and S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> measurements. Low loss (~0.2dB/km) is verified by OTDR measurement of the individual mode groups.

articleTitle: SDN-enabled programmable optical packet/circuit switched intra data centre network
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated an SDN-enabled optical DCN leveraging AoD, OPS, FPGA-based ToR with extended OpenDayLight controller and extended OF protocol. Experimental results show application-aware OCS/OPS connection provisioning (753/214ms), OPS end-to-end connections latency (252μs), and OCS/OPS switchover.

articleTitle: In-band OSNR monitoring of PM-QPSK using the Stokes parameters
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss OSNR monitoring using low bandwidth Stokes parameter analysis. OSNR levels reaching 23 dB are experimentally estimated within ±1 dB. Simulations show resilience to chromatic dispersion, corresponding to 1000 km of SMF for the experimental setup.

articleTitle: DORIOS: Demonstration of an all-optical distributed CPU, memory, storage intra DCN interconnect
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show an all-optical ultra-low latency server-to-remote memory/storage data center interconnection, exploiting programmable, flexible, bi-directional and data-rate transparent 4×16 Spectrum Selective Switches and supporting elastic WDM/TDM services using fast nanosecond tunable lasers.

articleTitle: High performance carrier phase recovery for coherent optical QAM
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A simple feedforward phase recovery algorithm for M-QAM constellations is presented. Performance is evaluated as a function of laser linewidth and SNR for 16- and 64-QAM, and is compared to that of the Blind Phase Search algorithm.

articleTitle: Flexible power-efficient Nyquist-OTDM transmitter, using a WSS and time-lens effect
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Power-efficient, flexible, Nyquist 4.88-ps sinc-pulses generation and OTDM multiplexing is demonstrated, using fractional Fourier transform subcarriers and time-lens effect. OTDM users are generated and multiplexed by a WSS, without rectangular spectral shaping.

articleTitle: A 25 Gbps silicon photonic transmitter and receiver with a bridge structure for CPU interconnects
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel configuration of hybrid-integrated silicon photonic interconnects employing a bridge structure, and demonstrate 25 Gbps error-free operation between transmitter and receiver with power efficiency of 9.6 mW/Gbps including a serializer chip.

articleTitle: Experimental verification of visible light communications based on multi-band CAP modulation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A multi-band CAP system is experimentally demonstrated for the first time in VLC. We show that with an 8-CAP testbed spectral efficiencies (~4.75 b/s/Hz) at a realistic distance of 1 m can be reached.

articleTitle: MIMO DSP complexity in mode-division multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review group delay management techniques and multi-input multi-output (MIMO) digital signal processing (DSP) architectures for mode-division multiplexing systems. We demonstrate long-period fiber grating devices for introduction of strong mode coupling to obtain fast and low complexity MIMO DSP.

articleTitle: Single-channel 1.92 Tbit/s, 64 QAM coherent orthogonal TDM transmission of 160 Gbaud optical Nyquist pulses with 10.6 bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 1.92-Tbit/s (160-Gbaud), PDM-64-QAM transmission over 150 km with a net potential spectral efficiency of 10.6 bit/s/Hz. This ultrahigh channel capacity and spectral efficiency were achieved simultaneously with an orthogonal TDM scheme.

articleTitle: Next generation ROADM technology and applications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: I introduce next generation ROADM technologies and application. A combination of PLC technology and free space optics will be the key to realizing simple CD/CDC ROADM. The defragmentation and re-grooming of optical paths will be important for utilizing network resources.

articleTitle: CapEx advantages of few-mode fiber networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: CapEx minimization for few-mode fiber networks is studied for different traffic patterns for the first time. FMF networks can have significant CapEx advantages for bulk data transfer and for fine-granularity switching by deploying MDM-compatible WSSs.

articleTitle: Pairwise coding to mitigate polarization dependent loss
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: By pre-coding data across polarizations, the performance degradation due to PDL can be largely mitigated without any coding overhead. Experimentally, this technique shows more than 2-dB Q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> improvement for PDM-QPSK with 6-dB worst-case PDL.

articleTitle: Multi-domain overarching control of flexi-grid networks with GMPLS as inter-SDN controller communication
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the experimental assessment of a hybrid control plane for multi-domain, heterogeneous networks based on abstraction and hierarchical TE. A mesh of SDN controllers use GMPLS protocols as East/West interfaces, forming an abstracted topology.

articleTitle: Low-crosstalk semi-trench-assisted multicore flat fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 250-m long 125-µm×315-µm size semi-trench-assisted multicore flat fiber is fabricated using undoped-secondary-cladding as the trench. Crosstalk at 630 nm is fully suppressed in the fiber with 4.2-µm and 27.5-µm core and pitch size, respectively.

articleTitle: All-optical coherent OFDM transmission of 8 × 40 Gb/s using an on-chip AWGR-FT 1 × 8 decoder circuit
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an 8 × 40 Gb/s all-optical coherent-OFDM system using an on-chip 1 × 8 Fourier-transform based on a modified arrayed-waveguide grating router, showing simultaneous receiving of 8 subcarriers with similar signal qualities.

articleTitle: Internet connectivity for the world's 60% unconnected population
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Due to three orders of magnitude global population density distribution, advanced telecom payload technologies located on earth, air and space are required to meet the challenge of providing Internet service to the unconnected world population.

articleTitle: Transmission optimized impairment mitigation by 12 stage phase conjugation of WDM 24×48 Gb/s DP-QPSK signals
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Fiber impairment mitigation of an unprecedented 24 WDM channel count is demonstrated in a transmission optimized fiber link using 12 phase conjugations. An 8dB higher nonlinearity threshold is measured for WDM 1.1Tb/s DP-QPSK signals.

articleTitle: A 50-Gb/s NRZ-modulated optical transmitter based on a DFB-LD and a 0.18-µm SiGe BiCMOS LD driver
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 50-Gb/s optical transmitter, consisting of a DFB-LD with a bandwidth of 20 GHz and a SiGe BiCMOS LD driver, was developed. At 43-50 Gb/s, it enhanced a LD bandwidth and demonstrated wide eye openings.

articleTitle: The manipulated rotating BPSK technique compatible with conventional CMA algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper proposes a manipulated rotating binary phase shift keying (MR-BPSK) technique, which can use conventional constant modulus algorithm (CMA) to update the adaptive filter coefficient. This technique inherits the robust nonlinear tolerance of conventional BPSK, which is proved in 420/440km real time unrepeatered transmission experiment.

articleTitle: HFA optimization for nyquist WDM transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose optimization rules for HFA in NyWDM transmission over uniform uncompensated links, and for moderate pumping regime we introduce a fiber Raman merit parameter showing that noise reduction is always dominant on NLI enhancement.

articleTitle: Energy efficient tunable light sources for next generation flexible access networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Tunable lasers are reviewed for colorless ONUs in next-generation access networks. In particular, advanced VCSEL technologies toward athermal and widely tunable operations, ultra-high-speed & low-chirp direct modulation, and ultra-compact modulator integration are presented.

articleTitle: Low-energy, high-performance lossless 8×8 SOA switch
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first monolithically-integrated active-passive lossless 8×8 SOA switch. A wide IPDR of 14.5dB for penalty <;1dB is achieved. The switch paths through the device exhibit excellent uniformity.

articleTitle: A study of a saturated parametric mixer non-reciprocity dependence on the pump wavelength
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study the non-reciprocal saturated parametric amplifier response dependence on the pump wavelength. The available pump depletion bandwidth and signal induced pump depletion level were characterized and the optimum pump wavelength and propagation direction was identified, with the non-reciprocal behavior having been clearly observed at all of the tried pump wavelengths.

articleTitle: Function placement and configuration for power balanced network function programmable optical nodes
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Synthesis, placement and configuration of SSS and EDFAs for different power balance scenarios is presented, for the first time, for function programmable optical node architectures. Comparison on device's number and OSNR performance are reported.

articleTitle: Resource allocation in nonlinear flexible-grid fiber-optic networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe a novel method for joint resource allocation in flexible-grid networks based on a nonlinear impairment model. Compared with the fixed-grid WDM benchmark, our algorithm achieves 38% bandwidth saving and significant transmission distance extension.

articleTitle: Pump-phase-noise-tolerant wavelength multicasting for QAM signals using flexible coherent multi-carrier pump
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate pump-phase-noise-tolerant 1-to-7 wavelength multicasting for QAM signals using flexible coherent multi-carrier pump. Less than 0.8dB penalty is obtained after multicasting with the elimination of phase noise from pump using coherent pumping.

articleTitle: Quadrature duobinary modulation and detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the performance of quadrature-duobinary (QDB) modulation with both maximum-likelihood-sequence-estimation and symbol-by-symbol detection and show that QDB can achieve better performance than 8-ary quadrature-amplitude modulation (8QAM) and 16QAM at a 4-b/s/Hz spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Multi frequency components generation using cascaded time lenses based on space-time duality
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We simulate and experimentally demonstrate a cascaded time lenses scheme to generate multi frequency components with frequency spacing tunable. The two time lenses are used to implement frequency-to-time mapping and spectral Talbot effect, respectively.

articleTitle: Characterization of electrostriction nonlinearity in a standard single-mode fiber based on cross-phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Electrostriction nonlinearity in a standard single mode fiber is characterized with a phase-diversity coherent optical receiver. Measured differences in the polarizations of crosstalk signatures caused by Kerr and electrostriction nonlinearities are reported.

articleTitle: Hybrid modulation formats outperforming 16QAM and 8QAM in transmission distance and filtering with cascaded WSS
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed time-domain hybrid-modulation with adaptive symbolrates to optimize the reach and margin of WSS routed 400 Gb/s systems. Experimental comparisons show, that a DP-8QAM/16QAM hybrid format can outperform the benchmark DP-8QAM and DP-16QAM formats in distance when up to 18 WSS are incorporated.

articleTitle: A full-band RF photonic receiver based on the integrated ultra-high Q bandpass filter
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A full-band RF receiver ranging from L- to W-band based on the ultra-high Q bandpass filter has been proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The SFDR of the receiver from C- to K-band are larger than 114dB-Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup>.

articleTitle: Optical nonlinearities in space-division multiplexed transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: generalized Stokes representation; Manakov and coupled Manakov equations for nonlinear mode-coupling; Raman amplification in multimode fibers; and analogies (and differences) with polarization of the (linear and) nonlinear multimode dynamics.

articleTitle: Advanced detection of super-Nyquist WDM QPSK signals with 5-bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show that using a quadrature 4-level polybinary detection scheme together with maximum-likelihood-sequence estimation, we can achieve a 5-bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency for super-Nyquist WDM quadrature-phase-shift-keyed signals, with performance comparable to 16-ary quadrature-amplitude modulation.

articleTitle: PMD induced impairment mitigation in Stokes vector direct detection systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the first measurement of PMD mitigation in Stokes vector direct detection (SV-DD) systems. By applying two novel algorithms, PMD tolerance has been improved from 3.5 to 9 ps for a 93-Gb/s SV-DD system.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave nonlinear optics in low-stress silicon-rich nitride waveguides
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate CW-pumped wavelength conversion in low-stress silicon-rich nitride waveguides. The ability to grow thick silicon-rich layers simultaneously enables high-field confinement, dispersion engineering and handling high-power levels without two-photon absorption effects.

articleTitle: 52.6 Gbit/s single-channel directly-modulated optical transmitter for 2-µm spectral region
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical injection locking is used to increase the modulation bandwidth and suppress chirp in a single-channel, single-polarization discrete multi-tone bit-loading-optimized transmitter. Transmission through a hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber with negligible signal degradation and distortion is demonstrated.

articleTitle: High performance narrow bandpass filters based on integrated Bragg gratings in silicon-on-insulator
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show that a dispersion-less filter with a narrow square-shaped passband exhibiting sidelobe suppression ratio reaching 13 dB can be fabricated in SOI using the superposition apodization technique and a phase noise reduction approach.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of tunable phase-noise mitigation and automatic frequency/phase locking for a 20–32 Gbaud QPSK homodyne receiver using optical mixing of nonlinearly generated higher harmonics
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate tunable phase-noise mitigation and automatic frequency/phase locking to a “local” pump laser for a 20-32 Gbaud QPSK homodyne receiver using nonlinear optical signal processing. For the input noisy signal, open eye-diagrams are obtained for in-phase and quadrature components and ~2 dB OSNR gain is achieved at BER 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: New ROADMs with DSP-enabled dynamic and flexible operations for elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Flexible ROADMs for architecture on demand are proposed and investigated, for the first time, which offer DSP-enabled dynamic operations at wavelength, sub-wavelength and orthogonal sub-band levels, continuous add-channel frequency tuneablility, and 10dB drop-channel sensitivity improvements.

articleTitle: Ring-based interleaver for Nyquist filtering and WDM multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We analyze the system performance of a novel ring-resonator circuit for simultaneous Nyquist pulse shaping and (de)multiplexing, which features a roll-off factor of 0.025 and is able to dramatically reduce the digital signal processing workload.

articleTitle: Parallel optical engine using vertical coaxial alignment
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A compact parallel optical engine platform using Si optical bench technology to realize highly manufacturable vertical coaxial alignment approach is demonstrated and an in-production 40G optical engine using this platform is presented.

articleTitle: 256 QAM (polarization-multiplexed, 5 Gsymbol/s) coherent transmission with an injection-locked homodyne detection technique
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an 80 Gbit/s-256 QAM coherent optical transmission with a fiber laser-based injection-locked homodyne detection circuit. The circuit enabled low phase-noise carrier-phase synchronization, and an 80-Gbit/s data signal was successfully transmitted over 150 km.

articleTitle: Image processing based common phase estimation for coherent optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexing system
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel common phase error estimation method based on image processing technique is proposed. Both numerical simulations and experiments prove its feasibility to compensate phase noise with improved spectral efficiency than the pilot-subcarrier aided method.

articleTitle: Training-based determination of perturbation coefficients for fiber nonlinearity mitigation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A new training method to determine perturbation coefficients for fiber nonlinearity mitigation is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. This method can deliver reliable coefficients for arbitrary pulse shapes, CD and power profiles without the full knowledge of system parameters.

articleTitle: Comparative digital mitigations of DAC clock tone leakage in a single-carrier 400G system
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate performances of two digital methods for suppression of clock tone leakages of an 80GS/s high-speed DAC supporting single-carrier 400G. A novel clock leakage mitigation technique is experimentally demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: High temperature operation of an integrated erbium-doped DBR laser on an ultra-low-loss Si3N4 platform
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate record high temperature operation, 400 °C, of an integrated Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>:Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> DBR laser on an ultra-low-loss Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> waveguide platform. Additionally, the device exhibits an uncompensated temperature dependent wavelength shift of 1.92 GHz/°C and maintains over 1.5 mW of output power throughout the entire temperature range.

articleTitle: Implementing simplified stokes vector receiver for phase diverse direct detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel Stokes vector receiver (SV-R) with phase diversity based on 4 single-ended photo-detectors and demonstrate 80-Gb/s direct detection (DD) over 160-km SSMF transmission. OSNR sensitivity is compared among different SV-R DD schemes.

articleTitle: Back-end integration of multilayer photonics on silicon
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present vertically-stacked a-Si:H and AlN photonic circuits deposited on silicon using back-end CMOS technology. At 1550-nm telecom wavelengths, the a-Si:H (0.5-µm×0.22-µm) and AlN (1-µm×0.4-µm) channel waveguides are measured to have low propagation losses of ∼3.8 and ∼1.4 dB/cm, respectively. Various passive devices with high performance are demonstrated on these two photonic layers, including multimode interferences (MMI), waveguide ring resonators (WRR), and arrayed-waveguide gratings (AWG). Moreover, the thermo-optic coefficients (dn/dT) of a-Si:H and AlN are measured to be ∼2.60×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup> and ∼3.56×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup> K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>, respectively.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous multi-domain network virtualization with end-to-end differentiated service provisioning and virtual network organization
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Hierarchical network virtualization is demonstrated on a heterogeneous multi-domain network testbed, based on SDN/Openflow and two-level Flowvisor. Differentiated services with various sets of QoS requirements are provisioned in the end-to-end optimally organized virtual networks.

articleTitle: Demonstration of large-port-count and compact ROADM that exhibits virtual-C/D/C performance
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate novel large-scale and cost-effective ROADM architecture exploiting the subsystem-modular express switches and tailored transponder banks for add/drop functionality. Simulations show that the proposed ROADM offers virtual-C/D/C performance. Good transmission characteristics are experimentally confirmed.

articleTitle: Renewable-energy-aware data center placement in optical cloud networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We solve the problem of datacenter placement in optical cloud networks with the aim of jointly minimizing the non-renewable datacenter energy consumption and the number of DCs. Lexicographic optimization is utilized to balance the two objectives.

articleTitle: Fine resolution spectral filtering using a 25GHz free-spectral range arrayed waveguide grating
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Spectrally dispersed light from a fine resolution AWG is spectrally filtered at ~1 GHz resolution with an SLM. AWG phase errors were permanently trimmed waveguide-by-waveguide with an excimer laser by inducing stress in the glass.

articleTitle: Double-slot hybrid plasmonic cavity used for phase modulation and sensing
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Highly-efficient double-slot hybrid plasmonic cavity is demonstrated. By measuring phase change with different liquids, we show that this sub-wavelength structure has better modulation efficiency than Si-based one for applications in ultra-compact highly-efficient sensors and modulators.

articleTitle: Radio over colorless WDM-PON with wavelength reuse based on polarization multiplexing and coherent detection incorporating digital phase noise cancellation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A bidirectional radio over a colorless wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) passive optical network (PON) with wavelength reuse based on polarization multiplexing and coherent detection incorporating digital phase noise cancellation is proposed and experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Advanced and low-complexity digital backpropagation for subcarrier-multiplexing systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An advanced digital backpropagation algorithm is proposed for subcarrier-multiplexing systems. Efficient intra-channel nonlinear compensation is experimentally demonstrated using this algorithm with 40 spans/step and 16 spans/step for QPSK and 16QAM formats, respectively.

articleTitle: W-band OFDM RoF system with simple envelope detector down-conversion
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This article proposes W-band OFDM RoF system at 103.5 GHz employing envelop detector (ED) down-conversion. It can support vector signal down-conversion and doesn't need the LO in BS. The data rate of W-band OFDM signals with 10-GHz bandwidth can achieve 40 Gbps over 25-km fiber and 2-m wireless transmission.

articleTitle: Software-defined, virtualized networking and beyond 100G
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Network Virtualization is coming to play the important role in network architecture because there are many flexible resources are available in ICT infrastructure. In this paper, we describe state-of-the-art challenges to be forced in implementing network virtualization functions and several use cases of utilizing network virtualization to get more value than is provided by using existing network architecture. We also discuss the future direction of networks in the Beyond 100G Era.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact 8-arrayed 8ç1 switch consists of ZrO2-SiO2-based high a PLC
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report an ultra-compact 21mm × 9mm 8-arrayed 8×1 switch based on the ZrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> PLC. Low insertion loss of less than 3.2dB in C-band was achieved by low loss coupling technique using a high-Δ fiber.

articleTitle: Ultra-high peak rejection notch microwave photonic filter using a single silicon microring resonator
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a simple approach to realize ultra-high peak rejection notch microwave photonic filter (MPF). Using a conventional phase modulator and a tunable bandpass filter, we achieve a notch MPF with an ultra-high peak rejection > 60 dB based on a single notch silicon microring resonator.

articleTitle: 1.8-Gb/s WDM visible light communication over 50-meter outdoor free space transmission employing CAP modulation and receiver diversity technology
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a WDM VLC system employing CAP modulation and receiver diversity technology. The record aggregate data rate of 1.8Gb/s with the BER less than 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> is successfully achieved over 50-m outdoor transmission.

articleTitle: 1.5-µm, 21.4-Gbps 4-PAM VCSEL link for optical access applications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the transmission performance of 21.4-Gbps 4-PAM signals generated by using a 1.54-µm VCSEL. We achieve >8-dB power budget after 15-km transmission over SSMF by optimizing the extinction ratio and utilizing electronic equalization.

articleTitle: Performance enhancement of an orbital-angular-momentum-based free-space optical communication link through beam divergence controlling
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using beam divergence controlling to mitigate angular error effects in OAM-based FSO links is investigated through simulation and experiment. Results show that controlling beam divergence allows reducing power loss and angular error induced channel crosstalk.

articleTitle: 25GBaud PAM-4 error free transmission over both single mode fiber and multimode fiber in a QSFP form factor based on silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first compact silicon photonics (SiPh) transceiver packaged in a QSFP form factor operating error free over 10 km of single mode fiber and 100m of multimode fiber using 25.6 GBaud PAM-4 optical signaling.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously integrated waveguide-coupled photodiodes on SOI with 12 dBm output power at 40 GHz
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate InP-based modified uni-traveling carrier photodiodes on silicon-on-insulator (SOI) waveguides with an internal responsivity of 0.95 A/W and 48 GHz bandwidth. The RF output power reaches 12 dBm at 40 GHz, which is the highest reported output power of high-speed waveguide photodiodes.

articleTitle: A low-phase-noise 18 GHz Kerr frequency comb spanning 65 THz
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a low-phase-noise on-chip 18GHz Kerr comb, with 3,600 phase-locked comb modes spanning 65THz. The lowest phase noise floor is achieved to date, with -130 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz offset for the 18GHz carrier.

articleTitle: An optimization approach for multi-domain disaster recovery
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper develops a novel optimization scheme for multi-domain optical network protection under multiple probabilistic failures arising from large-scale disasters. The model is solved using an approximation approach and the results compared with some advanced heuristics.

articleTitle: Efficient centralized light sources for RoF-WDM-PON based on weak-resonant-cavity fabry-perot laser diode
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel RoF-WDM-PON system to efficiently manage the light sources in the central office for both upstream and downstream links. A WRC-FPLD was employed as the key component to generate multi-wavelength lightwaves.

articleTitle: Maximize protected capacity for shared backup path protected optical networks with time domain hybrid modulation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We apply the time domain hybrid modulation (TDHM) transmission technique to maximize the protected capacity of a shared backup path protected (SBPP) optical network. Simulation results show that compared with discrete modulations, the TDHM scheme can significantly increase total protected network capacity.

articleTitle: Fiber-based solutions for in-door multi-Gbit/s wireless access
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Growth of wireless technologies requires high-capacity and energy-efficient infrastructures. Fiber-based RoF solutions provide multi-Gbit/s capacity with easy-upgrade, cost-effective and energy efficient features.

articleTitle: Software-defined transceivers for dynamic access networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Software-defined transceivers are about to be established in long-haul optical communications. But will they be of equal importance in dynamic access networks? And which technology seems most promising?

articleTitle: 20-Gb/s PDM-QPSK signal delivery over 1.7-km wireless distance at W-band
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 1.7-km wireless delivery of 20-Gb/s@85.5-GHz PDM-QPSK signal with a BER less than 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the longest wireless transmission distance at W-band up to now.

articleTitle: Circuit design techniques for high bit rate and high density optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: High density and high bit rate optical interconnects require higher level of integration and complexity. These solutions require circuits design techniques that result in low power and low crosstalk penalty which will be discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Silicon hybrid wavelength/mode-division-demultiplexer with 64 channels for on-chip optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel 64-channel silicon hybrid demultiplexer is proposed and demonstrated by utilizing a 1×4 ADC-type mode demultiplexer and two 17×17 bi-directional AWGs. With the proposed design, the hybrid demultiplexer becomes very compact and this issue of the channel-wavelength's misalignment is also relaxed greatly in comparison with the previous design. The insertion loss and crosstalk for the fabricated hybrid demultiplexer are around −5dB and −14dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Low-overhead low-power-consumption LDPC-based FEC solution for next-generation high-speed optical systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A low-overhead low-power-consumption LDPC-based FEC solution for next-generation high-speed optical systems is proposed. The novel concept provides 10.2-dB NCG with 12% total overhead and less than 2-W power consumption for 100-Gbps throughput.

articleTitle: Splice-on connectors: Design, application and development trend
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper describes the latest field-installable connectors, such as the mechanical splice-on connectors and fusion splice-on connectors, as well as, the recent trends and developments of splice-on connectors.

articleTitle: Demonstration of m-ary encoding/decoding using visible-light Bessel beams carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) for free-space obstruction-free optical communications
