publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate m-ary encoding/decoding using visible-light Bessel beams carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) for free-space obstruction-free optical communications. The bit-error rate (BER) performance of hexadecimal and 32-ary encoding/decoding are investigated. A zero BER of hexadecimal encoding/decoding is observed after decoding 500 symbols with obstruction.

articleTitle: Photonics-assisted microwave mixing and direct detection for dual-polarization and SCM based UDWDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel photonics-assisted unconventional double-sideband sub-carrier modulation is proposed for dual-polarization UDWDM-PON with direct detection. High spectral-efficiency is achieved by removing the band-limited electrical mixing components.

articleTitle: Optical comb-based versatile wavelength division multicasting add-drop node for efficient WDM networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a robust and modulation-format-transparent multicasting wavelength converter based on a Mach-Zehnder optical comb generator. All the wavelength-converted channels show maximum 0.6 dB and 1.1 dB penalties for QPSK and 16QAM signals, respectively.

articleTitle: A WDM 4×28Gbps integrated silicon photonic transmitter driven by 32nm CMOS driver ICs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A four-channel WDM silicon photonic transmitter with integrated lasers and modulators driven by low-power 32nm CMOS drivers, is demonstrated to operate at a data rate of 4×28Gb/s with BER<;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> and power consumption of 10.0pJ/bit.

articleTitle: 30×30 MIMO transmission over 15 spatial modes
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We transmit over all 30 spatial and polarization modes of a 22.8-km multimode fiber. 15-mode photonic lanterns enabled low-loss coupling into and out of the fiber and a time-multiplexed coherent receiver facilitates measurement of all 30 signals.

articleTitle: Optical chaos and hybrid WDM/TDM based large capacity quasi-distributed sensing network with real-time fiber fault monitoring
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical chaos and hybrid WDM/TDM based large capacity quasi-distributed sensing network with real-time fiber fault monitoring is proposed and proof-of-concept demonstrated. The multiplexing capacity can promisingly reach to 512.

articleTitle: Cascading-failure-resilient interconnection for interdependent power grid - Optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In interdependent power grid - optical networks, a single failure may cause iterative cascade of failures, resulting in network-wide disruptions. We propose schemes to design cascading-failure-resilient interconnection between power grid and optical network.

articleTitle: Novel delay-division-multiplexing OFDMA passive optical networks enabling low-sampling-rate ADC
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Without extra hardware, the proposed delay-division-multiplexing scheme reduces sampling rate and FFT size at ONUs in OFDMA-PONs to 1/2∼1/32 of conventional ones. Sending preprocessed signals, various aliasing-free subcarriers can be received dynamically by controlling delays.

articleTitle: Dispersion-tolerant single-sideband OFDM transmission in IM/DD systems using a single cascaded EAM
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using a single cascaded EAM, we demonstrate 13.5-Gbps IM/DD-OFDM transmission over 0∼200-km without distance-dependent bit-loading. Dispersion-induced fading and nonlinear distortion in conventional IM/DD systems are settled by novel single-sideband modulation and SSII cancellation schemes, respectively.

articleTitle: Photonic-assisted broadband wireless communication with On-line channel compensation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Based on photonic-assisted radio-frequency arbitrary waveform generation, a wireless communication system is assembled to experimentally demonstrate channel sounding, on-line channel distortion compensation and error-free data transmission for ultrabroadband (2-18 GHz) radio-frequency signals.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously integrated III–V on silicon distributed feedback lasers at 1310 nm
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report performances of III–V/Si distributed feedback lasers at 1310 nm. Continuous wave regime is achieved up to 55°C, with room-temperature threshold of 35 mA, while mode-hope-free operation with side-mode suppression ratio above 55 dB is measured. The −3dB bandwidth is 6.7 GHz.

articleTitle: Handover reduction via mobility-prediction-based VPON formation in optical-access-enabled cloud-RAN
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Next-generation radio-access networks will experience excessive handover due to shrinking cell sizes (to support more users) and increasing user mobility. We form Virtual Passive Optical Network (VPON) using mobility-prediction information to reduce handovers in CRAN.

articleTitle: λ-tuning protection scheme achieving under 50-ms protection time based on MPCP and backup-wavelength pre-assignment on WDM/TDM-PONs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a fast WDM/TDM-PON OLT-protection method based on ONU λ-tuning to pre-assigned backup wavelength and normal MPCP without discovery procedure. The fabricated system with 40-km SMF transmission achieves protection times of under 50 ms.

articleTitle: Deploying DSP in optical transceiver modules
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Application of specific digital signal processing techniques can ease the bandwidth and SNR limitations of optical links. This can lead to flexible layout and packaging options as well as improved performance.

articleTitle: Diamond-integrated optomechanical circuits
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Diamond integrated photonic devices are promising candidates for applications in nanophotonics and optomechanics. Here I present active modulation of diamond-based devices by exploiting mechanical degrees of freedom in free-standing electro-optomechanical resonators.

articleTitle: 25Gb/s 3-level burst-mode receiver for high serial rate TDM-PONs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first 25Gb/s 3-level modulated BM-RX employing a ¼-rate linear BM APD-TIA and a custom decoder IC. We successfully demonstrated burst-mode sensitivity of -20.4dBm with 18dB dynamic burst-to-burst for 25Gb/s upstream links.

articleTitle: 6 port 3×3 wavelength selective cross-connect by software-only reprogramming of a 1×N wavelength selective switch
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a wavelength selective cross-connect that can route any wavelength of any of the inputs to any output. The device is created by simple reprogramming a conventional 1×N wavelength selective switch, without hardware changes.

articleTitle: Ultra-low loss CMOS compatible multi-layer Si3N4-on-SOI platform for 1310nm wavelength
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated the applications of our Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>-on-SOI platform for O-band operation with propagation and interlayer transition loss of ∼0.24dB/cm and ∼0.2dB, respectively. We also characterized our SOI-based Ge photo-detector and silicon modulator at λ= 1310nm.

articleTitle: Recent advances in avalanche photodiodes
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper will review recent advances in linear- and Geiger mode avalanche photodiodes (APDs). The focus for linear-mode devices will be materials and structural modifications to the conventional InP/InGaAs APD that have enabled reduced excess noise and enhanced gain-bandwidth products. The discussion of Geiger mode APDs will cover the basic operation and principal performance parameters with emphasis on techniques to reduce afterpulsing.

articleTitle: Dynamic window decoding for LDPC convolutional codes in low-latency optical communications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a dynamic window decoding scheme for LDPC convolutional codes to reduce the latency compared to the belief propagation decoding. The BER performance of our proposed memory-efficient decoding scheme is verified by simulations.

articleTitle: High-speed tunable microwave photonic notch filter based on phase modulator incorporated loop mirror filter
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a frequency tunable microwave photonic notch filter with tens of GHz tuning speed. High notch rejection ratio of 50-dB is experimentally obtained over a continuously frequency tuning range from 1.5 to 10 GHz.

articleTitle: UDWDM PON with 6 × 2.5Gbaud 16-QAM multicarrier transmitter and phase noise tolerant direct detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 50km un-repeated downstream transmission based on a 12.5GHz comb source with 6 channels, each carrying 2.5GBd 16-QAM data. The pilot tone enables direct detection and phase noise independence delivering 10Gb/s per user.

articleTitle: Bandwidth scalable and high fidelity spectrally-sliced transmitter
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a high-fidelity transmitter based on the synthesis of multiple spectral slices and transmit a 60-GBd PDM-QPSK waveform over 4480 km with a Q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-factor of 8.71-dB using two slices.

articleTitle: Ultra-selective flexible add-drop multiplexer using rectangular stimulated brillouin scattering filters
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate optical separation-aggregation of a ∼2-GHz sub-band for a multi-band OFDM signal in QPSK and 16-QAM formats. The band gap is 300-MHz by using a rectangular optical filter based on stimulated Brillouin scattering.

articleTitle: High-diversity millimeter-wave CoMP transmission based on centralized SFBC in radio-over-fiber systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a space-frequency block coding transmission method enabled by centralized radio-over-fiber systems to improve diversity gain in millimeter-wave coordinated multipoint transmission. A real-time end-to-end experiment reveals improved signal quality and stability.

articleTitle: Trans-pacific transmission of quad-carrier 1Tb/s DP-8QAM assisted by LUT-based MAP algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 1Tb/s quad-carrier DP-8QAM transmission over 9280 km is reported at a spectral efficiency of 4.54 b/s/Hz thanks to the proposed joint transmitter maximum a posterior (MAP) pre-distortion and receiver correction scheme.

articleTitle: LCoS-based devices for MDM
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The applications of spatial light modulators for mode division multiplexing will be discussed, including multiplexing, characterization and wavelength switching and filtering.

articleTitle: Analysis of inter-core crosstalk in homogeneous multi-core two-mode fiber under bent condition
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We analyze the inter-core crosstalk in a homogeneous multi-core two-mode fiber under bent condition by using coupled-mode equations. The effects of the intra-core mode coupling on the inter-core crosstalk are investigated for various bending radii.

articleTitle: Efficient monitoring for ring-based long-reach passive optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An efficient monitoring scheme based on transmission-reflection analysis is proposed for long-reach passive optical networks. Both experimental and simulation results have demonstrated that the proposed scheme provides better localization functionality than the conventional methods.

articleTitle: III–V/SOI vertical cavity laser with in-plane output into a Si waveguide
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an optically-pumped III–V-on-SOI hybrid vertical-cavity laser that outputs light into an in-plane Si waveguide, using CMOS-compatible processes. The laser operates ∼1.49 µm with a side-mode suppression ratio of ∼27 dB and has a similar threshold as long-wavelength VCSELs.

articleTitle: Dilute Nitride SOAs for high-speed data processing in variable temperature conditions
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the first experimental study of a Dilute Nitride SOA with high-speed gain dynamics and attractive thermal characteristics as a data processing element at 10Gb/s and at different operating temperatures.

articleTitle: High performance DP-QPSK receiver module incorporating InP-based integrated coherent detection chip
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper presented a fully integrated InP coherent receiver chip for a dual polarization QPSK application. The chip, which has the highest responsivity reported to date, used a unique layout to benefit module assembly and minimize excess loss. The overall responsivity of a full module with VOA functionality exceeded 0.07A/W. The paper also demonstrated a miniaturized version of our chip which is suitable for future size and cost reductions.

articleTitle: Reliable expanded beam connector compliant with single-mode fiber transmission at 10 Gbit/s
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A new microlens design brings together benefits of physical contact and expanded beam technologies resulting in a reliable single-mode fiber connection requiring low maintenance for 10 Gbit/s networks as the Fiber-To-The-Home.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of passive optical network based on mode-division-multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate passive optical network based on mode-division-multiplexing. Two individual linearly polarized (LP) modes are successfully transmitted over 1.8-km low-modal-crosstalk few-mode optical fiber and demultiplexed with error-free performance.

articleTitle: Bidirectional 400-Gb/s transmission by lOOGbE optical sub-assemblies and a cyclic arrayed waveguide grating
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a bidirectional 400-Gb/s configuration that uses optical sub-assemblies for 100-Gb/s Ethernet and a cyclic arrayed waveguide grating. The feasibility of a 10-km fiber transmission of 28-Gbaud 8λ-PAM4 and a compact transceiver are shown.

articleTitle: Addition of in-band crosstalk to the Gaussian noise model
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The combination of a spectral weighting metric and a colored-to-white noise weighting factor incorporates crosstalk into the Gaussian noise model providing a performance prediction tool requiring no direct measurement of crosstalk impact on system sensitivity.

articleTitle: Colorless, dual-polarization 90° hybrid with integrated VOAs and local oscillator on polymer platform
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Colorless and polarization-multiplexed 90° hybrid is demonstrated on polymer platform with vertically inserted thin-film elements as efficient polarization splitter and rotator, on-chip VOAs, and integrated 22-nm wavelength-tunable high-power local oscillator for coherent WDM detection.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic method for distributed compensation of XPM in long haul WDM systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an optoelectronic method for distributed compensation of XPM based on power-dependent phase rotation. Simulations show 2.7-dB improvement in peak Q for a 28-Gbaud QPSK channel with 14-Gbit/s NRZ-OOK neighbors after 3200-km transmission.

articleTitle: Grating coupled low loss Ge-on-Si waveguides and multimode interferometers for the mid-infrared
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Germanium-on-silicon is a promising platform for planar photonics over the entire mid-infrared range. We report here grating coupled Ge-on-Si waveguides with record low losses of 0.6dB/cm, multimode interferometers and Mach-Zehnder interferometers.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of optical signal level swapping and multi-level amplitude noise mitigation using three parametric gain regions
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An optical signal level swapping function and a multi-level amplitude noise mitigation method are proposed using three parametric gain regions. Experiments demonstrate less than 1% EVM-penalty for swapping and multi-level amplitude noise mitigation is achieved.

articleTitle: Design of enhanced channel equalizers for adaptive zero-guard-interval CO-OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose the design of frequency domain block least-mean-square and recursive-least-square equalizers for adaptive zero-guard-interval CO-OFDM systems. Improvements in the channel estimation accuracy and channel tracking speed are experimentally and numerically demonstrated.

articleTitle: Demonstrating a software defined network (SDN) using Carrier Ethernet Switch Routers in a provider network
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate SDN in a service provider network using adapted Carrier Ethernet Switch Routers developed based on principles of segment routing. SDN based service composition and delivery is showcased and validated.

articleTitle: In-network experiences with installed OTN switched metro core optical systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Muxponders, while useful at the access edge, are no longer ideal for metro core network use. OTN switching in the metro core moves muxponders to the access edge, resulting in a more efficient metro core.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion of a 640 Gbit/s DPSK nyquist channel using a low-loss silicon nanowire
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 640 Gbit/s N-OTDM DPSK wavelength conversion is demonstrated in a Si-nanowire. All 64 tributaries are converted within an average power penalty of 1 dB at the FEC BER-limit 3E-3. Only 22-fJ/bit switching energy is required.

articleTitle: Noise characterization and transmission evaluation of unrepeated raman amplified DP-16QAM link
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Impairments characterization and performance evaluation of Raman amplified unrepeated DP-16QAM transmissions are conducted. Experimental results indicate that small gain in forward direction enhance the system signal-to-noise ratio for longer reach without introducing noticeable penalty.

articleTitle: Investigation of 50 GBd PAM-4 electrical interfaces for 2km data center interconnects
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The impact of ROSA-ADC electrical interconnect performance on a next-generation 2km-4λ, 56GBd PAM-4 system is investigated.

articleTitle: Undersea fiber optic cables - enabling a connected world
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Today, information flows across the globe as easily as it flows across the office. This information might come from New York, London, Tokyo, Sydney, Rio de Janeiro, or Cape Town and arrive not from satellites but from cables that sit on the ocean floor. The Earth's continents are connected with a web of undersea fiber optic cables that join the world's major population centers. Anyone who surfs the Internet, makes overseas calls, or simply texts friends on other continents uses these undersea fiber optic cables.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of optical wireless indoor localization system with background light power estimation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, an optical wireless based indoor localization system with background light power estimation capability is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. Results show that an average localization error of 2.41 cm is achieved.

articleTitle: DOCSIS 3.1® technology and hybrid fiber coax for multi-Gbps broadband
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: DOCSIS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> 3.1 technologies over HFC networks will continue to support the best-in-market speeds delivered to the broadest population of consumers with the best customer experience. This paper describes the trends of broadband demand and how cable technology could evolve leveraging fiber deep technologies.

articleTitle: Integrated devices for metro applications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss recent developments in optical and electro-optical integration and their benefits in the realization of optical interfaces for metro networks.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous silicon III–V Photonic Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. Some of the specific areas/topics discussed include: silicon photonics; silicon manufacturing; high speed interconnects; system scaling; multicore processors; interconnect power dissipation; waveguide optics; superior passive Si photonic devices; optical fiber coupling; 2D grating coupler; inverse taper; immersion lithography; in-band label extractor; optical packets; ring resonators; on-chip polarization handling devices; ultrasmall WDM filters; monolithic polarization diversity coherent receiver; ultralow loss waveguides; Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> high Q resonators; high Q whispering gallery mode resonators; microresonators comb generation; SiN optical microresonators; single soliton generation; Ge-on-Si photodetectors; on chip lasers and amplifiers; silicon light emission; electrically pumped germanium laser; heterogeneous integration; DFB quantum well hybrid silicon lasers; quantum well transmitters; AlGaInAs-silicon evanescent amplifier; semiconductor optical amplifiers; electroabsorption modulator; mode locked lasers; quantum dot lasers; ring tunable lasers; coupled cavity tunable laser; external cavity wavelength tunable laser; optical buffer memory; CMOS integration; and WDM links.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength in-band OSNR monitoring based on Lyot-Sagnac interferometer
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An in-band OSNR monitor based on Lyot-Sagnac interferometer is experimentally demonstrated for 4×40GBaud NRZ-QPSK WDM signal without requirement for prior knowledge of the noise-free coherence properties of the signal. OSNR from 7.5~25dB was realized.

articleTitle: 50×50 digital silicon photonic switches with MEMS-actuated adiabatic couplers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on monolithically integrated 50×50 digital silicon photonic switches with MEMS actuation, sub-microsecond switching time, low optical insertion loss (<;9.6dB), high extinction ratio (50dB), broadband operation (1400-1700nm), and compact footprint (7.6×7.6mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>).

articleTitle: Experimental investigation on crosstalk of FSK supervisory signal in ROADM networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The crosstalk of FSK supervisory signal encoded on 80×128Gbit/s DP-QPSK WDM channels in CNCG-ROADM networks was experimentally and theoretically estimated. The simulation results confirm that 30-cascaded ROADM could be supported with proper FSK signal decoder parameters.

articleTitle: High-diversity space division multiplexing visible light communication utilizing a fisheye-lens-based imaging receiver
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The verification experiment of the high-spatial-diversity fisheye-lens-based SDM VLC system is demonstrated. High spatial diversity is obtained, and an aggregate data rate of over 1.1 Gbit/s is achieved.

articleTitle: Digitally enhanced optical frequency domain reflectometry with long measurement range
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A digitally enhanced optical frequency domain reflectometry technique is proposed, in which the frequency-to-distance mapping is realized in digital domain. A spatial resolution of 1 m over 56 km was obtained in demonstrational experiments.

articleTitle: Mitigating spectral leakage and sampling errors in spatial and spectral (S2) imaging
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel method for validating the relative power value (MPI) of the Spatial and Spectral (S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) imaging technique. By applying corrections for spectral leakage and sampling errors we found the MPI determinations to be accurate within 1dB.

articleTitle: Demonstration of low-loss flexible fiber with Zeonex tube-lattice cladding for Terahertz transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A Zeonex hollow-core terahertz fiber was developed successfully. The lowest loss is 1dB/m at the frequency below 1THz, which is much lower than THz fibers reported. The loss is still below 5dB/m when it's bent.

articleTitle: Optical performance monitoring in DSP-based coherent optical systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review the requirements for optical performance monitoring in high capacity DSP based coherent optical transmission systems. Recent proposed schemes for OSNR and CD monitoring for coherent systems are summarized.

articleTitle: Recent progress in Silicon Photonics R&D and manufacturing on 300mm wafer platform
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A low cost 28Gbits/s Silicon Photonics platform using 300mm SOI wafers is demonstrated. Process, 3D integration of Electronic and Photonic ICs, device performance, circuit results and low cost packaging are discussed.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 512-ONU real-time dynamic-load-balancing with few wavelength reallocations for λ-tunable WDM/TDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate dynamic-load-balancing for the λ-tunable WDM/TDM-PON. Experiments confirm that our algorithm can distribute 512-ONU traffic loads fairly in real-time with 1/125 fewer λ-reallocations compared to the round-robin, and little impact on average latency.

articleTitle: Fast tunable silicon ring resonator filter for access networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon photonics filter based on ring resonator for an integrated receiver in access networks. This filter is rapidly tunable (15μs) and performs well in a 4×200GHz scheme, with BER better than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>.

articleTitle: Wide-temperature-range 103.2 (25.8 × 4)-Gb/s optical link for data-center Interconnects using a 1.3-µm lens-integrated surface-emitting laser array
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 103.2 (25.8 × 4)-Gb/s optical link using a 1.3-μm lens-integrated surface-emitting laser array was demonstrated. A power penalty after 2-km transmission was small (<;1dB) at 25°C. Moreover, error-free transmission up to 70°C was achieved.

articleTitle: Bi-directional transmission to reduce linear and nonlinear crosstalk
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Interleaved bi-directional transmission is shown to be a forward-looking system architecture benefiting from reduced nonlinear penalty. Although its performance is limited by Rayleigh scattering it is more suitable for systems designed for high spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Brown-field migration from fixed grid to flexible grid in optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the problem of gradual migration from fixed grid to flexible grid in optical networks by designing heuristics to selectively upgrade WSSs on ROADMs. We evaluate the performance of our scheme under different traffic profiles.

articleTitle: A 25Gb/s, 520mW, 6.4Vpp Silicon-Photonic Mach-Zehnder Modulator with distributed driver in CMOS
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 25Gb/s heterogeneously-integrated Silicon-Photonic transmitter is designed entirely in CMOS, consisting of a high-swing driver wire-bonded to a MZ modulator. Measurement results demonstrate clean optical eye diagrams with > 4dB extinction ratio while consuming 0.52W.

articleTitle: Compact and low-loss 8×8 silicon photonic switch module for transponder aggregators in CDC-ROADM application
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present 8×8 silicon photonic switch modules with newly designed spot size converters on a silicon chip. Averaged module excess loss as low as 7.2 dB on all 64 paths is achieved along with 0.15-ms switching.

articleTitle: First demonstration of service-differentiated converged optical sub-wavelength and LTE/WiFi networks over GEAN
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A converged optical-wireless testbed is formed integrating TSON sub-wavelength networking in UK and the NITOS wireless solution in Greece. End-to-end service provisioning and flow differentiation are demonstrated across two networks communicating over the GEANT.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated quantum-dot optical modulator with semiconductor optical amplifier for 1.3µm waveband error-free 10-km-long transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A monolithically integrated quantum-dot (QD) optical gain modulator with semiconductor optical amplifier was developed for successful demonstration of error-free Gb/s-order high-speed, 10-km-long transmissions using 1.3-μm multiple wavelength channels from a QD comb laser.

articleTitle: SiGe-based carrier-injection Mach-Zehnder modulator with enhanced plasma dispersion effect in strained SiGe
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate strained SiGe-based carrier-injection MZ optical modulator with low driving current of 1.47 mA owing to the enhanced plasma dispersion effect in SiGe. The 10 Gbps modulation with clear eye opening is also obtained.

articleTitle: Effect of waveguide surface roughness on the fiber coupling efficiency of inverse tapers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the effect of waveguide surface roughness on the coupling efficiency between silicon inverse tapers and lensed fibers. Short taper lengths of 30-50 micrometers are shown to achieve minimum coupling loss.

articleTitle: Generalized frequency division multiplexing for photonic-assisted millimeter-wave carrier aggregation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a spectrum efficient, photonic-assisted millimeter-wave carrier aggregation method using generalized frequency division multiplexing. For the first time, an experiment aggregating 18 component carriers demonstrates better EVM performance than OFDM with reduced guard bands.

articleTitle: Single channel 112Gbit/sec PAM4 at 56Gbaud with digital signal processing for data centers applications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 112Gbit/sec DSP-based single channel PAM4 at 56Gbaud that fits into QSFP is experimentally demonstrated. The DSP enables use of mature 25G optoelectronics for 2-10km datacenter intra-connections, and 8Tbit/sec over 80km interconnections between data centers.

articleTitle: Simultaneous multi-ONU wavelength switching method for coexistence of different λ-tuning times in WDM/TDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose OLT architecture and OLT internal control method utilizing multi wavelength-switching queues to realize simultaneous multi-ONU wavelength switching in λ-tunable WDM/TDM-PON. Suppression of latency degradation was demonstrated when ONUs of different λ-tuning times coexist.

articleTitle: Solutions for 80 km DWDM systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review currently discussed solutions for 80 km DWDM transmission targeting inter data-center connections at 100G and 400G line rates. PDM-64QAM, PAM4 and DMT are investigated, while the focus lies on directly detected solutions.

articleTitle: A novel routing and frequency slot assignment scheme that can adapt to transmission speed migration
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a dynamic control algorithm for flexible grid networks that can seamlessly adapt to transition channel capacity changes. Long-term network performance is numerically evaluated and the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Challenges in implementing high-speed, low-power ADCs in CMOS
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Challenges of CMOS ADC implementations for 100 Gb/s optical communication systems and beyond are highlighted. Limitations and opportunities of architectures and circuits are discussed based on a 56-90 GS/s 8 bit ADC in 32 nm SOI CMOS.

articleTitle: Data-oriented malleable reservation to revitalize spectrum fragments in elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper investigates malleable reservation (MR) for data-oriented requests to revitalize spectrum fragments in elastic optical networks. We formulate a mixed integer linear programming model and propose a time-efficient heuristic to solve the MR problem.

articleTitle: Advanced coding techniques for long-range Raman/BOTDA distributed strain and temperature measurements
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe the use of pulse coding for long-range distributed Raman and Brillouin optical time domain analysis (BOTDA) sensors and for implementing hybrid Raman/BOTDA distributed sensors for simultaneous strain and temperature measurement on the same fiber.

articleTitle: Scalable virtual network provisioning over distance-adaptive flexible grid optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a game theory based heuristic for provisioning virtual networks over distance-adaptive flexible grid optical networks. Our approach obtains close-to-optimal solutions with scalable and fast computation, which is critical for handling on-demand requests.

articleTitle: Experimental seamless Virtual Machine migration using an integrated SDN IT and Network Orchestrator
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper demonstrates an experimental Virtual Machine (VM) migration across several network domains (intra/inter-datacenter) while the VM network connection state is maintained. A SDN IT and Network Orchestrator is responsible for the VM seamless migration.

articleTitle: Consideration of control entity failure in distributed controlled multi-domain multi-vendor optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study on the problems caused by single control entity failure in the distributed controlled network architecture and then propose a novel scheme to improve network performance in terms of blocking probability and actual load.

articleTitle: Cross-layer orchestration for elastic and resilient packet service in a reconfigurable optical transport network
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a cross-layer orchestration for packet service over IP-optical networks, in terms of availability and elasticity. Our orchestration built over the SDN concept self-adjusts and cost-efficiently responds to dynamics on network paths, impairments/failures, and topology.

articleTitle: Optical design optimization for high-speed active optical cables
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce a Monte Carlo-based optimization to quantify the trade-off between optical loss and misalignment tolerances in active optical cables. Fibers with large core diameters are shown to outperform standard MMF at 20 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Tunable DC-40 GHz RF generation with high side-mode suppression utilizing a dual loop Brillouin optoelectronic oscillator
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An agilely tunable DC to 40 GHz RF generation using a dual-loop optoelectronic oscillator based on Stimulated Brillouin Scattering is experimentally demonstrated. The side-mode suppression ratio is measured to be 43.1 dB at 20 GHz.

articleTitle: Faster-than-Nyquist DFT-S-OFDM using overlapping sub-bands and duobinary filtering
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel single-channel Faster-than-Nyquist-DFT-S-OFDM transmitter that allows the sub-bands' spectra overlap flexibly. By combing duobinary filtering to mitigate inter-sub-band interference, 12% more spectral efficiency is demonstrated in a super-channel experiment over 3360-km transmission.

articleTitle: High-speed and duo-mode 850 nm VCSELs for 47 Gbps optical interconnect over 1 km OM4 fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Novel duo-mode 850nm VCSELs with short (λ/2) cavity, oxide-relief and Zn-diffusion apertures are demonstrated to balance the trade-off of speed and reaching bottleneck of VCSELs. Extremely-high data rate (47-Gbps) over 1005m OM4-fiber transmission is reported.

articleTitle: Optically phase-locked lasers for RF photonics applications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optically phase-locked lasers with low phase noise have the potential of being used in many RF photonic applications. In this paper, we review the work performed to offer high performance, robust and automated phase-locking solutions using semiconductor lasers. Implementation using a silicon photonic chip is presented.

articleTitle: 42-Gbit/s directly modulated 64-QAM OFDM with 10-GHz TO-can packaged colorless laser diode
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 10-GHz TO-can packaged colorless laser diode under coherent injection-locking for 42-Gbit/s 64-QAM OFDM transmission over 25-km SMF is demonstrated to achieve the lowest BER of 4.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup> at a receiving power of −2 dBm.

articleTitle: Low loss InP C-band IQ modulator with 40GHz bandwidth and 1.5V Vπ
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Design and fabrication improvements to InP optical IQ modulators resulted in a reduced Vπ of 1.5V while maintaining 40GHz bandwidth and loss <;7.5dB over C-band. Dual polarization QPSK constellations using 3Vpp drive are presented.

articleTitle: A noise suppression method for optical spectrum measurement utilizing SBS-based filter
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A comprehensive noise suppression method for SBS-based filter is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. Accompanied with linearization, the processed spectral dynamic range of an OOK signal can be improved from ∼10 dB to ∼60 dB.

articleTitle: Recent advances in low DGD few-mode fiber design, fabrication, characterization and experiments
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Design principles for low loss and control of mode coupling, fabrication results for DGD control, and characterization techniques are briefly reviewed. Experimental results for fibers supporting three or six spatial modes are presented.

articleTitle: Distributed control plane with spectral fragmentation-aware RMSA and flexible reservation for dynamic multidomain software-defined elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a distributed control scheme utilizing spectral fragmentation-aware RMSA and flexible active/passive reservation mechanism for dynamic multi-domain software-defined elastic optical networks. Our proposed scheme offers significant blocking probability reduction compared to conventional GMPLS/PCE architecture.

articleTitle: 40Gb/s pure photonic packet switch for datacenters
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 40Gb/s pure photonic packet switch testbed for a datacenter network. It uses a photonic wrap/un-wrap to handle all packet sizes, separate control and data paths, and a synchronization scheme to align packets of all nodes at the photonic switch despite different network fiber lengths.

articleTitle: High efficiency and SMSR distributed feedback laser array integrated with passive grating reflector based on reconstruction-equivalent-chirp technique
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We reported a 4-channel DFB laser array integrated with passive-grating-reflector utilizing reconstruction-equivalent-chirp technique. 53.3% increase of slope efficiency, 27.3% decrease of threshold current are obtained with >60dB SMSR and wavelength spacing deviation <; 0.07nm.

articleTitle: SDN/NFV orchestration for dynamic deployment of virtual SDN controllers as VNF for multi-tenant optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose to virtualize the SDN control functions and move them to the cloud. We experimentally evaluate the first SDN/NFV orchestration architecture to dynamically deploy independent SDN controller instances for each deployed virtual optical network.

articleTitle: 20Gb/s PAM-4 transmission from 35 to 90°C by modulating a Silicon Ring Resonator Modulator with 2Vpp
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A PAM-4 transmission is established by modulating a Si-RRM with a 2Vpp driving voltage. A 20Gb/s bit-rate is achieved with an 8GHz bandwidth, and maintained while the Si-chip temperature is varied from 35 to 90°C.

articleTitle: Advanced digital nonlinear distortion compensation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review the recent progresses on the nonlinear perturbation pre-distortion including the modified nonlinear model for performance improvement and nonlinear terms combination for complexity reduction. With Nyquist nonlinear model, the performance shows even more improvement.

articleTitle: A Si3N4 integrated programmable signal processor with a record high resolution for RF signal processing
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A programmable integrated RF signal processor with a record high resolution of 145 MHz has been proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The application to the signal extraction of OFDM-QAM signal has also been presented.

articleTitle: Unrepeatered high-speed transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review recent advances in the technologies required for high-speed unrepeatered transmission systems, with a specific focus on distributed Raman amplification. We also report several experimental demonstrations with record capacity and reach combinations.

articleTitle: RSOA intensity modulator frequency chirp-enabled 40Gb/s over 25km IMDD PON systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Adaptive bit and power loading of optical OFDM (OOFDM) enables full utilizations of RSOA intensity modulator (RSOA-IM) frequency chirps to significantly enhance system performances. 1GHz-RSOA-IMs can support 40Gb/s@25km OOFDM transmissions in simple IMDD PON systems.

articleTitle: Mitigation of nonlinear distortion in OPC module with backward Raman pumping
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Nonlinear distortion is suppressed in Raman-assisted optical phase conjugation of CO-OFDM signals, resulting in improvement of 10 dB in optimized output power, 1.2 dB in Q factor, and 7 dB in input power dynamic range.

articleTitle: Large scale optical cross-connect: Architecture, performance analysis, and feasibility demonstration
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A cost-effective and scalable photonic node architecture that interconnects small-scale optical cross-connect systems is presented. Its routing performance and technical feasibility are verified through numerical experiments and development of a prototype.

articleTitle: Extreme short wavelength operation (1.65 – 1.7 µm) of silica-based thulium-doped fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first demonstration of silica-based thulium-doped fiber amplifier (TDFA) working in the 1.65 - 1.7 μm waveband. Up to 29 dB small signal gain and noise figure as low as 6.5dB are achieved.

articleTitle: Quantitative evaluation of fiber fuse initiation probability in typical single-mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 5.5W@1480nm five-second-long light irradiation through a SMF-28e+ fiber on a highly Co-doped borosilicate glass surface gave 10% probability of fiber fuse initiation. This method is useful to evaluate relative fiber fuse tolerance for various fibers.

articleTitle: 80 × 200 Gb/s 16-QAM unrepeatered transmission over 321 km with third order Raman amplification
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show 80 × 200 Gb/s transmission over 321 km of low-loss fiber with third order Raman amplification without ROPA. We investigate narrow channel spacing down to 37.5 GHz, targeting a capacity of 21 Tb/s.

articleTitle: 5 × 1-Tb/s PDM-16QAM transmission over 1,920 km using high-speed InP MUX-DAC integrated module
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate WDM transmission of 75-Gbaud PDM-16QAM signals over 1,920 km. InP-based high-speed and compact MUX-DAC integrated modules (bandwidth exceeds 40 GHz) enable the long haul transport of 1-Tb/s superchannels composed of just two subcarriers.

articleTitle: Operational issues in access networks: past, present, and future
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Future network operation will be influenced by business and ownership models and the regulatory environment as future superfast and flexible broadband networks emerge. This paper discusses the issues affecting operators and network operations as network evolution progresses.

articleTitle: Ideal rectangular microwave photonic filter with high selectivity based on stimulated brillouin scattering
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have demonstrated an ideal rectangular microwave photonic filter with flexible tenability on bandwidth, central frequency and selectivity. The 20-dB shape factor is 1.056, which is the best for microwave photonic filters in ∼GHz bandwidth.

articleTitle: Carrier recovery techniques for semiconductor laser frequency noise for 28 Gbd DP-16QAM
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on the first experimental comparison of DD-PLL, two-stage feed forward, and two variations of extended Kalman filtering for tracking semiconductor laser frequency noise. We identify which carrier phase recovery technique works best depending on the carrier induced frequency noise profile.

articleTitle: Low-cost transceiver in single TO-can outline supporting WDM-overlay in filterless PONs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a single-fiber low-cost 1.25 Gb/s transceiver able to switch between transmission and reception mode. Crosstalk suppression with <;1dB penalty is achieved through filtered reception mode for WDM-loaded power-splitting PONs with >20dB optical budget.

articleTitle: Demonstration of CPRI over self-seeded WDM-PON in commercial LTE environment
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: CPRI between BBU and RRU equipment is carried by self-seeded WDM-PON prototype system within commercial LTE end-to-end environment. Delay and jitter meets CPRI requirements while services demonstrated show the same performance as bare fiber.

articleTitle: Energy efficient 850 nm vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers with extremely low driving-current density for >40 Gbit/sec error-free transmissions from RT to 85°C
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 850nm VCSELs with record-low driving-current-density (8kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), small resistance (60Ω), wide-bandwidth (26GHz), and small energy-to-data-rate ratio (228fJ/bit, 3.5mA) for >41Gbit/sec error-free transmission over 100 (2) meter OM4 fiber at room-temperature (85°C) have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: On the cost of protection in optical slot switching rings with elastic transponders
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an optimal network dimensioning model for different configurations of optical slot switching metropolitan rings with elastic-rate transponders. Sharing transponders across the two ring directions along with standard “shared protection” minimizes protection cost.

articleTitle: FSR-free filter based on a coupled microring grating system
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A coupled microring grating system is theoretically and experimentally demonstrated. It can be used as a no free spectral range filter, with an extinction ratio larger than 25dB and a 3dB bandwidth of 0.8nm.

articleTitle: Low noise degenerate FWM of 12×100 Gb/s DP-QPSK signals with counter-dithering of pump and idler waves
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate degenerate four-wave mixing of a 12×100 Gb/s DP-QPSK signal with counter-phase dithering by a phase modulator embedded in a fiber-loop. A ≈9 dB higher conversion efficiency enables an OSNR penalty of 0.7 dB at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> BER.

articleTitle: Field trial of 80-Gb/s PDM-QPSK signal delivery over 300-m wireless distance with MIMO and antenna polarization multiplexing at W-band
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 300-m wireless delivery of 80-Gb/s PDM-QPSK signal at W-band with BER less than 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>, which, to the best of our knowledge, attains the largest bit rate over long transmission distance at W-band up to now.

articleTitle: Extra-solar planets exploration using frequency comb: Infrared Doppler instrument for the Subaru telescope (IRD)
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Because of their large numbers, red dwarfs may be the most abundant planet hosts in our Galaxy. In order to detect Earth-like planets around nearby red dwarfs (in particular late-M stars), it is crucial to conduct the precise radial velocity (RV) measurements at near-infrared wavelengths where these stars emit most of light. We report the development of the Infrared Doppler (IRD) spectrometer for the Subaru telescope. IRD is a fiber-fed, high-precision, near infrared spectrometer with a spectral resolution of R~70,000 covering from 0.97 to 1.75 μm. To achieve 1m/s RV measurement precision, we employ our original laser frequency comb of a wide-wavelength coverage as an extremely stable wavelength standard in the near-infrared. The spectrometer optics is composed of a new wide-pitch Echelle-grating and Volume-Phase Holographic gratings. To achieve ultimate thermal stability, very low thermal expansion ceramic is used for most of the optical components including the optical bench. The spectrometer will utilize a 4096×4096-pixel HgCdTe array.

articleTitle: Silicon IQ modulator based 480km 80×453.2Gb/s PDM-eOFDM transmission on 50GHz grid with SSMF and EDFA-only link
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report 480km transmission of C-band 80×453.2Gb/s PDM-eOFDM hybrid 8-64QAM DWDM signals over G.652 fiber and EDFA-only link at 9b/s/Hz spectral efficiency based on silicon IQ modulator and 84.48G sample/s DAC.

articleTitle: A multi-stage perturbation technique for intra-channel nonlinearity compensation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using a multi-stage perturbation technique to compensate intra-channel nonlinearities, the computational complexity is reduced by a factor up to 9.3 and the Q-factor improvement over linear compensation is increased from 1.7 dBQ to 2.7 dBQ.

articleTitle: Linearity requirements of QAM transmitters
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 16, 64QAM, and higher-modulation formats impose strict linearity requirements on the modulator-driver response. We experimentally demonstrate the relation between transmitter nonlinearity and OSNR penalty. Simulations confirm experimental data for a wide range of harmonic distortion.

articleTitle: Holmium-doped fiber amplifier for optical communications at 2.05 – 2.13 µm
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the realization of a wideband holmium doped fiber amplifier designed for optical communications over 2050 – 2130 nm, providing up to 28 dB small signal gain and 4 – 9.5 dB noise figure.

articleTitle: High-speed quantum communications in telecom fibers using overlapping temporal modes
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We analyze an efficient quantum-communications architecture over telecom fibers using overlapping time-frequency modes and optimal receivers based on nonlinear processing.

articleTitle: Fast polarization-state tracking based on radius-directed linear Kalman filter
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a blind polarization tracking scheme based on radius-directed linear Kalman filter. It has the advantages of fast convergence and is inherently insensitive to phase noise and frequency offset effects.

articleTitle: Measuring flexibility and design trade-offs of N × M SSS-based ROADMs and BVTs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We quantitatively measure and evaluate the flexibility of key optical devices of ROADMs considering maximum system entropy. We analyze the dependency and trade-offs between flexibility, connectivity, capacity, granularity and spectral efficiency, key design performance indicators.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of compact 16 channels-50 GHz Si3N4 arrayed waveguide grating
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 16 channel-50 GHz arrayed waveguide gratings (AWG) on Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> for DWDM applications. The device achieves 1.8 dB loss, -20 dB crosstalk, phase errors below ± π/10 on a 3.7×0.7 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> footprint.

articleTitle: Wavelength-preserving temporal phase conjugation based on intensity-only detection and modulation devices
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel temporal optical phase conjugator based on intensity-only devices is presented. As proof-of-concept, wavelength-preserving conjugation of arbitrarily-chirped pulses and a 16-QAM signal is demonstrated using a photodetector and Mach-Zehnder modulator, avoiding all electronic-domain processing.

articleTitle: Intra-cavity dispersion-induced performance degradations of dual-RSOA-based self-seeded PON systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Experiments show that, compared to 10m-long dual-RSOA self-seeded cavities, 1km-long cavity's chromatic dispersions considerably broaden signal spectral widths, increase RINs by 4.8dB, and cause 2.2dB power penalty degradations for 10Gb/s@25km adaptive OOFDM self-seeded PON systems.

articleTitle: AlGaAs-on-insulator nanowire with 750 nm FWM bandwidth, −9 dB CW conversion efficiency, and ultrafast operation enabling record Tbaud wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an AlGaAs-on-insulator platform for integrated nonlinear photonics. We demonstrate the highest reported conversion efficiency/length/pump-power, ultra-broadband four-wave mixing, and first-ever wavelength conversion of 1.28-Tbaud serial data signals in a 3-mm long dispersion-engineered AlGaAs nano-waveguide.

articleTitle: Design of orbital angular momentum (OAM) Erbium doped fiber amplifier with low differential modal gain
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a design of orbital angular momentum (OAM) Erbium doped fiber amplifier (OAM-EDFA) supporting 22 modes with 18 OAM ones. Numerical simulation suggests that differential modal gain (DMG) of the optimum design is lower than 0.28 dB with mode-dependent gain (MDG) over 20 dB at C-band.

articleTitle: Technologies for a cost effective UDWDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A new ultra-dense WDM-PON with coherent techniques and low cost devices is developed for an efficient utilization of the optical spectrum, showing that the “Wavelength-to-the-User” concept can be feasible with 6.25 GHz channel spacing in a splitter-based PON.

articleTitle: Data center service localization based on virtual resource migration in software defined elastic optical network
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a data center service localization architecture based on virtual resource migration in software defined elastic optical network. The overall feasibility and efficiency of the proposed architecture are experimentally verified on our testbed.

articleTitle: A four-port polarization diversity coupler for vertical fiber-chip coupling
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and fabricate a novel four-port polarization diversity coupler for vertical coupling. With the help of 45° reflectors and improved 2×1 couplers, an ultralow coupling loss of −4.8dB is experimentally measured with polarization insensitivity.

articleTitle: 850–950nm wideband OM4 multimode fiber for next-generation WDM systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A wideband OM4 multimode fiber for 850-950nm operation was fabricated by optimizing the Alpha value of the index profile. Bandwidth, differential-mode-delay, bit-error-rate measurements are presented. This wideband fiber offers OM4 performance over the 850-950nm window.

articleTitle: Multiple microwave frequencies measurement using stimulated Brillouin scattering with improved measurement precision
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A photonic scheme to realize multiple microwave frequencies measurement using SBS is proposed. By coarsely/precisely determine the frequency band/frequency, two frequencies measurement with improved precision of < 1MHz is experimentally achieved.

articleTitle: Can Discrete Multi-Tone reduce the cost for short reach systems?
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Digital Signal processing is going on spreading from long reach systems to short reach systems like inter-/intra-data center systems. The cost requirements for short reach systems are more stringent than requirements for long reach systems. And digital signal processing is attractive for cost reduction of optical and electrical components. In this paper, digital signal processing, especially Discrete Multi-Tone, are discussed from the viewpoint of cost reduction.

articleTitle: Dispersion pre-compensation for PAM transmission system using 1-sample/symbol DAC and IQ modulator
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a systematic scheme for flexible dispersion pre-compensation using 1-sample/symbol digital-to-analog converter and IQ modulator for PAM transmission system. Transmission of dispersion-pre-compensated 12-Gbaud 4-PAM signal over SSMF links up to 120km is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Large-port-count MEMS silicon photonics switches
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Highly integrated optical circuit switch (OCS) with large port counts (~100×100) is achievable by combining silicon photonics and MEMS technologies. We will review the design trade-offs, performance scaling, and the current state of the art.

articleTitle: SDN multi-layer transport benefits, deployment opportunities, and requirements
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: IP+WDM transport benefits significantly from advancements in SDN automation, and traffic-engineering central-control optimization, potentially >30%. We discuss adoption opportunities in planning/engineering and operations/maintenance, trade-offs, and requirements for multi-phased evolution to a programmable multi-layer SDN architecture.

articleTitle: InP photonic integrated circuits for high efficiency pluggable optical interfaces
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: InP PIC integration platforms enable high efficiency pluggable transceivers. Design and performance of widely tunable and fixed wavelength PICs with electro-absorption and Mach-Zehnder modulators for 100 Gb/s datacom and telecom applications will be reviewed.

articleTitle: High-performance Si photonics interposer featuring RF travelling-wave electrode (TWE) via Cu-BEOL
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A silicon Cu-photonics interposer, consisting of monolithically integrated Si modulators and Ge photodetectors, has been explored for integrated optical communication. Up to 33.7 GHz-bandwidth of this integrated circuit are enabled by travelling-wave electrode via Cu-BEOL.

articleTitle: Cost benefits of asymmetric IP-over-DWDM networks with elastic transceivers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Asymmetric bidirectional routing based on IP-over-WDM architectures, leveraging elastic optoelectronic devices, is proposed for more cost-efficient optical networks. This new routing paradigm saves up to 25% overall (add/drop and regeneration) optoelectronic devices.

articleTitle: Delay spread in strongly coupled multi-core fibers for SDM transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: It is well known that the mean square delay spread in strongly coupled multi-core fibers increases linearly with the propagation distance. In this paper we quantify for the first time the coefficient of this linear growth and characterize its dependence on the main fiber parameters. Our analysis shows that the root-mean mean delay spread reduces with the fluctuations of the coupling coefficient between cores, while it increases with the correlation length of these fluctuations and with the beat length of the two polarizations of each core.

articleTitle: High-speed long-wavelength VCSELs for energy-efficient 40 Gbps links up to 1 km without error correction
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A high-speed VCSEL is characterized and directly modulated up to 40Gbps with power consumption ~14mW. BER performance exhibits error-free operation(<;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>) up to 1km of SMF with 1.6dB of penalty without optical amplification.

articleTitle: C-band mode-selective couplers fabricated by the femtosecond laser direct-write technique
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Asymmetric mode-selective couplers for multiplexing the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> modes of an optical fiber fabricated by the femtosecond laser direct-write technique are demonstrated. The devices feature high coupling ratios, excellent mode extinction ratios and low insertion losses.

articleTitle: High-splitting-ratio WDM/TDM-PONs using automatic gain controlled SOAs designed for central office use
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Our AGC-SOAs implement a modified gain control scheme that effectively increases splitting ratio even if they are located in central office; they provide network operators with significant benefits from the viewpoint of CAPEX and OPEX.

articleTitle: 50 Gb/s 4-PAM over 200 m of high bandwidth MMF using a 850 nm VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Transmission of 50 Gb/s over 200 m of dispersion compensated MMF using 4-PAM and directly modulated VCSELs is presented.

articleTitle: Fragmentation-aware spectrum assignment for elastic optical networks with fully-distributed GMPLS
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper proposes two types of fragmentation aware spectrum assignment for fully-distributed GMPLS framework. The cut-avoidance approach achieves lower blocking probability and the block-assign approach improves performance more when requested slot sizes are known.

articleTitle: Impact of grooming architecture of transport nodes in line interface count for multi-period planning
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We analyze the impact of the node architecture flexibility in the number of line interfaces required, for multi-period planning with and without traffic churn. The line interface savings from enforcing hitless traffic re-grooming are highlighted.

articleTitle: Fixed and Mobile Convergence: Which role for optical networks?
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Fixed and Mobile Convergence (FMC) is a key stake for operators in the perspective of 5G networks. This paper analyzes the expected role of optical networks for convergence and integration of fixed and mobile infrastructures.

articleTitle: First demonstration of wavelength translation for 1.376-Tbit/s DP-QPSK Nyquist OTDM signal
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Seamless wavelength translation of a single-carrier 1.376-Tbit/s DP-QPSK Nyquist OTDM signal over ∼30nm range is successfully demonstrated. Polarization-insensitive coherent detection using linear sampling is employed to demodulate dual-polarization Nyquist-OTDM signal for the first time.

articleTitle: Compact InP-based optical modulator for 100-Gb/s coherent pluggable transceivers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: InP-based MZ modulators are suitable for realizing coherent pluggable transceivers. They offer compact size, low driving voltage and high performance. Targeting lower power consumption, we employed a reduced driving voltage and an athermal twin-IQ modulator.

articleTitle: Equipartition multiplexing technique for equalizing channel dependent degradation in MDM transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We employ a novel equipartition multiplexing technique in mode-division-multiplexed transmission for equalizing channel dependent impairment induced by mode dependent loss and modal crosstalk, and successfully achieve 2-LP mode-multiplexed transmission with a low signal quality difference.

articleTitle: Techno-economic comparison of Silicon Photonics and multimode VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We compare Silicon Photonics and multi-mode short wavelength VCSEL technologies for various optical interconnect applications using addressable volume, relative cost, transmission reach, power consumption, and bandwidth-density as metrics.

articleTitle: Complexity reduction of perturbation-based nonlinear compensator by sub-band processing
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and numerically evaluate a novel sub-band processing architecture for computational complexity reduction of the perturbation-based nonlinear compensator. The complexity is reduced by a factor of 12.4 in 3000-km transmission with 0.1 dB penalty.

articleTitle: Modal dispersion properties of few-mode spun fibers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The effects of spin on the modal properties of few mode fibers are numerically investigated showing that, at least in the cases considered here, the spin may even increase modal dispersion rather than decreasing it.

articleTitle: Parallel split-step method for digital backpropagation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel split-step method for digital backpropagation in which the linear and nonlinear steps are applied in parallel, favouring hardware implementation. Numerical results show significant performance advantage over the classic split-step Fourier method.

articleTitle: Spatially-coupled LDPC protograph codes for universal phase slip-tolerant differential decoding
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show how a single spatially coupled LDPC code constructed from an optimized protograph with optimized windowed decoding outperforms different conventional LDPC codes in iterative differential decoding with significantly lower error floors and identical complexity.

articleTitle: Ultra-fast tunable true-time delay using complementary phase-shifted spectra (CPSS)
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce an ultra-fast, continuously tunable true-time delay, featuring settling times of tens of picoseconds. Our solution operates for large bandwidth signals, has a low complexity, low losses, and can be fully integrated.

articleTitle: Phase-sensitive optical processing in silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Parametric optical signal processing is reviewed for silicon nano-rib-waveguides with a reverse-biased pin-junction. Phase-sensitive parametric amplification with a phase-sensitive extinction of more than 20 dB has been utilized for the regeneration of DPSK signals.

articleTitle: Flexible polymer optical waveguide for Si photonics interface
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We realize a technology of single-mode polymer optical waveguide with precise alignment structures suitable for silicon photonic component assembly. The propagation loss is 0.5 dB/cm at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: OFDM for optical access
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: optical OFDM; optical access networks; optical communications; DSP based OFDM; OFDMA; optical modulation; and optical detection.

articleTitle: 64 GBd operation of a silicon-organic hybrid modulator at elevated temperature
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show 64 GBd 4ASK signaling with a silicon-organic hybrid Mach-Zehnder modulator, allowing data rates of up to 128 Gbit/s. The device is operated at room temperature and at 80 °C.

articleTitle: Demystification of self-seeded WDM access
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The operating principles of a self-seeded cavity are explained, and its main characteristics are described. Some practical implementation cases are also discussed.

articleTitle: Quantum secured Gigabit Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report transmission of a quantum signal alongside conventional Gigabit Passive Optical Network traffic in the same optical distribution network. Encryption keys generated from quantum signals enable provable secure communication in optical access networks.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an 11km hollow core photonic bandgap fiber for broadband low-latency data transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the fabrication of a record 11km length of photonic bandgap fiber supporting >200nm bandwidth with longitudinally uniform loss of ≈5dB/km at 1560nm and demonstrate error-free, low-latency, direct-detection 10Gbit/s transmission across the entire C-Band.

articleTitle: Symbol-by-symbol joint polarization and phase tracking in coherent receivers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An analytical model to describe the combined drift of the state of polarization and absolute phase is presented. To compensate for this drift, a novel, modulation format independent algorithm is proposed, which outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms.

articleTitle: Rate equation-based phase recovery for semiconductor laser coherent transmitters
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel carrier recovery technique for coherent systems with semiconductor lasers that incorporates the laser dynamics. A sensitivity improvement of 8dB over a decision-directed phase-locked loop is achieved experimentally for 28GBd DP-16QAM.

articleTitle: HPC networks: Challenges and the role of optics
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
