abstract: Cost, rather than power, poses the main challenge for exascale HPC interconnection networks. To deliver byte-per-FLOP ratios on par with today's petaflop-scale systems, price-performance of active optical links must improve by two orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Simple and efficient algorithm for polarization tracking and demultiplexing in dual-polarization IM/DD systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a simple and efficient DSP algorithm, which enables to demodulate dual-polarization PAM signals in direct-detection receivers. Simulation results show that the power penalty stemming from digital polarization tracking and demultiplexing is negligibly small.

articleTitle: Electrically-tunable fiber-optics pulse repetition-rate multiplier
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel, simple and all-fiber method for repetition-rate multiplication of picosecond optical pulse trains based on temporal self-imaging, involving temporal phase modulation and dispersion, with an electrically reconfigurable repetition-rate multiplication factor.

articleTitle: A comparison study of joint and sequential multi-layer planning for IP over flexible optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a joint multi-layer planning algorithm for IP over flexible optical networks, and use it, to compare the performance of joint as opposed to sequential multi-layer network planning in terms of spectrum and cost.

articleTitle: Agile network re-optimization supporting seamless service migration
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate novel re-optimization design techniques for realizing agile and seamless service migration with minimum connection disruptions. We also show the effectiveness of our integer linear programming based approach through network simulations.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of the 8-state Trellis-coded 4D-QPSK optical modulation format
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally evaluate the bit-error-rate (BER) performance of the 8-state Trellis-coded 4D-QPSK format that we proposed previously. At BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, 4-dB receiver-sensitivity improvement against DP-QPSK is obtained with a simple encoder structure.

articleTitle: Degree-expandable colorless, directionless, and contentionless ROADM without drop-side EDFAs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: By using an N×M multicast switch, where N is expandable from 4 to ≥16, and M is 16, we experimentally demonstrate that in a metro optical network with OSNR ≥17dB, the sensitivity of an intradyne coherent receiver can reach <; -34dBm for 28Gbaud DP-QPSK signals, thereby enabling a CDC ROADM with on drop-side EDFAs.

articleTitle: Practical techniques for nonlinear compensation and mitigation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Challenges of circuit resource reduction in digital back propagation toward practical implementation is demonstrated. A linear filter circuit resource is effectively reduced using frequency domain processing and filter coefficient optimization for lOOGbps and beyond.

articleTitle: An ultimately fast frequency-scanning Brillouin Optical Time Domain Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A polarization-independent fast frequency-scanning Brillouin optical time-domain analysis technique is presented, capable of acquiring the full Brillouin gain spectrum at a speed limited only by the fiber length and the employed frequency scanning granularity.

articleTitle: Rapid data evacuation for large-scale disasters in optical cloud networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In case of large-scale disasters, cloud networks may be vulnerable to data loss. We propose a rapid data-evacuation strategy to move maximum amount of data from disaster regions using survived resources under strict time constraints.

articleTitle: Experimental end-to-end demonstration of shared N:1 dual homed protection in long reach PON and SDN-controlled core
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate fast restoration of PON services with a dual-homed, shared-OLT protection mechanism. Using the SDN-controlled pan-European GEANT core network, we demonstrate PON protection and end-to-end service restoration times within 40ms and 155ms respectively.

articleTitle: Single-mode 24-fiber connector with GI fiber lens array
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A Single-mode 24-fiber connector with GI fiber-lenses is developed. The lenses make it possible to adopt MT-connector based guide-pin-alignment. Insertion loss of 0.54dB on average and loss variation less than 0.08dB under temperature cycling is achieved.

articleTitle: Optimal polarization launch for Raman depletion minimization in GPON and TWDM-PON coexistence
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: TWDM-PON (ITU-T G.989) will induce relevant extra-attenuation when operating in full coexistence with GPON due to Raman nonlinearity. We give a detailed analysis of optimal polarization launch options.

articleTitle: Analysis of forward error correction in the upstream channel of 10Gb/s optically amplified TDM-PONs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate the performance of forward error correction operated in burst-mode using a burst-mode receiver. We show reduced error correction capability due to transients from the burst-mode receiver at the start of each burst.

articleTitle: 6.27 bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency VCSEL-based coherent communication over 800km of SMF
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 125.5Gbps dual-polarization QPSK coherent transmission with sub-Nyquist 6.27bit/s/Hz-spectral efficiency is demonstrated in regional flex-grid WDM scenario up to 800km of SMF. Two commercial VCSELs are used at the transmitter and as local oscillator respectively.

articleTitle: A fully integrated DQPSK receiver based on compact silicon-on-insulator micro-rings
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra compact integrated Silicon receiver for DQPSK signals based on two tunable SOI microring resonators and four Germanium photodetectors. The device operation was characterized on a range extending from 7.5 to over 15 Gbaud.

articleTitle: Investigation of CAZAC sequences for data-aided channel estimation considering nonlinear optical transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate CAZAC sequences with positive and negative chirp for the use as training sequences in data-aided channel estimation. While both sequences show the same linear performance, the right choice of chirp is critical in case of nonlinear transmission. A performance difference of up to 2 dBQ was experimentally verified.

articleTitle: Fully photonics-based radar demonstrator: Concept and field trials
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This work shows the concept, performance, and field-trials of the first photonics-based radar. The comparative in-field experiments in aerial and naval scenarios against a state-of-the-art commercial system show the photonics potentials in enabling software-defined radars.

articleTitle: 20-Gb/s operation of RSOA using polar return-to-zero 4-PAM modulation format and direct detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the upstream transmission of 20-Gb/s polar RZ 4-PAM signal over 20 km of loopback SSMF link by using a directly-modulated RSOA and a direct-detection receiver.

articleTitle: Optimization of client-to-line-side switching in DWDM networks using sliceable bandwidth-variable transponders
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We evaluate the impact of electrical switching capacity on the cost-efficiency of SBVT-enabled backbone networks through a novel grooming and equipment provisioning algorithm. The results stress how the switch design is critical in balancing client-card and switch matrix costs.

articleTitle: Broadband coherent-optical add/drop multiplexing over 400-GHz bandwidth by fiber frequency conversion
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate coherent-optical subcarrier processing by fiber frequency conversion using an optical comb based beat signal to implement a broadband coherent add/drop architecture. Erasure and replacement of subcarriers over 400-GHz processing bandwidth is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Utilization of spectrum slot fragmentation to improve network resource efficiency on elastic optical network
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel utilization technique of spectrum slot fragmentation is proposed for elastic optical network. By network simulation, we have confirmed the advantage of our technique and its performance improvement becomes larger for optical nodes without wavelength contention.

articleTitle: 8 × 24 wavelength selective switch for low-loss transponder aggregator
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an optimal variant of an M × N wavelength selective switch (WSS) for a transponder aggregator. A PLC frontend enables us to integrate an M array of 1 × N WSSs and port selection switches in simple optics. A high-port count (8 × 24) prototype is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental validation of MTU-BRAS connectivity with DMT transmission and coherent detection in flexgrid metro networks using sliceable transceivers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Simple and cost-effective DMT transmission in combination with shared coherent detection is proposed for evolutionary flexgrid metro/regional networks. Network testbed experiments show successful 10Gb/s connections from MTUs to the sliceable transceiver at the virtual BRAS farm, covering up to 150km.

articleTitle: Flexible node architectures for metro networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the optical transport requirements of future Metro nodes using the traffic forecasts available today. In a large metro network with 8 million users, flexgrid ROADM nodes can support the 2018 estimated traffic.

articleTitle: Photonic implementation of a neuronal learning algorithm based on spike timing dependent plasticity
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A photonic system exemplifying the biological neural process of spike timing dependent plasticity (STDP) is experimentally demonstrated using nonlinear polarization rotation. STDP represents the neuronal responses for learning based on input/output timing, order, and sequence.

articleTitle: Stimulated Raman scattering impairments induced by NGPON2 introduction in co-existing PONs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate on NGPON2 introduction effects in a coexisting PON topology. Simple optical power measurements permit to demonstrate that stimulated Raman scattering brings up to 3.9dB extra-losses on GPON. No other significant impairments were observed.

articleTitle: Minimal virtualized-elastic-regenerator placement and least congestion resources assignment for translucent elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A virtualized-elastic-regenerator (VER) is a promising solution for efficiently regenerating various superchannels in elastic optical networks. We propose an effective heuristic for calculating minimal VER placement, routing, and least congestion resources assignment.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated directly modulated DFB laser array with MMI coupler for 100GBASE-LR4 application
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed the first 1.3-µm, 4×25-Gbit/s directly modulated DFB laser array monolithically integrated with an MMI coupler suitable for 100GBASE-LR4 application. Error-free operation was achieved for a 30-km SMF transmission when modulating four DMLs simultaneously.

articleTitle: Silicon quadruple series-coupled Vernier racetrack resonators: Experimental signal quality
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A tunable silicon quadruple Vernier racetrack resonator filter has been experimentally demonstrated. Data was sent through our filter at 12.5 Gbps which resulted in open eye diagrams, even at a suppressed through port notch.

articleTitle: SDN dual-optimization application for EDFAs and WSS-based ROADMs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel SDN dual-optimization application based on EDFA adaptive gain control and WSS-based spectrum equalization is proposed. OSNR 5.7 dB gains for 80 DWDM 128-Gb/s channels are experimentally demonstrated in our metropolitan optical network test-bed.

articleTitle: Dual-carrier 400G field trial submarine transmission over 6,577-km using 60-GBaud digital faster-than-Nyquist shaping PDM-QPSK modulation format
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate successful field trial dual-carrier 400G undersea transmission using 60-GBaud PDM-QPSK modulation format based on digital faster-than-Nyquist shaping on the transmitter side DSP jointed with receiver SOFTN and 20% SD-FEC decoding.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of overshoot suppression for cascaded WSS-based ROADMs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Cascaded WSS-based ROADMs using conventional controllers may amplify optical power fluctuations leading to undesired overshoots. We propose and experimentally demonstrate an optical channel power controller and a technique to suppress overshoots.

articleTitle: Capability of high optical-feedback tolerance and non-hermetic-packaging for low-cost interconnections using lens-integrated surface-emitting laser
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Low-cost optical assemblies for optical interconnections using lens-integrated surface-emitting laser are proposed. High coupling efficiency with single-mode-fibers of over −1.9dB and RIN below −140dB/Hz with large back reflection and 85°C/85% storage test are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Advances in multimode fiber transmission for the data center
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recent advances in VCSEL manufacturing and designed multimode fibers has opened an avenue to implement WDM for short distance links. This paper will focus on transmission performance of a new multimode fiber coupled with high speed VCSELs operating in a range of wavelengths from 850-980nm to deliver parallel transmission on a single fiber.

articleTitle: Field reliability of silica-based PLC splitter for FTTH
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Silica-based planar lightwave circuits (PLCs) are widely used as the key components in fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) systems because of their various advantages. This paper reviews the reliability of the PLC-type 8-branch optical splitter for outdoor plant.

articleTitle: Zero-bias operational ultra-broadband UTC-PD above 110 GHz for high symbol rate PD-array in high-density photonic integration
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have successfully developed a zero-bias operational ultra-broadband uni-traveling-carrier photodiode (UTC-PD) with a frequency bandwidth above 110 GHz using a low carrier concentration of 3 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> in the carrier collection layer.

articleTitle: Beyond 25 Gbit/s directly modulated, directly detected OFDM using channel flattening by a Fabry-Perot filter
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the joint use of OFDM and channel flattening effect provided by a Fabry-Perot filter to allow higher than 25 Gbit/s direct intensity modulated, directly detected transmission over up to 75 km SSMF.

articleTitle: Hitless monitoring of wavelength and mode-division multiplexed channels on a silicon photonic chip
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: On-chip non-invasive monitoring of WDM-MDM channels transmitted through silicon-photonic waveguides is achieved with a ContactLess Integrated Photonic Probe (CLIPP). Simultaneous monitoring of four intensity-modulated 10 Gbit/s channels is demonstrated with no penalty on system performance.

articleTitle: Silicon-organic hybrid (SOH) and plasmonic-organic hybrid (POH) integration
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Silicon-organic hybrid (SOH) and plasmonic-organic hybrid (POH) integration combines organic electro-optic materials with silicon photonic and plasmonic waveguides. The concept enables fast and power-efficient modulators that support advanced modulation formats such as QPSK and 16QAM.

articleTitle: WAN virtualization and dynamic end-to-end bandwidth provisioning using SDN
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We evaluate a WAN-virtualization framework in terms of delay and scalability and demonstrate that adding a virtual layer between the physical topology and the end-user brings significant advantages and tolerable delays.

articleTitle: An adjustable self-equalizing photo detector
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An optically-wideband adjustable self-equalizing photo-detector (ASEPD), capable of reviving eye closure due to limited bandwidth of electro-optical components in an optical link, is presented. The ASEPD enables use of various slower electro-optical components in faster data links.

articleTitle: Single-VCSEL 100-Gb/s short-reach system using discrete multi-tone modulation and direct detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an up to 115-Gb/s line-rate short-reach system using a single 1550-nm VCSEL with discrete multi-tone modulation and direct detection, which can cover 500-m to 4-km standard-single-mode fiber at 95-Gb/s to 105-Gb/s bit rates.

articleTitle: Dual-illuminated parallel-fed traveling wave germanium photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report 4-stage dual-illuminated Ge traveling wave photodetectors (TWPDs). Dual-illumination doubles the optical channels and boosts DC and RF power handling, resulting in a record figure-of-merit of an RF power-bandwidth area density of 0.66 mW-GHz/μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 500Gbit/s short reach transmission employing PAM4 signal and direct detection with 25Gbps device
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, we experimentally demonstrate single channel 128Gbit/s and four lanes transmission with a total capacity of 500Gbit/s for short reach applications employing PAM4 format and direct detection with commercial 25Gbps devices.

articleTitle: Versatile coherent in-line 4-, 16-, 32-QAM subcarrier add/drop-multiplexing by optical frequency conversion
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate the modulation format scalability & agility of a coherent add/drop node. Extinction of 25 dB yields OSNR penalties up to 1.1-dB for 3.2-GBd intra-format subcarrier add/drop up to 32QAM and 0.8-dB for inter-format 4QAM-by-16QAM add/drop.

articleTitle: Application drivers and trends for future broadband access
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We address the future access service and system requirements in Japan. We must ensure that sufficient bandwidth is available for future mobile and IP-TV services. We propose an optical access platform to meet these different requirements.

articleTitle: Low loss and low nonlinearity fibers for long haul transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review advance of pure-silica-core fiber with ultra-low loss of 0.15dB/km and large Aeff of 130μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. This fiber is applicable for C+L-band broadband transmission in submarine ultra-long links, exhibiting sufficiently low macro- and micro-bending losses.

articleTitle: Design of constant modulus modulation considering envelopes
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a method of designing modulation schemes for increasing Euclidean distance while minimizing power fluctuations during transitions. Simulations show that this has 0.8 ∼ 1.0 dB higher loss budget than DP-BPSK and 4D Simplex modulation over 6,000 km links.

articleTitle: Dynamic parametric dispersion compensation using FPGA pump controller and dispersion monitor
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an autonomous fast parametric dispersion compensator with a fast TDA-CSG-DR laser and a dispersion monitor based on spectral shearing interferometer. A response time of less than 17 ms, potentially sub millisecond, is achieved.

articleTitle: Scalable service provisioning in converged optical/wireless clouds using compression techniques
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: To support scalable service provisioning in converged optical/wireless clouds we adopt for the first time compressive sensing (CS) techniques. CS achieves optimal service provisioning with significantly reduced control and management information and computational complexity.

articleTitle: Generation of ultra-dense superchannels using frequency conversion in optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A concept for distributed ultra-dense frequency-division multiplexing is presented which enables precise frequency allocation without the need of absolute optical frequency control at the multiplexing nodes. We review experiments with OFDM and zero-guard-band Nyquist-WDM to demonstrate the precise generation of superchannels.

articleTitle: PDL-tolerant signal generation by digital spectrum slicing and polarization control
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel PDL-tolerant signal generation and reception method without additional optical devices and numerically demonstrate its efficiency for a 128 Gbit/s 2 subcarrier Nyquist-FDM DP-QPSK signal.

articleTitle: Direct-detection receiver for PDM signals
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel direct-detection receiver for polarization-multiplexed signal. For a demonstration, the proposed receiver is used for the detection of 20-Gb/s PDM-OOK signal while the polarizations of these signals are scrambled at 3 Mrad/s.

articleTitle: Demonstration of bandwidth-efficient mobile fronthaul enabling seamless aggregation of 36 E-UTRA-like wireless signals in a single 1.1-GHz wavelength channel
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a bandwidth-efficient mobile fronthaul system, where 36 E-UTRA-like wireless signals, six for each standardized bandwidth, 1.4/3/5/10/15/20 MHz, are aggregated in a single wavelength channel, achieving >30 dB loss budget for a 20-km SSMF link.

articleTitle: Multidirectional routing in wavelength selective switches
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel configuration of bidirectionally-utilized WSSs, which enables routing of wavelengths between tributary ports. The proposed configuration enables realization of OXCs and ROADMs with fewer numbers of WSSs than would conventionally be required.

articleTitle: Bidirectional coherent WDM-PON performance with real-time Nyquist 16QAM transmitter
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper experimentally investigates the nonlinear performance and backscattering tolerance for a full-duplex bidirectional coherent WDM-PON with real-time Nyquist 16QAM transmitter. With 2×8×10 Gb/s over 50 km, the performance is evaluated for various pulse roll-off factors.

articleTitle: Orchestrating virtual machine migrations in telecom clouds
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A throughput model is experimentally assessed and then used to compare non-orchestrated against orchestration when multiple VMs are migrated among datacenters in a telecom cloud. Numerical results show migration time reductions as high as 71%.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of transverse mode correlation and MPN using 900nm VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Cross-correlations between VCSEL transverse modes are measured using 40GSps synchronous observations of spatially separated modes. Positive correlation and anti-correlation behaviors are observed as well as low, distinct k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">mpn</sub>, contrary to assumptions of the IEEE model.

articleTitle: Progress in photonic sampled analog-to-digital conversion
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recent advances in photonic sampled analog-to-digital conversion of wideband signals are reviewed in context of the parametric polychromatic sampling and cavity-less pulse source driven subsampling. Latest results and a new figure of merit are presented.

articleTitle: Fiber nonlinearity compensation: Practical use cases and complexity analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review the applications of fiber nonlinearity compensation (NLC) in homogeneous and heterogeneous networks, (non)dispersion-managed links, and terabit transmission systems. Practically viable intra-channel NLC is shown to allow ~3.7dB gains, well beyond conventionally acknowledged bounds.

articleTitle: Novel optical access network virtualization and dynamic resource allocation algorithms for the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Novel optical access network virtualization and resource allocation algorithms for Internet-of-Things support are proposed and implemented on a real-time SDN-controller platform. 30-50% gains in served request number, traffic prioritization, and revenue are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Compact programmable monolithically integrated 10-stage multi-channel WDM dispersion equalizer on low-loss silicon nitride planar waveguide platform
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable dispersion equalizer on a low loss Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> planar waveguide platform. The equalizer has a tuning range of ±550 ps/nm, a footprint of 222.5 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and can compensate multiple WDM channels simultaneously.

articleTitle: Polarization insensitive variable optical attenuator based on field induced waveguides with a liquid crystal core
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A VOA based on field induced waveguides with isotropic liquid crystal core is fabricated on silicon backplane. Low loss and 0.1 dB PDL is ensured for 0-20 dB attenuation range by a special electrode design.

articleTitle: Bidirectional transmission of LTE-A carrier aggregation signal over a seamless fiber-wireless system in W-band
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a high-speed and low-latency seamless fiber-millimeter-wave system for future mobile front-haul networks. The bidirectional transmission of a downlink interband and an uplink intraband carrier aggregation LTE-A signal over the system is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Proactive Hierarchical PCE based on BGP-LS for Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Hierarchical PCE architecture is considered in multi-domain EONs. A novel scheme is proposed to proactively update the parent PCE using BGP-LS. Simulations show that the proposed scheme reduces blocking probability and parent PCE control load.

articleTitle: Controlling fiber geometry to improve optical performance of low-cost 12-fiber MTP connectors
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study the effect of fiber tip shape and height distribution on fiber physical contact in the MTP connector. We identify a new polishing process that results in <0.17dB of mean insertion loss per fiber.

articleTitle: 400-Gbit/s free-space optical communications link over 120-meter using multiplexing of 4 collocated orbital-angular-momentum beams
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 400-Gbit/s free-space optical communications link over 120 meters on the building roof by multiplexing four orbital angular momentum (OAM) modes (OAM l = ±1, ±3) each carrying a 100-Gbit/s data channel.

articleTitle: AMO-FBMC for reduction of multiple access interference between asynchronous ONUs in PON
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: OFDM has interference problem due to sidelobes, which hinders OFDM-based multiple access in optical uplink. By employing filter bank-based multicarrier (FBMC), we experimentally verified relaxation of multiple access interference and improvements of performance and capacity.

articleTitle: Power efficient implementation of SDFEC and DSP for optical transceivers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: SDFEC; DSP; optical transceivers; FEC; forward error correction; Shannon limit; channel capacity; optical fiber communications; coding gain; decoded BER; burst error correction; higher order modulations and RTL design.

articleTitle: 1λ,6 bits/symbol, 280 and 350 Gb/s direct detection transceiver using intensity modulation, polarization multiplexing, and inter-polarization phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 1λ, 6 bits/symbol, 280 and 350 Gb/s throughput with direct detection of polarization multiplexed PAM-4 intensity modulation and inter-polarization phase modulation over 4 phases at BERs of 2.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> (<;HD-FEC) and 1.6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> (<;SD-FEC), respectively.

articleTitle: Power-efficient coherent supercontinuum generation by two-color pulses pumping in a highly nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A coherent supercontinuum generator based on coherent two-color pulses pumping in a highly nonlinear fiber is proposed. Supercontinuum with a 20-dB width of 150 nm is achieved at a modest pump power of 24 dBm.

articleTitle: Real-time spectral dynamics of femtosecond solitons under free-carrier nonlinearity in silicon photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate real-time single-shot dynamics of soliton spectral broadening and Cerenkov radiation predominately induced by slow-light enhanced free-carrier nonlinearity in silicon photonic crystals. Ultra-stable free-carrier dispersion based continuum generation is identified for the first time.

articleTitle: Programmable hardware for high performance SDN
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: There is a significant speed mismatch between optical transmission and the current data center. The Field Programmable Gate Array offers a flexible bridge between emergent photonic technologies and next-generation data center servers, via programmable hardware.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Radio-over-Fiber networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper discusses reconfigurable Radio-over-Fiber networks, including activities in coherent remote access units, silicon photonics for microwave photonics and optical switching.

articleTitle: Scheme for optical network recovery schedule to restore virtual networks after a disaster
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Virtual networks mapped over a physical network can suffer from network disconnection due to disasters. We propose an integer linear programming model to restore physical links with maximizing connectivity of virtual networks.

articleTitle: 150 × 120 Gb/s transmission over 3,780 km of G.652 fiber using all-distributed Raman amplification
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Commercial all-distributed Raman system is demonstrated to support real-time error-free transmission of 150 channels × 120 Gb/s at 50 GHz channel spacing over 3,780 km of G.652 fiber with backward Raman pumping.

articleTitle: Field demonstration of up to 3Tb/s real-time superchannel transport over 359km using a fully managed flexible grid infrastructure with net spectral efficiency of 5.97bit/s/Hz
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first successful field trial of up to 3Tb/s real-time DP-16QAM superchannel over 359km EDFA-amplified, fully managed flexible grid infrastructure using production grade hardware and software, achieving net spectral efficiency of 5.97bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: 1.3 µm external-cavity quantum-dot comb laser for temperature control free operation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Temperature-dependence of a 1.3 μm external-cavity quantum-dot laser was evaluated. Four-wavelength simultaneous oscillation and wide-eye openings under 25-Gbps NRZ signal using the filtered individual longitudinal mode were demonstrated between 40 °C and 80 °C.

articleTitle: Photonics for gigabit wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Wireless dominates among our future connectivity requirements, moving towards speeds greater than gigabits/second. Photonics can provide energy-efficient, scalable and high-speed fronthaul and backhaul technologies, cost-effective network integration approaches as well as competitive optical wireless connectivity alternatives.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 120 Gbit/s full-duplex signal transmission over fiber-wireless-fiber network at W-band
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate full-duplex transmission of 120-Gb/s PDM-QPSK signal over simplified fiber-wireless-fiber network at W-band for the first time. The network is realized by photonic generation and demodulation techniques with a BER less than 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>.

articleTitle: Mode-group-selective photonic lantern using graded-index multimode fibers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We fabricate mode-group-selective photonic lanterns using multimode graded-index fibers. The use of the multimode graded-index fibers in the taper can significantly relax the adiabaticity requirement in comparison with using single-mode fibers.

articleTitle: A compact and wide-band polarization beam splitter based on wedge-shaped MMI coupler in silicon-on-insulator
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A compact polarization beam splitter is demonstrated in SOI employing a 1×3 wedge-shaped MMI coupler and a 2×2 MMI coupler. The measured extinction ratios are higher than 12dB within a wide wavelength range covering C-band.

articleTitle: Reliability and non-hermetic properties of Ge/Si optoelectronic devices
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Our CMOS-foundry mass-produced Ge/Si optoelectronic devices have passed the high temperature accelerated aging test, THB test and HAST test, which demonstrate satisfactory reliability and promising potential for non-hermetic applications.

articleTitle: 3D sparse finite-difference time-domain simulation of silicon photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Silicon photonic circuits are growing in size yet designing them often requires full-vectorial 3D simulation. Simulation times can be impractical with today's tools. We propose a new simulation tool that is significantly faster.

articleTitle: Photonic-assisted microwave frequency doubling based on silicon ring modulator
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an integrated optical millimeter-wave signal generator based on a silicon ring modulator. A 20 GHz microwave signal with 17 dB suppression ratio is obtained with a 10 GHz input signal.

articleTitle: Real-time coherent ONU for λ-to-the-user based on fully analogue processing of OOK signals
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using fully-analogue and commercially available electronics, we realize a real-time coherent ONU receiver for Ultra-Dense WDM-PON based on intensity-modulated signals. The receiver also requires common photonic components and has -47dBm sensitivity at FEC level.

articleTitle: 56 Gb/s direct detected single-sideband DMT transmission over 320-km SMF using silicon IQ modulator
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: High performance silicon IQ modulator is fabricated and used to demonstrate the first 56 Gb/s direct detected single-sideband DMT transmission over 320-km SMF. The required OSNR of 26.3 dB at BER of 3.7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> was achieved.

articleTitle: Network control and virtualization technologies for carrier services
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Network virtualization is a promising technology to reduce CAPEX and OPEX of telecommunication networks together with providing new service agility. This paper reviews recent research activities on network virtualization to enhance its benefits.

articleTitle: Direct-detection PDM-OFDM RoF system for 60-GHz wireless MIMO transmission without polarization tracking
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This work experimentally demonstrates a 60-GHz direct-detection PDM-OFDM system without polarization tracking at the receiver. A BER of 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> was achieved with all states of polarization over 10-km fiber and 3-m wireless MIMO transmission.

articleTitle: Two orthogonal carriers assisted 82-Gb/s dual-band DDO-OFDM transmission over 320-km SSMF
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a fading-free direct detection method for transmission of complex-value OFDM signal in metro distances. By using two orthogonal optical carriers, an 82-Gb/s dual-band transmission is demonstrated over 320-km SSMF within only 30-GHz electrical bandwidth.

articleTitle: Ultra-low loss vertical optical couplers for 3D photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We design, fabricate, and demonstrate ultra-low loss Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> vertical couplers for multilayer photonic integrated circuits. We achieve 0.05 dB coupling loss, 100×2 µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> footprint, and vertical coupling tolerant to lateral misalignment up to 1.2 µm.

articleTitle: DPSK-demodulation based on ultra-compact micron-scale SOI platform
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the error-free demodulation of a 10Gb/s DPSK-signal based on a novel Delayed Interferometer with ultra-small footprint. The device is fabricated on thick um-scale SOI platform and exhibits similar dimension with nanophotonic based DIs.

articleTitle: The latest fusion splicing technologies and applications to FTTx deployment
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Fusion splicing in FTTx deployment is part of the final process to link the network. Here we examine the latest fusion splicing technologies used worldwide and the challenges they present.

articleTitle: Photonic generation of chirped microwave pulses with precisely targeted and tuned parameters using external modulation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A photonic approach to generate chirped microwave pulses with precisely targeted and tuned parameters including central frequency, pulse repetition frequency, and chirp rate, is proposed. Such chirped pulses at 15 and 20GHz are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of free-space optical communications using OFDM-QPSK/16QAM-carrying fractional orbital angular momentum (OAM) multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report free-space optical communications exploiting fractional orbital angular momentum (OAM) multiplexing. Using OFDM-QPSK/16QAM signals over fractional OAM beams with varied channel spacing, fractional OAM communications are demonstrated in the experiment even with a small OAM channel spacing of 0.6.

articleTitle: Extension of self-seeding to 10/2.5Gb/s T(W)DM PONs through remotely pumped ODN extenders
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Self-seeded upstream transmission is applied to power-splitting PONs through remote amplification at extender boxes. Tree splits up to 1:16 are found to be compatible for full-duplex 10/2.5Gb/s PONs with fully passive optical distribution network.

articleTitle: Amplification of 12 OAM states in an air-core EDF
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose the amplification of 12 OAM modes in an air-core EDF using either core-or cladding- pumping at 980nm. Differential modal gains of only 0.25dB among all the 12-modes are achieved over the C-band.

articleTitle: Road to commercialize ArF technology for Si photonics through wafer-level assessment
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The development and assessment of ArF technology in a 200mm FAB line are described. Wafer-level measurement is implemented to explore the dummy pattern effect on cross-wafer uniformity and examine fundamental Si photonics devices.

articleTitle: 130-Gbps DMT transmission using silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator with chirp control at 1.55-µm
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally evaluated the transmission performance of discrete multi-tone (DMT) modulation with 10-Gbps SiP MZ modulator at 1550-nm region. We achieved the transmission of more than 130-Gbps over 2-km SMF with BER of FEC limit of 3.0E-03.

articleTitle: Photonic-enabled millimeter-wave wireless data transmission links based on photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present two different approaches for the generation of millimeter wave carrier signals for wireless data links based on photonic integrated circuits using the optical heterodyne technique. One approach, based on dedicated fabrication run, integrates all the required components on a single chip. A second approach is based on a multi-project wafer run on a generic integration platform. We demonstrate their application to wireless data transmission at 1 Gbps data rate without the requirement for phase stabilization schemes of the two wavelengths.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband bidirectional dual-band ouantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: By exploiting different discrete optical transitions in a QD SOA, we demonstrate theoretical and experimental distortion-free simultaneous amplification of two counter-propagating 40 Gbit/s OOK signals separated by 93 nm for a wide operating-parameter range.

articleTitle: Field trial and analysis of N∶1 redundant 10G-EPON using boost-type semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a high-reliable and long-reach N:1 redundant 10G-EPON system implemented on a commercial access network. We also develop an analysis method for estimating total reachable distance for 10G-EPON systems that use optical amplifiers.

articleTitle: Scaling limits of free-space tilt mirror MEMS switches for data center networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a first-principles analysis of the scaling of switch response speed as a function of port count, crosstalk, and insertion loss, based on physical optics and kinematics of canonical MEMS tilt mirror switch structures.

articleTitle: Mode-group-selective photonic lantern based on integrated 3D devices fabricated by ultrafast laser inscription
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a three-dimensional adiabatically-tapered mode-group-selective space-division multiplexer fabricated by ultrafast laser inscription. The device supports two mode groups at 1550 nm, has a loss of <4 dB, and is scalable to more modes.

articleTitle: The future of transport networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Summary form only given. Optics and electronics provide largely complementary capabilities for fundamental physical reasons: optics is good for communicating information over long distances and for limited forms of switching; electronics is good for processing and storing information and therefore for sophisticated forms of switching, including packet switching and routing.

articleTitle: 2.8FITs of field reliability of 1480nm/14××-nm pump lasers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recent progress of high power and high reliable 1480nm/14××-nm pump lasers as FOL14** series of FITEL is reported. Field reliability was estimated for over one million shipments and failure mode was analyzed by returned products.

articleTitle: Multi fiber connector technologies
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper describes the advancement of high density optical interconnect components which is enabling high bandwidth, low cost, single-mode and multimode optical communication between IC's for on-card, optical backplane and chassis to chassis applications.

articleTitle: Wavelet transform-OFDM in indoor visible light communication
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate that wavelet transform (WT)-OFDM without cyclic prefix has the similar BER performance with conventional Fourier transform (FT)-OFDM in VLC, while effectively improves the transmission distance by 20% due to less PAPR and better nonlinear tolerance.

articleTitle: A hybrid lightwave transmission system based on fiber-VLLC convergence
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A hybrid lightwave transmission system based on SMF and VCSEL-based VLLC convergence with light injection and optoelectronic feedback techniques is proposed. Over 40-km SMF and 10-m free-space VLLC transport, CNR/CSO/CTB/BER performs brilliantly for CATV/16-QAM/16-QAM-OFDM transmission.

articleTitle: High-speed polarization shift keying lightpath labeling of 100 Gb/s DP-QPSK for programmable photonic networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present theoretical and experimental results on PolSK lightpath labels for 100 Gb/s DP-QPSK signals. A 100 Mb/s label data rate is confirmed, with several coding overhead ratios and PDL tolerance of up to 2dB.

articleTitle: High-bandwidth optical I/O link with optical MCM
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A high-bandwidth optical I/O link with developed optical MCM is demonstrated. High speed link tests for 24 channels show that the TX operates at 25 Gb/s, and the optical I/O link operates at 20 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Practical considerations on discrete multi-tone transmission for cost-effective access networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate that digital pre-emphasis is of limited value in directly modulated discrete multi-tone transmitters and that the use of larger bandwidth discrete multi-tone is ineffective when the transmission capacity is limited by dispersion.

articleTitle: 70 nm seamless band transmission of 17.3 Tb/s over 40×100km of fiber using complementary Raman/EDFA
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated 70nm seamless band transmission of 173×128Gb/s QPSK signals over 40×100km of TeraWave™ fiber. The complementary Raman/EDFAs and wide-band single-stage discrete Raman amplifiers were used to achieve this 17.3Tb/s capacity ultra-wide single-band transmission.

articleTitle: SOI based photonic interconnection for multi-dimensional multiplexed system
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An on-chip polarization insensitive interconnection is proposed and fabricated based on SOI platform. The proposed circuit is experimentally demonstrated in fiber-optic communication system utilizing wavelength, polarization and mode multiplexing techniques with power penalty of 3.2dB.

articleTitle: Adaptive pre-equalization using bidirectional pilot sequences to estimate and feed back amplitude transfer function and chromatic dispersion
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an adaptive pre-equalization system that compensates the amplitude transfer function and chromatic dispersion using estimates transmitted from the receiver. Two kinds of pilot sequences are used for estimation and mutual communication.

articleTitle: Nonlinear phase noise reduction for 20-Gbit/s NRZ-QPSK signals using InP on SOI photonic crystal nanocavity
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: All-optical nonlinear phase noise reduction using an InP-over-SOI PhC nanocavity is experimentally demonstrated for 20-Gbit/s NRZ-QPSK signals. The phase-preserving intensity-limiting function results in an OSNR penalty reduction of 3.5 dB at a BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Identification of loss factors by evaluating backscattered modal loss ratio obtained with 1-µm-band mode-detection OTDR
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel diagnostic technique for identifying loss factors using 1-μm-band mode-detection OTDR. The loss ratio between the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> and LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> modes of backscattered light determines the macrobending or fusion splicing state.

articleTitle: Fiber fuse propagation in LPn mode in few-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We observed fiber fuse propagation in the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> mode in few-mode fiber. We report that the propagation threshold of the fiber fuse in the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> mode was higher than that in the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> mode.

articleTitle: How algorithms shape our networked world
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Summary form only given. In their hearts, computers, smartphones, and other mobile devices are simply quantifying information and sewing it together however we tell them to. But these devices aren't mere objects; they are the nervous system for a networked world. Their effects are broad, deep, and often quite difficult to discern, extending far off the desktop into our everyday lives.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated laser with weak optical feedback demonstrating suppressed relaxation-oscillation dynamics
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a laser with weak optical feedback, which shows broad regions of operation without relaxation-oscillation induced instabilities. Here, the side mode suppression is above 40 dB, independent of the feedback phase.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of polar code performance for coherent UDWDM PONs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on the experimental investigation of Polar codes with 7% overhead for forward-error-correction (FEC) in a coherent UDWDM PON scenario. The measured post-FEC bit error ratio vs. the signal-to-noise ratio is compared with results from simulations.

articleTitle: RF frequency quadrupling utilizing selective polarization rotation for wavelength-free radio-over-fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose rf frequency quadrupling based on selective suppression of optical carrier by a polarizer, for wavelength-free operation. Frequency-upconverted rf signal is successfully obtained experimentally, from generated two-tone optical signal with 25.7-dB carrier-suppression ratio.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of optical labeled superchannel switching for elastic optical network
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a node architecture supporting optical labeled superchannel switching for elastic optical network. Flexible superchannel/label generation and detection based on optical comb, label swapping with extraction, erasure, re-add are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Fast non-blocking N×N optical switch using diffractive MOEMS
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have developed a scalable free-space optical switch with a 12 microsecond reconfiguration time that can be implemented into an all-optical-cross connect for data communication architecture, or as a wavelength selective switch in a CDC ROADM for telecommunication networks. The foundation of the switch is the Texas Instruments DLP™ MOEMS that is used as a diffractive element displaying computer generated holograms to redirect the signal from any port to any port.

articleTitle: Simple receiving scheme in 100-GHz DD OFDM RoF systems employing low-sampling-rate ADCs and digital preprocess
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A simple low-sampling-rate receiving scheme is proposed for W-band OFDM-RoF systems. Using the proposed preprocess, aliasing-free subcarriers can be received, and employing the optimized delays to ADCs can achieve the performance insensitive to sampling rate.

articleTitle: 125-µm-cladding 8-core multi-core fiber realizing ultra-high-density cable suitable for O-band short-reach optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 125-μm-cladding 8-core fiber applicable to short-reach transmissions and compatible with conventional components is proposed. An ultra-high-density 12-MCF cable was fabricated with the proposed MCF, and error-free 8-SDM×4-WDM×25-Gb/s (800-Gb/s/fiber) transmission was demonstrated in O-band.

articleTitle: 25.8 Gbps error free transmission over 10 km at wavelengths from 1271 to 1331nm by uncooled (25 to 85°C) directly modulated DFB lasers for 100G-CWDM4
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We successfully demonstrated 25.8 Gbps error free transmission through an 11.4km-long fiber using 1.3 µm directly modulated DFB lasers at the CWDM wavelengths for temperatures as high as 85°C.

articleTitle: Copper is the new black for ultra broadband networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: G.fast, the newest ITU protocol for copper access, will deliver anywhere from hundreds of Mb/s to close to 1Gb/s. Operators have an additional tool at their disposal to provide fiber like speeds over existing copper.

articleTitle: Integrated devices for high-performance optical links
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the development of large scale Photonic Integrated Circuits, high capacity optical module integration and their performance in a variety of data-center / metro and long-haul coherent optical link applications.

articleTitle: Evaluating the potential for spectrally-efficient super-channel formats in brownfield networks with legacy services
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper shows that a successful combination of super-channels and highly-granular flexible grid networks is intrinsically dependent on the existence of legacy traffic and the occurrence of traffic chum during the network lifetime.

articleTitle: High-throughput multiple dies-to-wafer (D2W) bonding for III/V-on-Si hybrid lasers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate high-throughput multiple dies-to-wafer bonding method with up to 104 dies through temporary-bonding dies to handle wafer for batch processing. Various hybrid III/V-on-silicon lasers are demonstrated with CW operation at room temperature.

articleTitle: Photonic subsystems for optical packet/burst switches based on heterogeneous SOI and III–V integration
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper we describe how high-quality silicon photonic ICs and III-V membrane switches integrated on this platform can be used to build photonic subsystems for optical packet switches.

articleTitle: 32×32 strictly non-blocking Si-wire optical switch on ultra-small die of 11×25 mm2
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra-compact 32 × 32 path-independent-insertion-loss optical switch that integrates 1024 thermooptic MZ switches on SOI platform using ArF immersion lithography. On-chip loss of 19.7 dB and estimated crosstalk of -20 dB are achieved.

articleTitle: Plasmonic Mach-Zehnder modulator with >70 GHz electrical bandwidth demonstrating 90 Gbit/s 4-ASK
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A high-extinction-ratio plasmonic Mach-Zehnder modulator with an electrical bandwidth exceeding 70GHz is demonstrated. The BER is below 4×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> and 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> for a BPSK and 4-ASK signal with line rates of 72Gbit/s and 108Gbit/s, respectively.

articleTitle: A novel phase-locking-free phase sensitive amplifier based Regenerator
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel PSK regenerator based on phase sensitive amplification without active phase-locking. The scheme is applied to regenerate a phase noise degraded 10-Gbit/s DPSK signal, improving receiver sensitivity by 3.5 dB.

articleTitle: New trends in fiber based sensors
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical fibres can be imbued with the properties of nanomaterials and by introducing surface chemistries one can create sensors to detect specific small molecules or proteins. An overview of emerging sensing architectures will be presented with a focus on devices for biosensing.

articleTitle: 25Gb/s hybrid-integrated silicon photonic receiver with microring wavelength stabilization
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 25Gb/s hybrid-integrated microring receiver which includes a thermal tuning loop that stabilizes the drop filter resonance wavelength is implemented. The multi-channel 65nm CMOS source-synchronous receiver achieves -8.2 dBm sensitivity at BER <;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> and 0.68pJ/b.

articleTitle: 1.3µm SDN-enabled optical packet switch architecture for high performance and programmable data center network
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 1.3 μm port-count scalable SDN-enabled optical packet switch architecture for programmable data-center networks. Experimental assessments of a 40Gb/s 4×4 switch system with SDN-control show <;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> packet-loss and <;430ns latency for 0.5 load.

articleTitle: 100∼200-GHz optical mm-wave generation by one modulator and its application in 64QAM W-band signal transmission system
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 100~200-GHz mm-wave generated by only one intensity modulator driven by a 100-GHz RF signal can carry 10-Gbaud 64QAM signal to realize 2-m wireless delivery with a BER under 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>.

articleTitle: Exoerimental studv of C-band EML based ONU burst-mode transmitter for 40 Gbit/s TWDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using single 10Gbit/s EML with a wide operating temperature range, we achieved 40km transmission with a low dispersion penalty of less than 0.8dB over a wavelength range of 2.7nm covering 4-channel at 100GHz grid spacing.

articleTitle: 64QAM based coded modulation transmission over transoceanic distance with > 60 Tb/s capacity
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We achieve 63.5 Tb/s transmission over 5,380 km and 61.9 Tb/s over 5,920 km using 64QAM based coded modulation and continuous 73 nm optical bandwidth. 7.1 b/s/Hz spectral efficiency is achieved with 2.2 dBQ error correction threshold.

articleTitle: A 200-Gbps OFDM long-reach PON over 60-km transmission without inline and pre-amplifier
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 200-Gbps 60-km OFDM transmission in a 4-channel WDM system is demonstrated with 29-dB loss budget per channel without inline and pre-amplifier. Employing 10-GHz EAM and PIN, the LR-PON can support 64 ONUs with >2.5-Gbps/ONU capacity.

articleTitle: Routing, code, and spectrum assignment (RCSA) in elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper introduces the concept of code selection in RSA for EONs. Simulations show that code-adaptive time frequency packing reduces blocking probability by one order of magnitude with respect to format-adaptive Nyquist WDM.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics systems - nonidealities and nonlinearities
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this talk, we will provide an overview of nonlinearities and non-idealities in high-confinement silicon photonic waveguides, focusing in particular on the effects that are most relevant to realistic transceivers.

articleTitle: Active probing assisted monitoring for software defined networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Efficient and agile control-plane design is crucial for emerging flexible, on-demand optical networks. Active probing assisted monitoring is proposed and shown to reduce monitoring time by around 75% to achieve rapid monitoring in optical networks.

articleTitle: SDN and NFV convergence a technology enabler for abstracting and virtualising hardware and control of optical networks (invited)
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A new architecture utilizing combination of SDN and NFV for deeply programmable optical Internet infrastructure is proposed where network devices can be sliced, interconnected and programmed on demand for specific transport and network computing tasks.

articleTitle: Germanium-tin on Silicon p-i-n photodiode with low dark current due to sidewall surface passivation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate that the surface leakage current of a Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.95</sub>Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.05</sub>/Si p-i-n photodiode can be significantly reduced by ~two orders by Si surface passivation. Furthermore, a dark current density of 0.073A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">bias</sub>= -1 V) is achieved.

articleTitle: Selective excitation of high order modes in few mode fibres using optical microfibres
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Selective modal multiplexing and demultiplexing is demonstrated in few-mode fibers using weakly-fused microfiber couplers.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics for the datacenter
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: To fully benefit from silicon photonics technology at the system-level, novel electro-optical assembly techniques are required enabling a close integration with the processor or switch chip. Optical coupling and signal distribution options are discussed.

articleTitle: Burst-off-level power reduction in λ-tunable transmitter using a reverse bias voltage controlled burst-mode booster SOA for 256-split WDM/TDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a burst-off-level power reduction technique for a burst-mode booster SOA implemented λ-tunable transmitter. A large power reduction of 8.2 dB and a low crosstalk penalty of <;0.1 dB in 256-split WDM/TDM-PON are achieved.

articleTitle: OFDM PON downstream scheme with symbol pre-distortion and scalable receiver frontend
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a 40-Gbps A-RF-tone-based VSSB-DD OFDM PON downstream scheme with symbol pre-distortion and scalable receiver frontend to reduce the SSBI and the computational complexity of ONUs, respectively.

articleTitle: Experimental study of the limits of digital nonlinearity compensation in DWDM systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate idealized digital nonlinearity compensation in a 9-channel DWDM system. A Q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-factor gain of 2-dB for single-channel transmission is reduced to 0.1-dB in DWDM operation and recovers to 0.8-dB for nonlinearity compensation across all channels.

articleTitle: Protection path-based hitless spectrum defragmentation in elastic optical networks: Shared backup path protection
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose two protection path-based spectrum defragmentation algorithms to improve the spectrum utilization for an elastic optical network with shared backup path protection (SBPP). Results show that the proposed algorithms can significantly improve spectrum efficiency compared to the case without defragmentation.

articleTitle: Low-differential-mode-group-delay 9-LP-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the fabrication of low-differential-mode-group-delay 9-LP-mode fibers using a standard bend-insensitive 50μm-diameter-core multimode process. Such 9-LP-mode fibers exhibit DMGDs <; 155ps/km at 1550nm.

articleTitle: Reliability-constrained resource allocation with weighted SRLG for distributed clouds
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose heuristics to allocate virtual machines among distributed data centers for a cloud request. Our objective is to minimize the maximum delay between selected data centers, while considering the reliability and computing resource constraints.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of hierarchical control over multi-domain OTN networks based on extended Openflow protocol
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a control mechanism for multi-domain optical networks with commercial OTN equipments by using hierarchical SDN controllers. A solution based on extended OpenFlow was proposed to support Control Virtual Network Interface in OTN network.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of long-distance analog transmission over few-mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first FMF-based analog fiber-optic link to increase link gain and reduce intermodulation distortions. Compared with SMF, FMF-based link increased input power by 3 dB and reduced third-order intermodulation distortion by 3 dB.

articleTitle: A 4-λ, 40Gb/s/λ bandwidth extension of multimode fiber in the 850nm range
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The bandwidth capacity of 50/125 μm multimode fiber is extended by using four VCSELs with wavelengths coarsely separated at 30nm and with each wavelength operating at 40Gb/s. All four wavelengths achieve BER <;1E-12 at 100m.

articleTitle: Tapered mode multiplexers for single mode to multi mode fibre mode transitions
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Three-mode multiplexers were made by post-processing existing SMF-28 fibres. The input was three identical SMFs which were fused together and adiabatically tapered to form a multimode output core. The light was converted to the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> and two LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> with low loss (0.6-0.7 dB). The mode multiplexers were broadband.

articleTitle: 112 Gb/s PAM4 transmission over 40km SSMF using 1.3 µm gain-clamped semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: By using a gain-clamped 1.3 μm semiconductor optical pre-amplifier, we experimentally demonstrated that both single- and dual-wavelength 112Gb/s 4-level pulse-amplitude-modulation (PAM4) signals can be transported over 40km standard single-mode fiber with >3dB power margin.

articleTitle: Photonic generation of high-power pulsed microwave signals with peak powers up to 7.2 watt
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using a modified uni-traveling carrier photodiode we demonstrate photonic generation of pulsed 1 GHz and 10 GHz signals with peak power levels as high as 38.6 dBm (7.2 W) and 36.4 dBm (4.4 W), respectively.

articleTitle: FTTx migration to Giga-bps hyper-connectivity networking infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: By upgrading current 100Mbps class FTTx to 1Gbps, commercial nationwide ‘Giga Internet’ service has launched in 2014 in Korea. Including government, big three operator's (KT, SKT, LGUplus) efforts for network evolution will be presented.

articleTitle: High-capacity mobile fronthaul supporting LTE-advanced carrier aggregation and 8×8 MIMO
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a SCM-PON mobile fronthaul architecture supporting 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>G cell sites with 3 RRHs, 5 aggregated carriers, and 8×8 MIMO (60×20MHz per λ) using 2-GHz-bandwidth optical components with first demonstration of complete RF signal processing.

articleTitle: Demonstration of multi-hop optical packet switching and transmission using SOA-based optical packet switches
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a multi-hop optical packet switching using SOA-based broadband optical switches and burst-mode EDFAs. Over 450 km all-optical packet transmission was achieved by 10-hops of the optical packet switch for the first time.

articleTitle: Evolution of networks to meet the explosion of cloud services
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Cloud is driving traffic growth, causing Service Providers to increase capacity and network efficiency. Towards these ends a new type of network is emerging - Data Center Interconnect. Differences between DCI and traditional networks are discussed.

articleTitle: Single output tunable DFB semiconductor laser array with equivalent phase shift
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report single output tunable DFB semiconductor laser arrays in series and grating-matrix configuration designed by reconstruction equivalent chirp (REC) technique. By using interference lithography and photolithography for the grating fabrication, tunable laser arrays with good performance are experimentally realized with low cost.

articleTitle: Impact of MAP detection on the mutual information of a 1.2 Tb/s three-carrier DP 16-QAM superchannel
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For a 1.206 Tb/s three-carrier DP 16-QAM super channel, the mutual information is evaluated without and with fixed look-up table based maximum-a-posteriori detection at the receiver to mitigate pattern-dependent distortion in the transmitted signal.

articleTitle: Field transmission of uncompressed ultra-high definition video signals through dynamic optical path network
