publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, transmission of 86-Gb/s ultra-high definition video signals from Tokyo to Tsukuba over 173 km. Successful operation was confirmed through bit-error-rate < 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> and noise-free videos displayed on the screen.

articleTitle: Extra-wide-band OM4 MMF for future 1.6Tbps data communications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the fabrication of a Highly Germanium and Fluorine co-doped MMF optimized according to effective bandwidth considerations, with OM4 performance over the 850-1000nm window. Such fiber opens the door to future 1.6Tbps data communications.

articleTitle: Control Architectures for Multi-Layer Networking: Distributed, centralized, or something in between?
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: · Both distributed and centralized control systems have valuable attributes for network control · It is possible to keep some functions distributed while centralizing others · The entire controller may become distributed to meet carrier grade req.s · Multi-vendor systems are likely to be more distributed to allow for vendor innovation · Typical network control is likely to be hybrid for the above reasons.

articleTitle: Low optical power embedded OTDR
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A live fiber loss measurement technique with 0dBm laser source accurately identifies losses over 100km fiber with no change to distance resolution. Multiple levels of length and resolution analysis are obtained from a single dataset.

articleTitle: Design trade-offs in practical ASIC implementations
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: power dissipation; power integrity; on chip power distribution network; signal integrity; and design for testability.

articleTitle: Embracing diversity: Interconnecting different materials and components for the lowest $/Gb
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Highest performance and lowest cost optical functions are best obtained in the shortest time by using proven and mature building blocks. We show the use of a MEMS breadboard to interconnect glass PLCs, InP lasers, and silicon photonics for a variety of functions.

articleTitle: Coherent BOTDA sensor with suppressed chromatic dispersion
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Intensity modulated probe is utilized in coherent BOTDA sensor to reduce chromatic dispersion effect instead of phase modulated probe. Reduction of ~6-MHz decoding error in Brillouin gain spectrum is achieved along 40-km sensing distance.

articleTitle: On the use of factor graphs in optical communications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Factor graphs and message passing allow the near-automated development of algorithms in many engineering disciplines, including digital communications. This paper gives an overview of their possible use in optical communications.

articleTitle: How the distribution of superchannel size affects the effectiveness of the elastic WDM CONUS network
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: By planning the CONUS WDM network featuring elastic Nyquist superchannels, we discuss why the distribution of their number of subcarriers can impact the insertion/extraction of traffic and the optimization of their WDM transmission.

articleTitle: All-optical ultra-high-speed OFDM to Nyquist-WDM conversion
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an all-optical ultra-high-speed OFDM to Nyquist-WDM conversion scheme based on complete OFT. An 8-subcarrier 640 Gbit/s DPSK OFDM super-channel is converted to eight 80-Gbit/s Nyquist-WDM channels with BER <; 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> performance for all channels.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Fourier transformation based coherent detection scheme for discrete spectrum
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Joint decision on eigenvalue patterns and on corresponding amplitudes was experimentally demonstrated using the discrete part of the nonlinear Fourier transform calculated after coherent detection of a high power 16-GBd two symbol QPSK burst signal.

articleTitle: Digital coherent communications with a 1550 nm VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate for the first time the use of a single mode 1550 nm VCSEL in a standard coherent communication system employing QPSK modulation format. The phase noise of the VCSEL is also characterized in detail.

articleTitle: Highly scalable subsystem modular OXC nodes that host tailored add/drop mechanism
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and optimize as a complete entity, a novel highly scalable subsystem modular OXC architecture that employs an efficient add/drop part. Numerical experiments prove significant hardware scale reduction compared to the conventional architecture.

articleTitle: First field trial of 40-km reach and 1024-split symmetric-rate 40-Gbit/s X-tunable WDM/TDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce the world's first field trial of a symmetric-rate 40-Gbit/s λ-tunable WDM/TDM-PON that uses a high-speed λ-selective ONU TRx and optical extender. 40-km reach and 1024-split λ-switching transmission, and system demonstrations are successfully performed.

articleTitle: Optimization criteria for coherent PONs with video overlay and hybrid ODN
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Based on a test bed of hybrid point-to-multi-point optical distribution network, in coexistence of UDWDM with video overlay, we derive a set of optimum parameters and their impact on the network operation.

articleTitle: VCSELs for coherent PON
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recent advances and research on coherent technologies for access networks are discussed and put into context of user demands and standardization work.

articleTitle: The non-contact connector: A new category of optical fiber connector
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on a new category of fiber connectors called non-contact connectors. By introducing a gap between anti-reflection coated fiber facets, a connector with outstanding optical performance, reliability and low cost is achieved.

articleTitle: Impact of channel add/drop on nonlinear performance in uncompensated 100G coherent systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We examine nonlinear performance of uncompensated coherent systems in which neighboring channels are added and dropped at ROADM nodes along the path; we investigate dependence on fiber type and initial dispersion on the added channels.

articleTitle: Single-mode board-level interconnects for silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An optical interconnection technology for 1310/1550nm has been successfully developed with single-mode glass waveguide panels characterizes loss of 0.05dB/cm. The glass has been integrated into a multi-layer electrical printed circuit board for silicon photonic assembly.

articleTitle: Performance and complexity comparison of CPE algorithms for 256-QAM optical signals
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A detailed analysis of different CPE schemes for 256- QAM signals is presented. Viterbi&Viterbi algorithms demonstrate very poor performance, while the best compromise between complexity and performance is achieved using the BPS+MLE algorithm.

articleTitle: Enhancing clock tone via polarization pre-rotation: A low-complexity, extended Kalman filter-based approach
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally verified that our proposed low-complexity extended Kalman filter-based polarization pre-rotation at ASIC rates enhances the clock tone of polarization-multiplexed signals.

articleTitle: Cycle slip tolerant, differential encoding aware soft-decision FEC
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We compare hybrid turbo differential decoding with other FEC-schemes that reduce the penalty usually associated with differential encoding applied for cycle slip mitigation. We discuss implementation aspects and show robust FEC-performance in nonlinear transmission experiments.

articleTitle: Quantum dash passively mode-locked lasers for Tbit/s data interconnects
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time Tbit/s transmission using Q-Dash mode-locked laser sources with FSR of 44.7 and 22.7GHz. The aggregate capacities achieved were 1.128Tb/s for 44.7GHz and 2.256Tb/s for 22.7GHz Q-Dash PMLL using IM/DD-SSB-OFDM.

articleTitle: Performance of joint iterative detection and decoding in coherent optical channels
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show that a joint iterative detection and decoding algorithm compensates phase noise and laser frequency fluctuations in a 100 Gb/s coherent optical receiver with non-differential 16-QAM modulation, achieving 1 dB gain over existing solutions.

articleTitle: Recent progress in the development of few mode fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review the performances of both core and cladding pumped few-mode erbium doped fiber amplifiers supporting 6 spatial modes (4 mode groups) which incidentally the highest mode count demonstrated to date.

articleTitle: Amplification of 5 modes carrying each 100Gb/s with a few mode EDFA
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We built an optical Few Mode Amplifier supporting 5 modes. Moderate crosstalk between modes has been measured thanks to careful design and alignment optimization. Simultaneous amplification of 100Gbits/ PDM-QPSK signal over 5 modes is demonstrated. OCIS codes: (060.2320) Fiber Optics amplifiers and oscillators; (060.4230) Multiplexing.

articleTitle: Dense SDM (12-core × 3-mode) transmission over 527 km with 33.2-ns mode-dispersion employing low-complexity parallel MIMO frequency-domain equalization
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 12-core × 3-mode dense SDM transmission over 527 km graded-index multi-core few-mode fiber without mode-dispersion management. Employing low baud rate multi-carrier signal and frequency-domain equalization enables 33.2-ns DMD compensation with low computational complexity.

articleTitle: Reflowable thermoplastic optical lens module for 10-Gbit/s transmission with 850-nm VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We successfully developed reflowable thermoplastic optical lens module by electron beam cross-linking and fabricated MM-based 10-Gbit/s optical transmitter unit. Experimental result shows good durability for reflow process up to 260 °C.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 100G/lambda Nyquist-PAM4 transmission with digital pre-equalization of chromatic dispersion for extended-reach 400GbE
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 40-km NZ-DSF and SSMF transmission of 100 Gbit/s/lambda Nyquist-PAM4 with the help of digital pre-equalization is demonstrated, achieving BER less than Super FEC limit (BER 2E-3).

articleTitle: Band-structure approach to synthesis of grating couplers with ultra-high coupling efficiency and directivity
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a complex-wavevector band-structure approach to synthesis of fiber-to-chip grating couplers, and show apodized bi-level designs with 95% coupling efficiency and 99% directivity using only two device layers of a monolithic SOI CMOS process.

articleTitle: High-count multi-core fibers for space-division multiplexing with propagation-direction interleaving
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: By introducing a square lattice structure for bidirectional core assignments in multi-core fibers, the effectiveness of propagation-direction interleaving for crosstalk reduction can be increased, realizing a 24-core fiber with -30.6 dB crosstalk over 100 km.

articleTitle: 1.4 mA (70 mV) peak-to-peak drive of 1.25 Gb/s frequency modulated laser for WDM coherent access networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A new laser suitable for access-systems with FM efficiency up to 7 GHz/mA and negligible amplitude modulation is presented. It enables 1.25/2.5 Gb/s operations with extremely low driving signals: 70 mV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pk-pk</sub> and 250 mV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pk-pk</sub> respectively.

articleTitle: Multicore fiber technology
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper discusses crosstalk estimation in multicore fibers (MCFs) using coupled-mode theory and coupled-power theory. Crosstalk suppression was also covered. Strategies for multicore fiber design were also presented. Due to the limitation of the outer cladding size of multicore fibers (MCFs) related to their mechanical reliability, the number of cores as well as the core arrangement have to be carefully determined based on the required modulation format and transmission distance. By introducing heterogeneous core arrangement, further decrement of core-to-core distance is possible with keeping lower crosstalk level compared with the homogeneous MCFs. The combination of MCF and few-mode fiber (FMF), which is FM-MCF, is a very promising approach to realize space multiplicity over 50. Further development on related devices such as Fan-in/Fan-out and amplifier for FM-MCF transmission is highly expected. Investigation towards cost saving by using MCF transmission system is underway and further development on devise integration is expected for deploying MCFs in the real network.

articleTitle: Autonomic agent for transport networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Autonomic networking refers to the self-managing characteristics (configuration, protection, healing, and optimization) of distributed network elements, adapting to unpredictable changes while hiding intrinsic complexity from operators and users. Autonomic Networking, which often involves closed-loop control, is applicable to the complete network (functions) lifecycle (e.g. installation, commissioning, operating, etc). An autonomic function works in a distributed way across various network elements, but allowing central guidance and reporting, and co-existence with non-autonomic methods of management. This paper will discuss some of the use cases for basics autonomic agent, which takes into consideration layer 1 (with focus on optical transport) performance for layer 3 decisions.

articleTitle: 750Mbit/s visible light communications employing 64QAM-OFDM based on amplitude equalization circuit
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using the designed amplitude equalization circuit, we first demonstrate the highest data rate and longest transmission for VLC system with 750Mbit/s data rate employing 64QAM-OFDM after 2m free-space transmission.

articleTitle: Tunable transmitter for serial 100 Gb/s connectivity inside flexible data centers using hybrid polymer integration
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce a platform based on passive and electro-optic polymers, and present a serial 100G transmitter with 22-nm tunability. We achieve 100-Gb/s transmission over 1625-m, and demonstrate the flexibility of the transmitter inside data-center networks.

articleTitle: Highly sensitive photonic crystal cavity laser noise measurements using Bayesian filtering
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We measure for the first time the frequency noise spectrum of a photonic crystal cavity laser with less than 20 nW of fiber-coupled output power using a coherent receiver and Bayesian filtering.

articleTitle: Differential pilots aided in-band OSNR monitor with large nonlinear tolerance
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Differential pilots aided in-band OSNR monitor is proposed and verified under 32GBaud WDM experiments. High accuracy (<;0.5dB error), no dependency on pulse shapes, and large nonlinear tolerance (1dB error after 4dBm 2700km transmission) are proved.

articleTitle: Impact of physical layer restrictions on the dynamic switching of channels in transparent optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Physical layer effects restricts the arbitrarily fast dynamic channel switching in transparent optical networks. We show the influence of these effects and how they limit the dynamic switching of channels.

articleTitle: Zero dispersion modes and its effects on characterization of MMF chromatic dispersion
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The multiple zero dispersion wavelengths of multimode fiber modes are studied. The effect of these modes and the launch conditions on the characterization of chromatic dispersion is estimated.

articleTitle: Dynamic frequency chirp properties of QD-SOAs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally show dynamic frequency chirp properties induced in a quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifier (QD-SOA), for the first time. We also compare the dynamic chirp properties of the QD-SOA with those of a common SOA.

articleTitle: Widely tunable OEO based on a directly modulated DFB laser under optical injection
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A widely tunable optoelectronic oscillator based on a directly modulated distributed feedback (DFB) semiconductor laser under optical injection is demonstrated. Microwave signals with frequency tuned from 5.98 to 15.22 GHz are generated.

articleTitle: Impact of adaptive modulation on cost efficient traffic grooming in elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We evaluate the contribution of “adaptive modulation” to cost reduction in traffic grooming-capable optical networks. We demonstrate up to 25% optical line reduction with adaptive modulation for large networks carrying traffic of hundreds of terabits/s.

articleTitle: Demonstration of multi-hop optical add-drop network with high frequency granular optical channel defragmentation nodes
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Four nodes optical add-drop network with high frequency granular optical channel defragmentation has been demonstrated. All channels presents error-free operation and power penalties are less than 4 dB even after multi-hop transmission.

articleTitle: Optical pulse compression reflectometry with 10 cm spatial resolution based on pulsed linear frequency modulation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A new scheme based on pulsed linear frequency modulation is proposed to improve the stability and spatial resolution of optical pulse compression reflectometry. 10 cm spatial resolution over 5.4 km measurement range is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Best effort multi-rate optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Load-aware signal power selection strategies are applied while planning multi-rate optical networks intended to carry best effort traffic. Network fiber spans are carefully classified as either full-load or odd-only, trading wavelengths for improved OSNR.

articleTitle: Multiple fiber, flexgrid elastic optical network design using MaxEnt optimization
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate how maximum entropy (MaxEnt) allocation strategies can optimally determine links within a flexgrid elastic optical network requiring multiple fiber-pairs to support 100% capacity growth with 34.3% improvement in the uniformity of spectrum allocations.

articleTitle: Miniaturized heterodyne channel monitor with tone detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a miniaturized heterodyne optical channel monitor with 300 MHz frequency resolution, 0.5 GHz absolute frequency accuracy and tone detection ability. The compact optical package size of 19×27×7mm makes it suitable for integration into next-generation ROADMs.

articleTitle: Optical electric field sensor using push-pull for vibration noise reduction
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The push-pull slab-coupled optical sensor measures a localized single electric field component with the advantage of reducing adverse strain effects for sensing in harsh vibrating environments. Its miniature size makes it ideal for compact environments.

articleTitle: Optical diversity transmission with signal and its phase-conjugate lights through multi-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper demonstrated a 4.5dB Q-value improvement by realizing maximum-ratio combining in phase-conjugate lights pair diversity transmission through a multi-core fiber. Simulations confirm cancellation of the spatial correlation component in the enhanced amplified-spontaneous emission noise.

articleTitle: Large-scale optical-switch prototype compactly implemented with novel functional configuration
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel optical-switch architecture that can be compactly implemented with novel functional configuration. A highly-integrated 180×180 optical switch prototype is fabricated using PLC technologies and its good performance is experimentally confirmed.

articleTitle: A WDM-Compatible 4 × 32-Gb/s CMOS-driven electro-absorption modulator array
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A four-channel electro-absorption-modulator array, driven by 32-nm CMOS drivers providing 2-V peak-to-peak output swing, operates with BER < 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−12</sup> at a data rate of 4 × 32 Gb/s and dissipates 170 mW of power.

articleTitle: High power sub-picosecond pulsed SWIR source based on thulium assisted Raman wavelength shifting
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 1.5W sub-picosecond pulsed source near 2μm. Cavity-less source is based on integrated association of 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> order Raman wavelength-shifting and thulium amplification. Coherent spectrum of 61.5nm with 49% pump power conversion efficiency is achieved.

articleTitle: Sixteen-channel monolithically integrated InP wavelength selector based on a chain of passband-flattened cyclic AWG and optical switches
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An integrated wavelength selector based on combinations of integrated AWGs and SOAs selects one-out-of-sixteen input channels. Loss-compensated, error-free 16 WDM channel selection operation with <;2.3dB penalty is reported with an OSNR of up to 32.5dB/0.1nm.

articleTitle: All-optical polarization control for telecom applications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe a phenomenon of self-organization of the light state-of-polarization in optical fibers based on a nonlinear cross-polarization interaction between an incident signal and its backward replica. Several proof-of-principles for telecom applications are reported.

articleTitle: Coupled mode analysis of crosstalk in multicore fiber with random perturbations
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A simple, general crosstalk formula is derived for multicore fibers with random perturbations using coupled mode theory. Analytical crosstalk expressions under exponential and Gaussian correlation length distributions are presented. Experimental results agree well with theory.

articleTitle: Ultra-high-resolution tunable PC-OTDR for PON monitoring in avionics
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a setup for detecting and evaluating fiber curvatures using high-resolution Photon-Counting OTDR. Our setup is based on a Time-to-Digital Converter which can account for a resolution of up to 2,8 centimeters.

articleTitle: Low-cost 6.25 GHz UDWDM-PON based on direct intensity-modulated transmitters
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demostrate a 6.25 GHz grid WDM-PON based on commercially available directly-modulated DFB transmitters driven with a 650mV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</sub> and simplified coherent receivers. The system can support 35 dB distribution network losses and allows the λ-to-the-user approach.

articleTitle: Direct modulation of 56 Gbps duobinary-4-PAM
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper reports on the direct modulation of externally modulated laser and transmission through single mode fiber of a 56 Gbps duobinary-4-pulse amplitude modulation signal through 10 GHz class optics.

articleTitle: Efficient carrier-reuse for MMW-RoF access network architecture with orthogonal phase-correlated modulation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a bandwidth-efficient full-duplex millimeter-wave radio-over-fiber access link based on orthogonal phase-correlated modulation enabled by polarization maintaining fiber Bragg gating. In our scheme, backscattering noise is eliminated completely in the upstream link.

articleTitle: Generation of 448-Gbps OTDM-PDM-16QAM signal with an integrated modulator using orthogonal CSRZ pulses
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We generated a 56-Gbaud single-carrier PDM-16QAM signal using a single integrated modulator driven with 28-Gbaud electronic signals. Two orthogonal CSRZ pulses generated in the modulator are used for spectrally efficient OTDM.

articleTitle: Laser-phase-fluctuation-insensitive optical coherent transmission of 16-QAM radio-over-fiber signal with offset-frequency-spaced two-tone local light
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A digital-signal-processing-assisted and laser-phase-fluctuation-insensitive optical coherent transmission of a 10-Gbaud 16-quadrture-amplitude-modulation radio-over-fiber signal with an offset-frequency-spaced two-tone local light is experimentally demonstrated. Error-free symbol recovery after the 20-km-long fiber-optic transmission is shown.

articleTitle: Silicon waveguide optical isolator integrated with TE-TM mode converter
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A Si waveguide optical isolator is integrated with an asymmetrical slit Si waveguide TE-TM mode converter. A maximum isolation of 26.7 dB is demonstrated at a wavelength of 1553 nm for TE mode input light.

articleTitle: Widely bandwidth-tunable broadband optical filter on silicon
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated tunable silicon band-pass filter with low in-band ripples of 0.3 dB, a high contrast of 55 dB, and no free-spectral range. A record bandwidth tuning over 670 GHz was achieved.

articleTitle: On the SOA cascadability and design rules for optical packet-switched networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally evaluate performances of QPSK, 8- and 16-QAM signals after traversing a long cascade of up to 50 SOAs and assess system design rules for an optical packet-switched SOA-based network.

articleTitle: Passive linear-optics 640 Gbit/s logic NOT gate
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 640 Gbit/s all-optical NOT gate for high-speed telecommunication on-off-keying (OOK) data signals. We employ linear optical signal processing based on spectral phase-only (all-pass) optical filtering to perform the target logic NOT operation.

articleTitle: Field trial of broker-based multi-domain software-defined heterogeneous wireline-wireless-optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Driven by a broker-based OpenFlow control plane, we report the first field trial of software-defined heterogeneous wireline-wireless-optical multi-domain networks connecting UC Davis Campus, USTC, California OpenFlow Testbed Network (COTN) and Energy Sciences Network (ESNet).

articleTitle: A novel IPoOTN packet-optical architecture for economical and fast protection of link/IP port failures
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We analyze two operationally deployable multi-layer restoration architectures for packet-optical networks that protect against port and link failures. An IPoOTN architecture using Layer 3 and Layer 1 protection mechanisms reduces IP port use by 46% compared to IPoWDM.

articleTitle: Ad-hoc photonic network based on movable and deployable ICT resource unit to meet rapidly changing service demands
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper reviews an emerging photonic network architecture based on the movable and deployable ICT resource unit(MDRU). The architecture enables us to instantly deploy an ad-hoc network that can meet rapid changes in service demand. Development of prototype MDRU and the results of a proof-of-concept experiment are reported.

articleTitle: High-speed avalanche photodiode for 100-Gbit/s ethernet
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 25-Gbit/s avalanche photodiode with an inverted p-down structure and its application to a 100GbE receiver optical subassembly. The performance indicates a record minimum receiver sensitivity of -20 dBm and 50-km error-free transmission.

articleTitle: Challenges in higher order mode Raman amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A higher order Raman amplifier model that take random mode coupling into account is presented. Mode dependent gain and signal power fluctuations at the output of the higher order mode Raman amplifier are discussed.

articleTitle: High-power THz-wave generation by using ultra-fast (315 GHz) uni-traveling carrier photodiode with novel collector design and photonic femtosecond pulse generator
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: UTC-PDs with novel collector design, flip-chip package, and ultra-wide bandwidth (315GHz) are successfully demonstrated. Under optical femtosecond pulse train illumination with THz repetition rate, it achieves record-high maximum CW output power (1.04 mW) at 280GHz operation.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis of the impact of beating between signal modes on few-mode erbium doped fiber amplifier performance
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We analyze the impact of beating effects between signal modes experimentally by comparing gain values for modulated and CW signals. We measure noticeable differences because of mode beating and mode dependent EDFA saturation.

articleTitle: Spectrally efficient 1Tb/s transceivers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Based on recent Terabit-class transmission experiment, we discuss the design of 1Tb/s transceivers for long-haul optical systems involving complex tradeoffs between constellation complexity, opto-electronics bandwidth limitations, ROADM cascade, advanced FEC...

articleTitle: Cost effective metro photonics enabled by coherent optics
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We explore whether the coherent attributes of 100G PM-QPSK technologies allows for the removal of ROADMs from transport networks. Our design is limited to metro networks carrying internet-bound data traffic.

articleTitle: Comparison between square and stepped-square QAM for optical transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a comparison of QAM and stepped-square QAM (SS-QAM) for optical transmission. While offering lower average power and 2D peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR), SS-QAM suffers a penalty in baseband due to higher 1D-PAPR.

articleTitle: Separation of semiconductor laser intrinsic linewidth and 1/f noise using multiple fiber lengths with the delayed self-heterodyne method
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed a method of measuring the intrinsic linewidth of semiconductor lasers, by using self-heterodyne method with multiple measurements of different delay fiber lengths. By eliminating the 1/ f noise effects, the linewidth becomes much smaller than the conventional measurement method.

articleTitle: Design of a family of ring-core fiber for OAM
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the design, simulation, and experimental characterization of a family of ring-core fibers suitable for OAM transmission. The simplicity of design and easily fabricated multiplicity of fibers facilitates analysis and modeling as compared to other OAM fibers.

articleTitle: Phase-sensitive amplification of 28 GBaud DP-QPSK signal
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, amplification of a DP-QPSK signal using a vector phase-sensitive amplifier (PSA). The PSA-based receiver shows an about 0.7 dB sensitivity improvement compared to an EDFA-based receiver.

articleTitle: Cross-talk in TWDM-PON beyond NG-PON2
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We assess the influence of cross-talk on the capability of upgradability of TWDMPON beyond NG-PON2 for a higher number of connected customers and for a higher number of wavelength channels using experiments and simulations.

articleTitle: Nonlinear impairment aware resource allocation in elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel integer linear program formulation and low-complexity heuristics for nonlinear impairment-aware routing and spectrum allocation in OOFDM-based elastic optical networks. Results indicate 23% bandwidth reduction compared with a transmission reach-based benchmark method.

articleTitle: Power-efficient gray-scale control of silicon thermo-optic phase shifters by pulse width modulation using monolithically integrated MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We first-time demonstrate gray-scale control by pulse-width modulation for silicon thermo-optic (TO) phase shifters using monolithic MOSFET. This work enables simple and power efficient control of TO modules without using DAC and analog current drivers.

articleTitle: Optical information capacity of silicon
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have established bounds on information capacity of silicon and have identified new types of noise from which the bounds originate. Our results suggest solutions to extending the limit via coding and coherent signaling.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic dual-polarization nanotaper for chip-to-fiber coupling
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a dual-polarization nanotaper that operates as an integrated silicon photonic beam cube, having low PDL and superior polarization extinction over 130 nm of bandwidth, and tightly-controlled NA for coupling to fiber.

articleTitle: Tunable dual-frequency lidar exploiting a mode-locked laser for integrated coherent radar-lidar architectures
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A mode-locked laser-based dual-frequency lidar with tunable tones separation is demonstrated, allowing a dynamic tradeoff among robustness and sensitivity of measurements and enabling integration with photonic-based radar. Velocity measurements for different tones separation are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Evaluating flexibility degrees in optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We consider an IP over flexgrid network and present a joint IP routing, distance-adaptive routing and spectrum allocation formulation. We evaluate the performance of fixed- and flex-grid switches, fixed transponders, single- and multi-flow bandwidth-variable transponders.

articleTitle: Photonic Integrated wavelength converter based on double stage cross gain modulation in SOAs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a new monolithic InP Photonic-Integrated-Circuit (PIC) for all-optical wavelength conversion. The PIC exploits double stage cross-gain-modulation in semiconductor optical amplifiers (SOA)s and an integrated DBR laser. We report device characterization and 10 Gb/s wavelength conversion operation.

articleTitle: The dynamics of inter-channel nonlinear distortions in fiber-transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Inter-channel nonlinear processes that are responsible for nonlinear interference noise (NLIN) in fiber optic transmission, can be classified as two-pulse, three-pulse, or four-pulse collisions. Each type of collision is shown to have a unique signature and the nature of NLIN is determined by the relative importance of the various classes of pulse collisions. The pulse-collision picture provides a simple and intuitive explanation to all of the reported phenomena, and suggests possible paths for their cancelation.

articleTitle: Mode selection and larger set equalization for mode-multiplexed fiber transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study the performance of six-mode and ten-mode fiber-based SDM systems impaired by mode-dependent-loss when selecting an appropriate set of modes for multiplexing at the transmitter, and detecting more modes at the receiver.

articleTitle: Complete Dispersive Fourier Transform in near-field for single-shot spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show that analog temporal phase modulation enables complete Dispersive Fourier Transform in near-field. As for proof of the concept, acetylene gas absorption spectrum is measured at 37 million frames/second update rate with high sensitivity.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstrations of next generation cost-effective mobile fronthaul with IFoF technique
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We described next generation mobile fronthaul based on IFoF technique and theoretically estimated its system performances. Based on our analysis, we also experimentally demonstrated mobile fronthaul with 12 IF carriers on a single wavelength.

articleTitle: A novel detection scheme for Nyquist optical time-division multiplexed signal with coherent matched sampling
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel detection scheme for N-OTDM signal with coherent matched sampling is proposed to suppress inter-symbol-interference. 9 dB required-OSNR improvement is observed under 3.9 ps pulse-width in 160 Gbaud proof-of-concept experiment compared with Gaussian-shaped sampling.

articleTitle: 4D-CMA: Enabling separation of channel compensation and polarization demultiplex
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a 4D-CMA feedback for butterfly filter adaptation enabling separation of channel compensation and polarization demultiplex. Using a digital polarization controller for demultiplex we demonstrate feasibility and ~10-fold speed increase compared to standard CMA.

articleTitle: Telecom to mid-infrared supercontinuum generation in a silicon germanium waveguide
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first demonstration of broadband supercontinuum generation in silicon-germanium waveguides. Upon propagation of ultra-short femtosecond pulses in a 3-cm-long waveguide, the broadening extended from 1.455µm to 2.788µm (at the −30-dB point).

articleTitle: Impairment evaluation toward QKD integration in a conventional 20-channel metro network
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Integration of QKD in telecom infrastructures raises noise issues not present in systems using dedicated fibers. Experiments on a 3-node metro network indicate that integration is possible when allocating broadband quantum channels in the O-band.

articleTitle: Extremely low loss THz guidance using Kagome lattice porous core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel porous core Kagome lattice photonic crystal fiber is proposed for extremely low loss THz waves guiding. It has been reported that 82.5% of bulk effective material loss of Topas can be reduced.

articleTitle: Loop-assisted multi-input-multi-output coherent matched detector for ultra high-bandwidth parallel optical time-frequency domain sampling
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate loop-assisted multi-input-multi-output coherent matched detector, enabling ultra-wideband parallel optical sampling in time-frequency domain. 8-subchannels packed in 80 GHz in single polarization was simultaneously captured in parallel only using a single 10-Gbaud coherent receiver.

articleTitle: LCOS-based flexible grid 1×40 wavelength selective switch using planar lightwave circuit as spot size converter
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A high port count WSS using planar lightwave circuit at optical input/output ports is presented. We demonstrate a LCOS-based 1×40 WSS with less than 8.0 dB insertion loss and ±17 GHz 0.5dB passband width.

articleTitle: Operational issues facing commercial raman amplifier system: Safety measures and system designs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We overview operational issues in Raman amplifier system deployment from the viewpoints of precautions and countermeasures against potential hazards and optical signal-to-noise ratio system design for stable commercial use.

articleTitle: All-fiber spatial mode selective filter for compensating mode dependent loss in MDM transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a simple all-fiber spatial mode selective filter based on splicing a short segment of small-core SMF between two few-mode fibers. An 8dB MDL equalization range with less than 2dB IL is demonstrated for a 2-mode fiber device.

articleTitle: Optical fronthaul of LTE-advanced MIMO by spatial multiplexing in multicore fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical wireless fronthaul of dual Mx2×2 MIMO LTE-A systems by radio-over-fiber spatial multiplexing is demonstrated over 125m 4-core fiber using 16QAM and 64QAM subcarrier mapping. 3GPP LTE MIMO algorithms in-place successfully mitigate core-to-core impairments.

articleTitle: First multi-partner demonstration of BGP-LS enabled inter-domain EON control with H-PCE
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The control of Multi-domain Elastic Optical Networks (EON) is possible by combining H-PCE based computation, BGP-LS topology discovery, remote Instantiation via PCEP, and signaling via RSVP-TE. This paper presents the first multi-platform demonstration that fully validates such control architecture achieving multi-protocol interoperability.

articleTitle: 51.1-Tbit/s MCF transmission over 2,520 km using cladding pumped 7-core EDFAs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 51.1-Tb/s multi-core fiber transmission using cladding pumped 7-core EDFAs and confirmed a reachable distance of 2,520 km with 73 × 100-Gbit/s Nyquist-pulse-shaped DP-QPSK signals per core.

articleTitle: True value of flexible networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This presentation illustrates how new Packet Optical platforms will leverage coherent optics along with CDC-F ROADM advances to significantly improve network reliability. scalability and flexibility to reduce the overall cost of transport infrastructure.

articleTitle: Optical Nyquist-filtering multi/demultiplexer with PLC for 1-Tb/s class super-channel transceiver
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed a 37.5-GHz-spaced 8-subcarrier Nyquist-filtering multi/demulti-plexer with inverse sine compensation using integrated planar optics. We successfully demonstrated super-channel generation/reception with an OSNR penalty of 0.2 dB using the multi/demultiplexers and 32-Gbaud DP-QPSK subcarriers.

articleTitle: Simultaneous phase noise reduction of 30 comb lines from a quantum-dash mode-locked laser diode enabling coherent tbit/s data transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A feed-forward heterodyne scheme is shown to simultaneously reduce the phase noise of many comb lines from a quantum-dash mode-locked laser diode (QD-MLLD). This enables the first coherent data transmission using QD-MLLD as multi-wavelength source.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of femtocell visible light communication system employing code division multiple access
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper experimentally demonstrates a femtocell visible light communication system employing CDMA for multiple users, in which the intracells and intercells interference is alleviated, resulting in a significant aggregate capacity improvement.

articleTitle: Optical-comb-line selection from a low-power/low-OSNR comb using a low-coherence semiconductor laser for flexible ultra-dense short range transceivers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 6.25GHz-spaced optical-comb-line selection either by low-coherence injection-locked laser (LC-ILLD) or with a combination ultra-narrow-filter and low-noise-fiber-amplifier (UNF-FA) is assessed. In a 144Gbps DP-64QAM transmission the LC-ILLD outperforms the UNF-FA approach for comb-OSNR-levels below 30dB.

articleTitle: FlowBroker: Market-driven multi-domain SDN with heterogeneous brokers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an enhanced market-driven multi-broker architecture for multi-domain SDN forwarding, in which heterogeneous brokers compete for domain customers and can peer with one another to provide enhanced services if economically beneficial.

articleTitle: Mode-division multiplexed W-Band RoF transmission for higher-order spatial multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 20Gb/s seamless 2×2 MIMO transmission of W-Band millimeter-wave signals over a 30-km modal-dispersion-compensated mode-division multiplexed link and a 2.5-m wireless path, is demonstrated for enhancing the transmission capacity in radio-over-fiber systems.

articleTitle: Fractional OFDM based transmitter and receiver for time/frequency multiplexing in gridless, elastic networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time optical fractional OFDM system, based on intermediate grids between time and frequency axes. Using reconfigurable wavelength selective switches, we demonstrated open eye diagrams, and performance below the FEC-limit.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of the improvement of system sensitivity using multiple state trellis coded optical modulation with QPSK and 16QAM constellations
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We evaluated experimentally 2, 8, 32 state 32Gbaud TCM-QPSK and TCM-16QAM. TCM offers finer configuration for flexible transponders increasing SE, on 1.1dB wider ranges. TCM may also be used with HD-FEC in lower power transceivers.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of full-duplex optical wireless personal area communication system with 16-CAP modulation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, we experimentally demonstrate a full-duplex high-speed indoor optical wireless communication system with 16 Carrierless-Amplitude-Phase (CAP) modulation. Results show that 10 Gb/s downlink and 2 Gb/s uplink can be realized simultaneously.

articleTitle: 400 Gbps real-time coherent Nyquist-WDM DP-16QAM transmission over legacy G.652 or G.655 fibre infrastructure with 2 dB margins
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate uncompensated error-free transmission of 400 Gbps real-time coherent DP-16QAM with Nyquist filtering (5.33 bit/s/Hz) over 500 km (resp. 300 km) of G.652 (resp. G.655) fibre using purely EDFA amplification and taking into account 2 dB margins.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable four-channel polarization diversity silicon photonic WDM receiver
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a silicon photonic 4×25 Gb/s polarization-insensitive wavelength-division multiplexing receiver with a fiber-to-photodiode responsivity >0.26 A/W and crosstalk <;-20 dB in 200-GHz channel spacing. Both central wavelengths and channel spacing are tunable.

articleTitle: Evaluating the optimum filter resolution and sub-channel spectrum granularity for flexible super-channels
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The optimum spectrum granularity for sub-channel allocation within super-channels is evaluated according to the Nyquist-shaping characteristics of ultra-fine resolution filters. Optimized blocking performance is achieved for 3.125GHz granularity using novel fine resolution technologies.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive in-band OSNR measurement of polarization multiplexed signals operating in the non-linear regime
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce a non-intrusive OSNR measurement technique relying on spectral deformation analysis which is suitable for densely provisioned polarization-multiplexed signals operated in the nonlinear regime. We demonstrate its performance over a wide range of conditions.

articleTitle: 25.78-Gb/s VCSEL-based optical transceiver with retimer-embedded driver and receiver ICs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The 25.78-Gb/s VCSEL transceiver with retimer-embedded ICs was firstly developed. We succeeded to suppress the power as low as 200 mW/lane for retime function and realized transmission over 300-m by jitter suppression with the retimer.

articleTitle: Scalable and flexible transport networks for inter-datacenter connectivity
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We provide an overview of the underlying drivers for capacity growth and discuss technologies and emerging management models (e.g., SDN) to actualize and manage this capacity in terrestrial long haul and subsea links.

articleTitle: SDN control of packet over optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: ONOS packet optical use; transport control; and transport-enabled SDN.

articleTitle: L-band 2-LP mode EDFA with low modal dependent gain
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate mode-dependent gain (MDG) controllability in an L-band 2-LP mode amplifier, and realize a low MDG and flat-gain (<;1 dB) in the 1570-1600 nm range by using a ring-core erbium-doped fiber amplifier.

articleTitle: Multi-core fiber based pluggable add/drop link using rotational connector
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We realize an arbitrary core access in multi-core fiber (MCF) by using a planar lightwave circuit and a rotational connector technologies. This enables easy and reconfigurable construction of a high-speed multiple link over an MCF.

articleTitle: First demonstration of hollow-core fiber for intra data center low latency connectivity with a commercial 100Gb/s interface
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For the first time 100Gb/s transmission using commercial low latency hardware is demonstrated over the longest manufactured hollow-core fiber (2.75km) to date, proving the feasibility of ultra-low latency intra-data center connectivity.

articleTitle: Evaluation of impact of traffic asymmetry on performance of Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The impact of traffic asymmetry on performance of Elastic Optical Networks (EONs) is studied. Results of experiments are presented to show how both symmetric and asymmetric lightpath provisioning scenarios influence spectrum usage and network CAPEX cost.

articleTitle: Ethernet and OTN - 400G and beyond
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Evolution of networks to higher rates involves the work of three key standards organizations: IEEE 802.3 for Ethernet, OIF for higher-rate electrical signaling and for the Flex Ethernet Initiative, and ITU-T Study Group 15 for Optical Transport network specifications in evolving beyond 100G; Lots of “moving parts” and coordination required. Recent developments including new Ethernet rates, Flex Ethernet require constant adjustment across the ecosystem to take new developments on board; A full 100G eco-system of standards was available in 2010. The generation including 400G is expected to be available in 2017.

articleTitle: Low switching voltage InP-based travelling wave electrode Mach-Zehnder modulator monolithically integrated with DFB-laser for 60 Gb/s NRZ
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a transmitter consisting of a travelling wave electrode InP-based Mach-Zehnder modulator monolithically integrated with a DFB laser. For the first time, 60Gb/s NRZ at low 1.5V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</sub> modulation voltage and zero chirp is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Network optimization strategies and control plane impacts
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Network planning strategies based on GN-model are explored and compared to identify the best solution that maximizes network flexibility. An optical architecture for real-time network optimization is presented and implications at optical control plane are discussed.

articleTitle: Decision-directed-free blind phase noise estimation for CO-OFDM
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an effective decision-directed-free blind phase noise compensation method for CO-OFDM transmission. By applying this technique, the common phase error can be accurately estimated using as few as three test phases.

articleTitle: 400Gb/s trials on commercial systems using real-time bit-rate-adaptive transponders for next generation networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review recent field trials employing real time 400Gb/s dual-carrier PDM-16 QAM channels. The results demonstrate their compliance not only with nowadays 50-GHz grid network but also with next generation flexgrid networks carrying super-channels.

articleTitle: Virtual machine migration over optical circuit switching network in a converged inter/intra data center architecture
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel converged inter/intra data center architecture using optical-circuit-switching over metro-scale distances. A Software Defined Network (SDN) control-plane provides connectivity between the application and data-plane layers. Virtual-machine migration over 50km is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: High-linearity avalanche photodiode for 40-km transmission with 28-Gbaud PAM4
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a high-linearity avalanche photodiode (APD) for 28-Gbaud PAM4, namely. 56 Gbit/s/λ,. With an optical receiver incorporating the APD, a 40-km transmission with −17 dBm receiver sensitivity was successfully demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: 25.8Gbps Direct Modulation AlGaInAs DFB lasers of low power consumption and wide temperature range operation for data center
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 25.8Gbps Direct Modulation AlGaInAs DFB lasers were demonstrated for lower consumption in a wide temperature range. The DFB lasers achieved excellent eye opening from -20°C to 85°C at low current less than 56.5mA.

articleTitle: Clock recovery in coherent optical receivers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigated symbol timing in coherent systems. Several non-data-aided phase detector candidates are listed for specific excess bandwidth-dependent applications. Parallel implementation including clock recovery delay and hardware limitations are studied.

articleTitle: Shape sensing using multi-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A method of converting multi-core fiber strain and twist measurements into three dimensional shape measurements using Frenet-Serret equations adapted to the treatment of a multi-core optical fiber as a Kirchhoff elastic rod is presented.

articleTitle: InP coherent optical modulator with integrated amplification for high capacity transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the design and characterization of an InP-based coherent optical transmitter integrating optical gain together with modulator, monitor and control elements to provide enhanced performance for high spectral efficiency 100Gb/s transmission.

articleTitle: Long distance transmission in a multi-core fiber with self-homodyne detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate long-distance space-division multiplexed self-homodyne transmission in two synchronized recirculating loops. Compared to intradyne detection, PDM-64QAM transmission distance with DFB lasers is doubled and 6800km PDM-QPSK transmission, within ldB of intradyne detection, is achieved.

articleTitle: Optical wireless LED link for the backhaul of small cells
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally that optical wireless (OW) links using an infrared LED can meet the bitrate, distance and latency requirements for low-cost small-cell wireless backhaul in Long-Term Evolution (LTE) mobile networks.

articleTitle: Coherent terabit communications using a quantum-dash mode-locked laser and self-homodyne detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We transmit 18 GBd 16QAM signals on 25 spectral lines of a quantum-dash mode-locked laser diode, achieving a 1.562 Tbit/s aggregate data rate. Phase noise is cancelled by self-homodyne detection using LO tones transmitted with the signal.

articleTitle: First demonstration of seamless optical and radio transmission with plural W-band wireless sections
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated the feasibility of seamless optical and radio transmissions with plural W-band wireless sections for the first time. A 5-Gbaud QPSK signal was successfully transmitted over 2×20-km SMF spans and 2×2-m W-band wireless links.

articleTitle: Measurement of direct modulated lasers frequency-drift in burst-mode and impact on narrowly filtered receivers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The frequency-drift under burst-mode operation is evaluated. A fast drift at start of burst is found that has inverted sign compared to thermal drift. The impact on narrowly filtered receivers is studied by BER measurements.

articleTitle: Six spatial modes photonic lanterns
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Low-loss all-fiber mode selective photonic-lanterns capable of exciting six spatial fiber modes (4 LP modes) are demonstrated. Mode field profile characterization of photonic lanterns using both step and graded index fibers is presented.

articleTitle: Widely tunable Coupled Cavity Laser based on a Michelson interferometer with doubled free spectral range
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a 26 nm tunable Coupled Cavity Laser based on a novel interferometer and fabricated in a low-cost generic foundry process, with SMSR above 40 dB and fibre coupled power > 5mW.

articleTitle: High symbol rate transmission systems for data rates from 400 Gb/s to 1Tb/s
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: high symbol rate transmission systems; terabit-class transponders; space division multiplexing; single carrier high symbol rate systems; commercial high speed DAC; optical equalizer programmable filter; front-end calibration; DSP; higher-order modulation; QAM; high symbol rate transmitters; high symbol rate receivers; transponders; and digital coherent detection.

articleTitle: 400-Gb/s operation of flip-chip interconnection EADFB laser array module
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The flip-chip interconnection 8-channel EADFB laser array module is developed. The flip-chip interconnection technique provides low crosstalk. After 10-km transmission, clear eye opening is obtained for all eight lanes under 8 × 50-Gb/s simultaneous operation.

articleTitle: On the MIMO channel rank deficiency in W-band MIMO RoF transmissions
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Spatial multiplexing gain degradation due to millimeter-order antenna misalignments in W-band MIMO-RoF systems is investigated in 40-Gbps-class 2 × 2 MIMO-OFDM RoF transmissions. The advantage of space-time block coding there is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Linearization of optical channels with stokes vector direct detection
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Aiming to improve the performance of short-reach optical communications, Stokes-vector direct detection (SV-DD) is proposed to realize linear complex optical channels. In this paper, we present the principle and discuss the performance of SV-DD modulation format.

articleTitle: Agnostic software-defined coherent optical receiver performing time-domain hybrid modulation format recognition
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel DSP architecture for coherent optical receivers that identifies time-domain hybrid modulation formats without any prior knowledge of the received signal. Experimental investigation demonstrates successful identification of 31.5GBaud TDHMF signals composed with BPSK/QPSK/8QAM/16QAM after 810km transmission.

articleTitle: Scalability of telecom cloud architectures for live-TV distribution
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A hierarchical distributed telecom cloud architecture for live-TV distribution exploiting flexgrid networking and SBVTs is proposed. Its scalability is compared to that of a centralized architecture. Cost savings as high as 32 % are shown.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics and FDMA-PON: Insights from the EU FP7 FABULOUS project
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The FABULOUS EU project aims at demonstrating the effectiveness of a self-coherent reflective FDMA WDM PON architecture, achieving record transmission performances and demonstrating an ONU as a silicon-photonics PIC with unprecedented level of integration.

articleTitle: 40-watt power-over-fiber using a double-clad fiber for optically powered radio-over-fiber systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have successfully demonstrated bidirectional radio-over-fiber transmission using a double-clad fiber with 40-Watt (W) optical power feeding. The error-vector-magnitude penalties of the transmitted signals were less than 0.06% with and without 40-W optical power feeding.

articleTitle: Elastic Black Link for future vendor independent optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review the status of Black Link standardization activities, prospects and challenges on possible elastic-optical extensions, and report on the latest experimental achievements on DSP technology compatibility for next generation 1.28 Tb/s PM-16QAM super-channel.

articleTitle: Transceiver-limited high spectral efficiency Nyquist-WDM systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally examine the maximum achievable transmission performance of a 7 channel Nyquist-WDM system with 10GBd per carrier. Back-to-back, a maximum of 11.9 bit/sym and 13.8 bit/sym can be transmitted for DP-64QAM and DP-256QAM respectively, while after 2 spans of transmission, a maximum of 12.4 bit/sym and 11.6 bit/sym can be achieved.

articleTitle: A 25 Gb/s burst-mode receiver for low latency photonic switch networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A DC-coupled burst-mode receiver performs optical power calibration in 12.5ns, achieves phase lock in 18.5ns and tracks input data using a CDR. The sensitivity of the 4.4pJ/bit receiver is -10.9dBm (BER <; 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup>) at 25Gb/s.

articleTitle: InP integrated coherent transmitter for 100 Gb/s DP-QPSK transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated coherent transmitter (ICT) comprised of a co-packaged narrow linewidth BH-DFB laser and high performance InP-based modulator suitable for 100 Gb/s DP-QPSK coherent transmission. This ICT provides a signal output power > 0dBm and an independent 10 dBm local oscillator (LO) port.

articleTitle: SDN-controlled routing of elephants and mice over a hybrid optical/electrical DCN testbed
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an SDN-controlled hybrid optical/electrical intra-DCN framework allowing differentiated routing of diverse flow types. Experimental results demonstrate flow completion time reduction of up to 60% and 40% for elephants and mice respectively.

articleTitle: Advanced DSP for optical access networks: Challenges and opportunities
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Employing DSP technology is an attractive way to enhance standardized 10-Gbps per wavelength PONs toward the converged optical-wireless network. For TDM-based co-existence of digital coherent PON and existing PONs, burst mode coherent receivers for uplink and hierarchical modulation for downlink are introduced.

articleTitle: Field demonstration of a tunable WDM-PON system with novel SFP+ modules and centralized wavelength control
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on a demonstration of a novel tunable WDM-PON system over 25km of field deployed fiber. We show error-free operation at 1GbE with sensitivity better than −30dBm and centralized control of the ONU wavelengths.

articleTitle: Phase sensitive amplifiers and their applications
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: phase sensitive amplifier; PSA; four-wave-mixing; three-wave mixing; phase locked waves; optical injection locking; phase regenerator; binary stair-like phase transfer function; phase sensitive extinction ratio curves; multicasting; QPSK regeneration; one mode low noise amplifier and phase-conjugated twin waves.

articleTitle: Photonic packaging in high-throughput microelectronic assembly lines for cost-efficiency and scalability
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate silicon photonic packaging that can be fully exercised in existing microelectronic packaging facilities. We show low optical loss and point towards notably improved assembly cost and scalability in both volume and optical port-count.

articleTitle: Coded modulation design for finite-iteration decoding and high-dimensional modulation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show how to design capacity-approaching LDPC codes under different modulation formats and different decoding methods. With EXIT chart analysis for finite-iteration BICM-ID of various HDM, we achieve 2dB gain from a code optimized for 1D modulation.

articleTitle: Impact of fanout and transmission reach on performance of multicasting in Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The impact of fanout and transmission reach on provisioning of static multicast traffic in Elastic Optical Networks is studied. Result of numerical experiments are presented to show the impact in terms of spectrum and regenerator usage.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>

articleTitle: Spatial-spectral-efficiency-enhanced multi-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A spatial-spectral-efficiency (SSE)-enhanced multi-core fiber (MCF) is designed by considering splicing loss, transmission distance, attenuation, and nonlinearity. Proposed MCF achieves highest SSE ever-fabricated single-mode MCFs with transmission distance up to 4,000 km.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 75 ns end-to-end latency in an optical top-of-rack switch
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 75 ns end-to-end latency for server to server Ethernet traffic in an FPGA implementation of an optical data center top-of-rack switch control plane.

articleTitle: On optimal modulation and FEC overhead for future optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Transceivers employing square PM-QAM with up to two FEC overheads are optimized based on the SNR distribution. For NSFNET two FEC overheads with PM-16QAM give an 82% throughput increase compared with PM-QPSK with 7% overhead.

articleTitle: Application-aware software-defined EPON upstream resource allocation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study an SDN-enabled EPON architecture that utilizes application information from clients to achieve superior upstream resource allocation. This leads to better quality of experience of video-conferencing clients which are high consumers of upstream bandwidth.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared photonics
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Group IV and III-V semiconductor photonic devices are prime candidates for photonic and opto-electronic (OEIC) applications in the 1.8 to 5.0 μm infrared wavelength range. Si-based active photonics in the GeSn/SiGeSn heterosystem (LDs, PDs, LEDs, amplifiers, EOMs) offers the Si CMOS “foundry advantage” for high-volume low-cost OEIC manufacture. Two MIR applications stand out: (1) deployment of GeSn SOI-based OEICs in a new “supplemental” global fiber-optic network at ~ 2 um wavelengths; (2) creation/deployment of GeSn-related photonic chem-bio-physical sensor OEICs (as well as night-vision-imaging chips) in hand-held tablets and smart phones. The new smart sensors will be part of a local or global network-of-sensors utilizing the “internet of things”.

articleTitle: Efficient and mode-selective spatial multiplexer based on multi-plane light conversion
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on a 6-mode spatial multiplexer based on multi-plane light conversion with 4.6dB insertion loss and −23dB mode-to-mode crosstalk, designed for few-mode fiber transmission systems that do not rely on complex electronic post-processing.

articleTitle: Performance optimization in ROADM-enabled DWDM systems using flexible modulation formats
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The time domain hybrid QAM enabled flexible transceiver is proposed to adaptively optimize the transmission performance in DWDM systems with cascaded ROADMs. Comprehensive performance investigations are conducted for both fixed and flexible grid systems.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation of the time and frequency crosstalk dependency in a 7-core multi-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally evaluate the time-varying crosstalk frequency response of a multicore fiber. Our findings suggest that dynamically adaptive transmission would be able to exploit this behavior, to improve the performance of crosstalk-limited links.

articleTitle: Integrated photonic devices and circuits in multilayer silicon nitride-on-silicon platforms
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Low-loss silicon nitride waveguides integrated onto silicon photonic platforms enable the scaling to large-area photonic circuits. Properties of a multilayer silicon nitride-on-silicon platform and a variety of photonic devices and circuits will be described.

articleTitle: Impact of pluggable analog coherent optics modules on line card architecture and DSP functionality
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Pluggable analog coherent optics modules will change the architecture of line cards. Associated benefits like lower cost, installation on-demand and higher face-plate densities will come at the price of more complex DSP algorithms.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated mode multiplexer/de-multiplexer on three-dimensional SiOx-waveguide platform
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed a compact and multiplicity-scalable mode multiplexer using three-dimensional silicon-rich silica waveguide on a silicon chip.
