Experimental results showed a feasibility demonstration of demultiplexing 3 modes with a chip area of -0.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Programmable wavelength locking and routing in a silicon-photonic interconnection network implementation
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A programmable control system for wavelength locking WDM channels on microring arrays is used to demonstrate arbitrary demultiplexing and selection of fast switchable wavelengths. Successful data measurements verify the functionality within an interconnection network implementation.

articleTitle: First 105 Gb/s low power, small footprint PAM-8 impedance-engineered TOSA with InP MZ-modulator and customized driver IC using predistortion
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A small footprint, low power 105Gb/s PAM-8 TOSA with InP-based/Mach-Zehnder modulator and a customized SiGe differential driver with a modulation power of 3.23pJ/bit is demonstrated. Predistortion is applied to compensate for non-linearities of both devices.

articleTitle: Fully-passive resiliency switch for agile PON restoration
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a network recovery concept based on fully-passive inline demarcation nodes powered through energy scavenging at low optical feed level of -10dBm. Protection switching in 10.7 ms is experimentally demonstrated at the PON feeder.

articleTitle: High speed and high temperature operation of VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: VCSELs operating at high bit rates over a wide temperature range are needed for the next generation optical interconnect standards. We report on the high speed and high temperature characteristics of 850 nm VCSELs and VCSEL arrays capable of meeting the upcoming requirements.

articleTitle: Multiplier-free carrier-phase recovery for real-time receivers using processing in polar coordinates
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A low-complexity, multi-format carrier-phase estimation algorithm for QPSK and 16QAM is demonstrated. Our multiplier-free hardware implementation is enabled by operating in polar coordinates and allows for detection of QPSK signals beyond 38 GBd.

articleTitle: Real-time 10 Gbit/s-16 QAM quantum stream cipher transmission over 320 km with FPGA-based transmitter and receiver
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first real-time 10 Gbit/s-16 QAM quantum stream cipher transmission over 320 km with an FPGA-based transmitter and receiver. The random number sequence pattern was changed on-line to increase the encryption security.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a photonic integrated network-on-chip with multi microrings
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A multi-microring network-on-chip for datacom applications is demonstrated on a silicon-on-insulator platform. Measurements on the photonic integrated circuit are in good agreement with simulations, achieving a 3dB-bandwidth of 39 GHz and a worst-case crosstalk of -12dB.

articleTitle: The impact of pump phase-modulation and filtering on WDM signals in a fibre optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: WDM signal degradation from pump phase-modulation in a one-pump 20dB net-gain fibre optical parametric amplifier is experimentally and numerically characterised for the first time using 10×59Gb/s QPSK signals.

articleTitle: Development of MPO type 8-multicore fiber connector
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed MPO type 8-MCF (56-core) connector. Rotational alignment with alignment member and absorption of protrusion difference using compressive strain were adopted. Fabricated 8-MCF connector demonstrated all core PC and connection loss <; 0.7 dB.

articleTitle: Narrow linewidth tunable laser using coupled resonator mirrors
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel fully integrated tunable single mode hybrid silicon laser is demonstrated. We report a linewidth of 260kHz, which is the lowest reported for a monolithically integrated laser. The side-mode suppression ratio is >40dB.

articleTitle: High performance 400 Gigabit Ethernet links using hybrid multiband CAP/QAM scheme
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose the first combined 4×100Gb/s hybrid multiband CAP-16 transmitter and QAM-16 receiver system and simulations show that it has 0.7 dBo (2.2 dBo) more power margin than 8×50Gb/s (4×100Gb/s) PAM-4 over DML (EML) SMF link.

articleTitle: Impact of WDM channel spacing on millimeter-wave wireless access using wireless coherent radio-over-fiber (CRoF) channels
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Impact of channel spacing in a WDM network on the performance of wireless channels selected by the coherent optical heterodyne radio-over-fiber approach. Experimental demonstration shows a penalty of about ~1 dB per 5 GHz decreased channel spacing down to a channel spacing of 15 GHz and a penalty of ~2 dB between 15 GHz and 10 GHz channel spacing.

articleTitle: Future narrow linewidth lasers
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe the challenges and solutions for future narrow linewidth lasers with small footprint. We fabricated DR laser array based narrower linewiedth TLS. We introduce ITXA of a co-packaged DFB array based TLS and InP-based modulator.

articleTitle: SDN transport architecture and challenges
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: SDN architecture based on separation of control and data functions enables realization of programmability and application aware networking. High level reference architecture components are discussed and potential challenges are outlined for implementation.

articleTitle: FWM-based, idler-free phase quantiser with flexible operating power
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Coherently adding a signal's conjugate and third harmonic at the latter's wavelength enables phase quantisation across a large operating power range. With broadband phase noise, a 5.6dB QPSK receiver sensitivity improvement is achieved with BER= 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>.

articleTitle: Compact silicon-based DML transmitter with extinction ratio improved for 40G TWDM PON OLT scenarios
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An ER improved 4×10Gbps DML WDM transmitter based on Silicon MRR for 40G TWDM-PON is proposed. The ER improvement is more than 6dB with sensitivity of -30.6dBm at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> BER after 20km transmission.

articleTitle: Demonstration of no-guard-band coherent IFDMA/OFDMA/SC-FDMA-PON co-existence uplink system using real-time IFDMA transmitter
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated multiple-FDMA co-coexisted PON uplink transmission using the real-time ONU transmitter prototype. Flexible bandwidth assignment to multiplexed 3-ONU and the distance-adaptive capability is successfully indicated.

articleTitle: Experimental assessment of GMPLS/PCE-controlled Multi-Flow Optical Transponders in flexgrid networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and implement required GMPLS/PCE routing and signaling protocol extensions for the configuration/control of MF OTPs. A novel online RSMA algorithm allows experimentally evaluating the automatic provisioning of LSPs including MF OTPs.

articleTitle: Residual capacity aware dynamic control of GRE-based routing optical path networks under traffic growth model
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel control algorithm for Grouped Routing networks that utilize a metric for residual capacity estimation. Numerical experiments under growing traffic scenarios confirm that it can maximize the fiber frequency utilization.

articleTitle: Impact of multi-wavelength sliceable transponders in elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The utilization of sliceable bandwidth variable transponders based on multi-wavelength technology is evaluated in EONs. A routing and spectrum assignment scheme is proposed specifically designed to consider the constraints introduced by multi-wavelength technology.

articleTitle: Volume manufacturing of Hollow Core Photonic Band Fibers: Challenges and opportunities
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A fluid dynamics model is used to investigate yield increase in hollow-core bandgap fibers. 100km of good fiber from one preform seems feasible; for higher yields some observed distortions would need to be addressed.

articleTitle: Multifunctional all-optical signal processing scheme for simultaneous multichannel WDM multicast and XOR logic gates based on FWM in QD-SOA
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Through FWM in our fabricated QD-SOA and without additional pumps, three 1-to-3 WDM multicasts and three XOR logic gates are simultaneously realized for three 10 Gbps NRZ-DPSK signals. The error-free performance is achieved for all of the signals and the power penalties are <; 1.3dB at BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>.

articleTitle: Performance and advantages of 100 Gb/s QPSK/8QAM hybrid modulation formats
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We designed and compared time-domain hybrid-modulation formats with adaptive symbol rates and adaptive code rates to optimize the reach of variable grid 100Gb/s systems. Experimental comparisons quantify linear, non-linear and coding gain of various schemes.

articleTitle: Survivable Virtual Optical Network mapping in spectrum and modulation format convertible flexible grid optical networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study the problem of survivable Virtual Optical Network (VON) mapping in a flexible grid optical network with programmable regenerators that are capable of converting spectrum and modulation format. We propose heuristic algorithms to address the problem with the objective of minimizing blocking probability for dynamic VON requests.

articleTitle: Perturbative nonlinear pre-compensation in presence of optical filtering
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study the performance of perturbative nonlinear pre-compensation algorithm in presence of in-line optical filtering, by numerical and experimental investigations. We show that optical filtering can severely degrade the performance of perturbative nonlinear pre-compensation.

articleTitle: Coherent optical communication technology
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. Some of the specific areas/topics discussed include: Principle of Coherent Optical Detection; Brief History of Coherent Optical Communications; Digital Coherent Receivers; Digital Signal Processing; Coherent Transmission Characteristics; and Conclusions.

articleTitle: Polarization insensitive wavelength conversion of 40 Gb/s DPSK signals in a silicon germanium waveguide
publicationTitle: 2015 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate polarization insensitive FWM-based wavelength conversion of 40Gb/s DPSK signals in a SiGe waveguide, with 0.42-dB polarization-dependent loss. A 1.5-dB Dower nenaltv was measured at a BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup>.
